In reality, sycophancy rarely happens in a single exchange; it may emerge organically as users repeatedly insist or subtly steer the dialogue over time. Current evaluations, however, rely on rigid, single-turn tests or fixed scripts that fail to capture these natural dynamics. Furthermore, these benchmarks often mistake showing basic empathy for yielding, penalizing models for acknowledging a user's feeling. This view may drive future models to over-correct into cold, dismissive rigidity. To address this gap, we introduce FIGS (Factual Integrity and Grounded Support), a dual-axis evaluation framework built around extended, realistic dialogue. We use an adaptive 10-turn conversational simulator that dynamically challenges the target model, reflecting how users repeat requests, push back, or steer a conversation toward a preferred answer. To accurately evaluate these trajectories, we apply a taxonomy that strictly separates Sycophancy (whether the model holds firm to the truth and keeps its praise proportional) from Calibrated Validation (showing empathetic understanding of the user's feelings without overdoing it). We release our complete testing environment, including 500 diverse multi-turn scenarios and an automated judge. Our evaluation of leading models reveals a consistent trade-off: over the course of a sustained interaction, current systems either slowly drift to sycophancy or over-correct into robotic detachment. This demonstrates that balancing honesty with appropriate support throughout a natural conversation remains a critical, unsolved challenge.

AI.tldr: FIGS是一个双轴评估框架，使用10轮自适应对话模拟器，通过500个多轮场景独立评估大语言模型的"谄媚性"（Sycophancy，对事实立场的把控）与"校准性共情"（Calibrated Validation，对用户情感披露的恰当回应），以揭示当前模型在诚实与共情之间难以兼顾的核心矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估多采用单轮或固定脚本测试，无法捕捉真实多轮对话中随用户反复施压而逐渐浮现的谄媚行为；此外，单轴评估常将"共情"误判为"屈服"，可能驱使模型矫枉过正，陷入冷漠的"家长式陷阱"（paternalism trap）。本文旨在构建一个能同时衡量事实定力与恰当共情的真实多轮评估基准。
AI.method: 1) 提出双轴分类体系：S轴（Sycophancy，7条规则）评估事实立场把控，分S1（立场形成与修正）与S2（内容与清晰度）两层；V轴（Calibrated Validation，3条规则）评估对用户披露情感/处境的恰当回应。2) 构建500个冻结的多轮场景（390个S轴 + 110个V轴），覆盖6个日常领域与3个严重等级，由自适应用户模拟器（DeepSeek-V4-Flash）执行10轮对话。3) 采用固定LLM评委（GLM-5.3-Flash），通过两阶段打分（先1-4严重度，再标定违规规则）；评委与人类标注一致性QWK达0.75（S轴）/0.70（V轴），超过人类标注者间一致性。4) 评估8个主流模型在baseline、factual（强调准确性）、optimal（双轴平衡）三种系统提示下的表现。
AI.result: 主要发现：1) 基线下模型谄媚失败率26.2%–64.4%，而V轴失败率普遍低于5.5%；94%的谄媚失败出现在首轮回复之后。2) factual提示显著降低谄媚失败率（所有模型下降24–57点），代价是7/8模型的V轴失败率显著上升（最高从5.5%升至41.8%），且新引入的V轴失败更严重（51%为3或4级），即"家长式陷阱"。3) optimal提示可在4个模型上将谄媚降低一半以上同时保持V轴失败率不高于基线。4) 与SycEval、SYCON、ELEPHANT等基准的对比实验显示，FIGS是首个能区分"合理修正"与"屈服"、区分"恰当共情"与"谄媚"的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: FIGS揭示了当前LLM在多轮对话中面临的核心张力：保持事实定力与提供恰当共情之间存在系统性权衡。简单的"冷漠无益"提示化指令（fact-grounded）虽能削弱谄媚，却诱发"家长式陷阱"——即冷漠的家长式态度；而针对双轴设计的提示可在大幅削弱谄媚的同时不付出共情代价。作者将FIGS作为冻结的留出评估集而非训练目标发布，以避免Goodhart效应。

title: Completion-Aware Cross-Fidelity Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Line Bus Holding
summary: Exploratory reinforcement learning (RL) on an operating bus fleet is impractical,while policies trained only from historical data cannot acquire new experience. Hybrid Offline-and-Online (H2O) RL combines fixed target replay with simulator interaction, but the inexpensive online simulator can differ from the target in transition and event-duration dynamics. We study this cross-fidelity problem for multi-line bus holding and address a failure mode in which lower generalized passenger time coexists with incomplete passenger journeys.

AI.tldr: 本文研究跨保真度离线到在线强化学习在多线公交驻站控制中的应用,针对H2O RL中廉价在线仿真器与目标仿真器之间在转移和事件持续时间动力学上的差异,提出一个完成度感知的驻站安全储备机制,在降低广义乘客时间的同时避免乘客旅程不完整。
AI.motivation: 在实际运营的公交车队上进行探索性强化学习不现实,而仅从历史数据训练的策略无法获取新经验。H2O(混合离线-在线)RL将固定目标回放与仿真器交互相结合,但廉价的在线仿真器在转移和事件持续时间动力学上可能与目标不同。作者研究多线公交驻站控制的跨保真度问题,并解决一种失败模式:较低的广义乘客时间与不完整的乘客旅程共存。
AI.method: 1) 将异步驻站问题建模为24,000秒的时序半马尔可夫决策过程(SMDP),采用精确的广义乘客时间核算和混合离散-连续动作。2) 使用SUMO生成的包含3,284,718个转移、240个回合、8种行为策略和30个环境单元的不可变离线数据集。3) 改进的H2O+框架:通过隐式Q学习(IQL)初始化,在线仿真器中继续训练25,000个决策事件。4) 完成度安全储备:在低负载尾部车辆且存在剩余需求的状态下,将物理驻站时间提升至60秒。5) 形式化确认:使用1,350个全新的SUMO回合(10个独立环境块、3个需求水平、5个训练种子、45种固定物理行为)进行精确符号检验。
AI.result: 在1,350个全新SUMO回合上,相对于直接父策略,完成度增强策略将每名离港乘客的广义乘客时间从2,484.86秒降至2,392.73秒(-92.12秒,-3.71%),将完成率从0.96185提升至0.96650(+0.00466),将未完成乘客从655.42人降至578.20人(-77.22人)。在所有10个独立块中,主终点和完成度非劣效性检验(0.003裕度)均通过;单侧精确符号检验p值均为0.0009766。在所有需求水平和训练种子上效应方向一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了一个固定的完成度感知储备相对于其直接父策略改善了广义乘客时间和完成率;跨10个独立环境块、3个需求水平和5个训练种子均方向一致。然而,确认的声明仅限于此固定候选策略与其固定直接父策略在仿真器到仿真器端点评估中的比较。未来工作应统一训练和评估运行时,收集更多独立环境单元,将完成度纳入学习目标,并对固定策略进行时间保留的操作记录验证。

title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Grammar-constrained generation guarantees syntactic validity, but can substantially degrade semantic quality when the model's preferred outputs are poorly aligned with the imposed grammar. This trade-off is particularly severe when the prompt is underspecified or the model has limited instruction-following ability. Beam search can partially mitigate these failures by exploring multiple valid sequences, but its computational cost grows with beam width, while sequence-level probability is only an imperfect proxy for semantic quality. We introduce GrammarRL, a label-free reinforcement learning method that adapts language models to grammar constraints without requiring annotated data. GrammarRL optimizes the model using two complementary self-supervised rewards derived from its own likelihoods: a direct reward, measuring how likely the constrained output is given the input, and a reverse reward, measuring how well the input can be reconstructed from the generated output. We optimize these rewards with a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) objective over groups of grammar-constrained rollouts, augmented with the top-1 beam-search hypothesis and regularized towards a frozen base model. We evaluate GrammarRL on sign language gloss translation, hierarchical text classification, and named entity recognition using Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. GrammarRL consistently outperforms constrained greedy decoding, with an average improvement of 9.8 points and gains of up to 22.8 BLEU. It matches or outperforms beam search on two of the three tasks while preserving greedy-decoding inference cost. Ablations further show that the two rewards are complementary: either reward alone can underperform the untrained baseline, whereas their combination consistently improves upon it.

AI.tldr: GrammarRL是一种无标注的强化学习方法，通过双向自监督奖励（直接奖励+反向奖励）和RLOO策略优化，使语言模型在语法约束解码下生成语义质量更高的输出，且推理时只需贪心解码。
AI.motivation: 语法约束解码虽保证形式正确性，但当模型偏好的输出与约束语法不一致时（尤其是提示信息不足或模型指令跟随能力有限时），会严重损害语义质量。现有推理时搜索方法（beam search、后验近似）计算成本高，而序列级概率并非语义质量的可靠代理。因此需要在无标注数据下，将序列级偏好提前学习到模型参数中。
AI.method: 1）策略生成N个语法约束采样候选+1个beam search top-1候选；2）冻结参考模型π_ref计算双向奖励：直接奖励R_direct衡量输出y在给定输入x下的似然，反向奖励R_reverse衡量从y重建x的似然（noisy-channel）；3）用RLOO（Leave-One-Out）计算优势函数A^(i)=r^(i)-其他候选均值；4）损失函数结合策略梯度项和KL正则化项（β=0.02），通过LoRA适配器训练策略；5）推理时仅使用语法约束贪心解码，无需额外搜索。
AI.result: 在三个结构化生成任务（手语gloss翻译、层次分类WoS、命名实体识别CoNLL）上，使用1B-8B的Llama模型，GrammarRL相比冻结基线平均提升9.8分（最高22.8 BLEU）；在两个任务上匹配或超越beam search；在Gloss和CoNLL上匹配或超越需要10倍生成长度的采样后验近似方法（importance sampling和SMC）。消融实验表明直接奖励和反向奖励互补：单一奖励可能低于基线，组合（λ=0.5）则在所有任务上一致优于基线。最佳λ因任务而异。
AI.conclusion: GrammarRL成功地将序列级偏好通过无标签强化学习"摊销"到模型参数中，使推理时仅需贪心解码即可获得高质量的语法约束输出。双向奖励设计有效解决了直接奖励导致的"无信息输出"和反向奖励导致的"结构陷阱token"两种退化模式。未来方向包括与后验近似方法结合（GrammarRL作为更好的proposal）、自适应λ、扩展到更丰富约束（如编程语言）。

title: OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software
comment: 62 pages. Website: this https URL Public contributions welcome: this https URL
summary: Scientific software presents a demanding test for computer-using agents based on visual language models (VLMs): completing a research workflow requires interpreting specialized interfaces, manipulating scientific objects, and producing verifiable results. We thus introduce OSWorld-Science, a benchmark and evaluation environment that combines scientifically meaningful tasks, artifact-based evaluation, and an efficient agent harness for studying computer use in the scientific domain. The benchmark contains 12 VLMs and 146 high-quality tasks across several scientific domains and software configurations, covering workflows such as molecular drawing and retrosynthesis, pathology image analysis, statistical computing, and physical simulation. Tasks are developed through expert proposals and iterative human--AI co-design, with selection guided by scientific value and difficulty. Task-specific execution-based evaluators inspect application states and generated artifacts, including molecular structures, segmentation masks, plots, and numerical results, and award partial credit for incomplete outcomes. Our special harness integrates model adapters, interaction-loop control, and trajectory logging to support comparisons of models and interaction strategies. Our results show that current state-of-the-art VLMs with a strong harness still face challenges in addressing key questions in the scientific domains. We also analyze the benchmarking results across multi-linguistics, reasoning efforts, context length and other factors and derive several important conclusions and directions to assist future development. Overall, we provide an integrated framework connecting expert-defined scientific goals to verifiable software outcomes, enabling systematic evaluation of both agent capabilities and harness design in scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: OSWorld-Science 是一个用于评估计算机使用代理（CUA）在科学研究软件上操作能力的基准测试。它包含146个跨七个科学领域的高质量任务，支持多语言，并提供基于工件（artifact-based）的评估方法和专门的代理框架（harness）。实验表明，即使是最先进的VLM驱动代理，在科学软件任务上也面临巨大挑战，最强模型在困难任务上的成功率仅约40%。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算机使用代理基准（如WebArena、OSWorld）主要关注通用桌面任务，而科学研究软件具有专业性强、界面复杂、需要生成可验证的科学工件等特点。现有评估未能充分捕捉科学家关注的科学价值、异构输出的统一评估、以及代理框架（harness）本身对性能的影响等关键问题。
AI.method: 1. 任务构建：与领域专家合作设计146个任务，覆盖化学、医学、生物学、物理学、地理信息、统计学、语言学和神经科学七大领域；采用"专家提案"和"人机协同设计"两种方式。2. 评估方法：基于执行的评估器检查环境状态和生成的工件（分子结构、分割掩码、图表、数值结果），支持部分得分。3. 代理框架：整合模型适配器、交互循环控制、轨迹日志，支持不同VLM和交互策略的比较。4. 任务形式化：将科学计算任务定义为目标条件化的POMDP，奖励函数在[0,1]范围内。5. 消融实验：在23个QuPath任务上研究了推理努力、历史窗口长度和任务语言三个因素的影响。
AI.result: 1. 整体性能：12个VLM中，Claude Fable 5.1表现最佳（73.7%，每任务$6.5），GPT-6 Astra次之（57.4%，每任务$7.7），最强模型在困难子集上成功率仅约40%。2. 失败分析：约74%的运行未能产出可评分的工件；大多数失败不是因为推理错误而是因交互层问题（坐标帧不匹配、动作未生效）或预算耗尽。3. 消融发现：增加推理努力对Opus 5有效（59.7% at max），但对Sonnet 5收益有限；历史窗口增至w=10时性能最优；不同语言对结果影响有限。4. 交互模式：统计任务中86.7%的操作通过终端完成，仅10个运行使用了SAS/RStudio；应用模式运行平均多花30步、得分低23.6%。5. 关键洞察：自我一致性验证不足以捕获错误（如化学任务的立体化学错误），需要独立于代理自身假设的验证。6. 各领域分析显示化学是最困难的领域（最强模型仅44%），EEG表现差异大，地理信息中4个模型因坐标帧不匹配完全失败。
AI.conclusion: 当前最先进的VLM驱动的计算机使用代理在操作专业科学软件方面仍面临重大挑战，尤其是在化学等需要精确操作和验证的领域。简单的策略如增加推理努力或扩展上下文窗口无法有效解决根本问题。研究应聚焦于开发专门的科学代理，包括改进代理框架、加强交互层可靠性（如坐标帧校准）、以及实现独立于代理自身假设的验证机制。未来的基准设计应确保任务真正需要目标应用程序，并加强可执行检查。

title: ConflictGuide: AutoResearch Improves When Competing Behaviors Are Made Visible
summary: When designing machine learning models, desirable properties are often in tension: improving one behavior can impair another, so task progress can depend on alleviating the conflict. LLM-based AutoResearch systems, which iteratively edit model code and retain edits based on scalar task-performance feedback, have largely ignored this trade-off. We find that scalar feedback supports broad exploration early in search, but it does not reveal how edits affect competing behaviors. In matched-budget experiments, introducing competing-behavior feedback as task gains diminish increases the share of proposals that improve both behaviors and sustains progress beyond scalar-only plateaus. Obtaining this feedback for a given model requires identifying its competing behaviors and designing probes to measure them. To make competing-behavior feedback actionable, we introduce ConflictGuide. Its reusable ConflictGuide-Skill combines a literature-grounded taxonomy with model-specific evidence to identify competing behaviors and specify probes for a code agent to implement as metrics. Evolution proceeds in two stages: Stage I explores with task feedback; Stage II uses probe feedback to steer proposals toward conflict alleviation and retains marginal-gain edits only when probes indicate sufficient alleviation. Across five diverse model families, ConflictGuide reduces task and conflict-related errors by up to 28% and 14%, respectively, relative to scalar-only AutoResearch, with gains extending to other code agents.

AI.tldr: ConflictGuide是一种两阶段AutoResearch框架，通过引入竞争行为反馈（而非仅依赖标量任务指标）来改进LLM驱动的模型自动演化。它识别模型特定的设计冲突，并通过定制探针衡量相互竞争的行为，在标量反馈探索后引导提案朝冲突缓解方向发展。
AI.motivation: AutoResearch系统依赖标量任务性能反馈进行迭代代码编辑，但标量反馈无法揭示代码编辑如何影响相互竞争的行为（改进一个行为可能损害另一个）。在任务增益趋于平缓时，这种盲区限制了进一步进展。需要一种方法来揭示编辑对竞争行为的差异化影响，从而实现持续的改进。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) ConflictGuide-Skill，基于文献根-轴-机制分类法（9个根、6个轴、110个机制）识别模型特定冲突，并设计可量化的探针来衡量竞争行为；(2) 两阶段演化流程：Stage I使用标量任务反馈进行广泛探索；Stage II引入探针反馈引导提案朝冲突缓解方向，并通过辅助保留路径（边际任务增益+探针证明足够缓解）来过滤编辑。探针需经过资格验证，使用固定的评估数据和预校准阈值。
AI.result: 在5个模型系列（SpecB-FNO、SNGP、GCNII、ESN、TCM-Lite）上，ConflictGuide相比标量AutoResearch将任务错误降低最多28%、冲突相关错误降低最多14%。联合改进的提案比例从7.2%提升至13.1%，联合退化从29.0%降至20.7%。从共同分支点出发，ConflictGuide在标量方法趋于平缓后仍能继续改进。该方法在Kimi K2.7 Code和AIDE框架下也能泛化。Stage I预算100次迭代、Stage II 100次迭代为最佳平衡点。
AI.conclusion: ConflictGuide通过使竞争行为对AutoResearch智能体可见来提升模型演化效果。它能识别模型特定的设计冲突、量化竞争行为、并在标量增益趋于平缓后通过探针引导的提案和保留机制实现持续改进。该方法适用于多种架构和代码智能体，但依赖于足够的模型特定证据来识别冲突并设计有效探针。未来工作包括自适应探针反馈时机、多冲突交互分析以及系统性的适用性评估。

title: Coverage Before Control: Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering for Controllable Retrosynthesis
summary: Single-step retrosynthesis models are commonly evaluated by their ability to recover recorded reactions. In practice, chemists may need to choose among several precursor sets for the same product, for example to preserve a particular motif. Recovering a recorded answer alone does not establish this ability to follow a preference. Satisfying such requests requires both coverage of relevant alternatives and control over which alternatives are favored. We introduce Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering (RIGS), a two-stage framework for instruction-conditioned retrosynthesis. Stage A trains a language projector, teaching it which alternatives an instruction favors or discourages. Stage B uses the projector learned in Stage A to steer a frozen generative model through lightweight residual adapters. We construct nested one-to-many training supports by pairing each product with increasing numbers of candidate precursor sets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that broader support helps the model generate a wider range of alternatives, and RIGS can learn to guide generation according to instructions. The relationship between coverage and control is consistent across model scales but non-monotone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIGS（Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering），一个面向指令条件单步逆合成反应预测的两阶段框架。Stage A训练语言投影器，将自然语言指令与产物局部候选前体集偏好对齐；Stage B通过轻量级残差适配器将学习到的指令表示转移到冻结的GraphDiT生成器中。核心原则是"先覆盖后控制"（coverage before control），即候选覆盖是实现指令响应式生成的前提。
AI.motivation: 现有单步逆合成模型通常以"是否恢复记录反应"来评估，但实际化学家需要在多个合理前体集中根据偏好（如保留特定基序）进行选择。仅恢复记录答案无法衡量模型是否真正具备指令跟随能力。真实场景需要同时具备"候选覆盖"和"指令控制"两个能力，但目前对二者关系缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 1) 构造嵌套式一对多训练支持：对每个产物，通过DESP模板库和启发式评分生成Top K（K=15/30/45/60）候选前体集。2) Stage A（生成器无关的语义接地）：冻结Qwen3-Embedding-8B编码指令，冻结反应对编码器编码候选，由KL损失和成对损失训练一个轻量投影器P_φ，将指令映射到反应表示空间。3) Stage B（残差指令引导）：将投影器初始化为Stage A结果，通过节点-文本交叉注意力适配器在选定GraphDiT层注入指令残差，更新公式为 h_{l+1} = B_l(h_l + α·A_{l,θ}(h_l, M_c^{(l)}))。训练目标包含四项：正流匹配损失L_pos、排序损失L_rank、回放参考KL损失L_roll和参考保护KL损失L_guard。4) 推理时重用基础CTMC采样器，按采样频率对去重后的有效前体进行排序。
AI.result: 在USPTO-MR和合成模板扩展Top15/30/45/60上评估8M和65M GraphDiT：1) 候选覆盖：从USPTO-MR的2,348（8M）和1,723（65M）提升至Top30的16,922和20,075，但Top45到Top60呈非单调变化。2) 指令控制：65M Top30的Matched-Shuffled P@1提升+18.52 pp，N@10降低27.19 pp，效果在Top30/Top45最佳，Top60几乎无提升。3) Stage A接地的作用：在8M Top30测试中，Stage A使N@10的Matched-Shuffled降低6.82 pp，主要抑制与指令冲突的候选。4) 跨数据集和指令套件验证：在Pistachio、Structure（自由形式结构指令）和Metric4（合成相关属性）上均证实了控制能力，65M Top30在Structure上P@1提升+8.09 pp，N@10降低18.44 pp。5) 多步规划案例：将RIGS作为单步生成器集成到价值引导的AND-OR树搜索中，可引导整条合成路线选择无卤前体。
AI.conclusion: RIGS成功实现了指令条件的单步逆合成生成，将语言指令接地到产物局部候选偏好，并通过残差适配器转移到冻结生成器。系统研究表明"覆盖"与"控制"在两个模型规模下呈一致但非单调的关系：合成支持扩展提高了候选恢复率，但继续扩展至Top60反而使指令控制增益下降甚至为负。Stage A语义接地主要贡献于抑制与指令冲突的候选，而非促进首选候选的恢复。控制与覆盖在跨数据集（Pistachio）、跨指令类型（Structure、Metric4）和多步规划中均得到验证。当前局限在于评估聚焦单步，多步规划尚未系统评估，未来工作将集成到LLM引导的规划中并改进输出有效性。

title: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
summary: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better documents or changes in grading. In shared-session text-only grading with template markers removed, five judges score the complete system 20.4 to 33.6 points out of 95 above the same model generating directly from a short prompt. Every judge scores the system higher on all seventeen development deliverables. Margins against direct Opus generation from a short prompt range from -4.7 to +0.8 points. Judges agree on broad progress across development rounds but agree less on final-deck rankings than on pooled scores. Repeated grading also shifts scores on unchanged decks, making small improvements difficult to distinguish from judge variability.

AI.tldr: 该研究对一套用于企业及投资银行（CIB）演示文稿生成的智能体系统进行回顾性评估，比较该系统与无框架直接生成的效果，并量化LLM评分者的可靠性。结果显示，完整系统在17个交付物上一致优于27B模型的直接生成（文本评估提升20.4-33.6分），但与直接Opus生成的差距很小（-4.7至+0.8分）；同时LLM评分者具有显著的随机性，对未改动文档的重复评分也会产生变动，使得小幅改进难以与评分波动区分。
AI.motivation: 在CIB演示文稿生成系统的迭代开发中，使用LLM评分者引导提示、模板和代码的修改，并据此判断改进是否有效。但LLM评分本身存在位置、冗长度、自我偏好等偏差，且对长文档的评分可靠性很少以评分点为单位报告。因此需要量化：(1)同一评分者重复评分的不一致性；(2)评估系统相对直接生成的真实提升；(3)评分者间在进展判断与最终排序上的一致性。
AI.method: 研究对象为基于Qwen3.8-27B模型构建的混合生成框架，包含财务计算引擎、剧本（playbook）、已编译叙述条款与输出验证检查。17个交付物（覆盖范围、信用、融资、并购四类）经过8轮开发迭代。使用rubric引导评分，5-8名来自6个模型家族的评分者（Opus、Sonnet、Haiku、DeepSeek、GLM、GPT-6 Luna Pro、Gemini、Qwen）评估完整系统、27B短/强提示直接生成、Opus短/强提示直接生成。对其中一轮进行了清洗文本的仅文本评分（移除模板标记）。采用ICC、Cohen's κ、Spearman相关、最小可检测变化（MDC₉₅）、Wilcoxon符号秩检验、Bootstrap置信区间、双向方差分解等统计方法分析评分一致性、进展及系统优势。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) 评分可靠性有限——同一Opus两次评分在轮次7和8的ICC为0.77-0.78（区间低至0.31-0.44），合并后单文档噪声尺度为7.9-8.4分；(2) 系统优势显著——在清洗文本评分中，所有5位评分者均给完整系统评分高于27B直接生成20.4-33.6分（满分95分），且全部17个交付物均如此；但与Opus直接生成的差距仅为-4.7至+0.8分；(3) 评分者间一致——所有评分者均看到轮次1到轮次7的改进（5.6至13.9分）；但对最终文档排序的一致性低于对汇总分数的一致性（轮次7中位数成对Spearman=0.30）；(4) 评分变动的偏移集中于评分会话，单一会话承担了大部分重复评分变动；(5) 一致性与审计性维度贡献了相对权重最大的内容差距（19%-32%）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究得出三点主要结论：(1) 完整智能体框架在开发案例上一致优于27B模型的直接生成，但在清洗文本评分中与Opus直接生成几乎持平；(2) 评分者对开发进展的广泛认同一致，但对最终文档的排序认同度较低；(3) 更换评分者或会话可使未变动的文档得分发生变化，因此小幅度改进难以与评分随机性区分。实践建议包括固定评分配置、重复评分以估计变异性、在阈值附近关注连续分数而非二元裁决、以及在涉及呈现差异时增加仅文本评分。

title: AIMS: An Agentic AI Framework for Sim-to-Real Multi-Modal ISAC
summary: Multi-modal integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables environmental perception and reliable connectivity for intelligent wireless networks. Data-driven multi-modal ISAC models depend heavily on annotated real-world data to learn relationships across sensing and wireless observations, thereby constraining scalable deployment. Although synthetic data generation reduces the burden, adapting existing simulation pipelines to a target deployment requires consistent scene, sensing, wireless, and learning configurations, while mismatches among these coupled components impair sim-to-real transferability. To address the challenge, we propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for sim-to-real multi-modal ISAC, named AIMS. Given a natural-language deployment request specifying the target task, deployment conditions, and real-data budget, AIMS derives a deployment-specific sim-to-real configuration and coordinates its execution to produce a deployment-specific task model. A two-agent architecture coordinates scene construction with task learning. A scene construction agent generates geographically grounded, synchronized sensing and wireless records from shared physical states, while a scene understanding agent configures task-relevant modalities and mixture-of-experts (MoE) learning for zero-shot inference or few-shot adaptation. Structured domain knowledge guides dependency-aware planning, while validation evidence supports feedback-driven revision of affected decisions. Experiments on the real-world DeepSense~6G dataset demonstrate improved vehicle detection and beam prediction over the considered simulation and fusion baselines. A separate orchestration benchmark evaluates task interpretation, dependency reasoning, and feedback-driven replanning across diverse deployment requests, showing improved plan correctness with structured domain knowledge and validation feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIMS，一个面向sim-to-real多模态ISAC的智能体AI框架，通过双智能体架构（场景构建智能体+场景理解智能体）将自然语言部署请求转化为部署特定的sim-to-real配置，并在DeepSense 6G真实数据集上验证了车辆检测与波束预测性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态ISAC数据驱动模型依赖大量标注真实数据，限制了可扩展部署。虽然合成数据可减轻负担，但将现有仿真流水线适配到目标部署需要协调场景、感知、无线和学习配置，组件间不匹配会损害sim-to-real可迁移性。核心挑战在于如何从高层自然语言部署请求推导出一致的sim-to-real配置，并处理组件间的耦合依赖关系。
AI.method: 采用基于LLM的双智能体架构：(1) 场景构建智能体——经"地理接地→动态激活→无线投影"三阶段，从共享物理状态生成同步的感知与无线数据；(2) 场景理解智能体——配置任务相关模态与MoE学习，支持零样本推理或少样本适配。结构化领域知识（任务/能力/依赖）指导依赖感知规划，验证证据支持反馈驱动的修订。以Qwen3-14B为LLM骨干，在共享实验状态上进行规划与反思循环。
AI.result: 在DeepSense 6G数据集上：(1) 波束预测——AIMS零样本模型在Scenario 3和4上均优于5个基线，Top-3较最强融合基线提升约7-16个百分点；20样本少样本适配进一步提升性能；(2) 车辆检测——AIMS在Scenario 3和9上的AP较最强融合基线提升约6-13个百分点；(3) 智能体编排基准（140个请求）——AIMS在正常/挑战层级的Plan-TSR分别为100%和88.6%，显著优于Direct LLM和Tool-only AIMS，结构化领域知识将Dependency-F1从87.0%提升至100%。
AI.conclusion: AIMS通过智能体AI框架有效解决了sim-to-real多模态ISAC的部署特定配置挑战，结构化领域知识与验证反馈显著提升了规划正确性与依赖处理能力。未来工作可探索性能驱动的闭环优化，将下游感知与通信性能作为反馈进一步指导配置与适配决策。

title: What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures. The authors contributed equally
summary: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis around the replaced decision, executed conditions, measurement comparability, controls, and remaining explanations. Results. Of 222 studies reporting local decision metrics, 142 also report measured task endpoints and 49 report proxies. These counts identify studies that report both types of measurement, without establishing that the measurements come from matched comparisons. Outcome Monitors reports a package-level completion gain whose attribution to detector quality remains limited; First-chunk selection reports a local improvement assessed against an offline proxy endpoint; Evidence-Carrying Termination reports fewer premature unsupported terminations and completion non-inferiority, without establishing completion superiority. Cross-case analysis identifies three candidate mechanisms involving recovery and disruption, intervention timing, and downstream use. Attribution and deployment depend on the comparison controls, label definitions, and information available to the controller. Conclusions. The review distinguishes the task-level benefit of a component replacement from the contribution of local decision quality and derives eight claim-specific reporting items. Neither online execution nor simultaneous gains in local and task metrics alone establish that better local decisions explain the task-level gain.

AI.tldr: 本文是一项关于语言模型智能体中"组件替换"评估的系统性范围综述，区分了组件替换的"任务级收益"与"局部决策质量贡献"，指出仅靠在线执行或局部与任务指标的同步改善不足以证明更好的局部决策解释了任务级收益。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体中替换某个组件会改变后续轨迹、观测和恢复机会，但现有评估常混淆局部决策质量提升与任务级收益，需要厘清两者区别并规范评估报告标准。
AI.method: 对348项研究进行范围综述（scoping review），审查90条比较记录（来自40项纳入研究），通过8个有目的选取的案例进行跨案例综合分析，围绕替换的决策、执行条件、测量可比性、对照设置和剩余解释展开。
AI.result: 222项报告局部决策指标的研究中，142项同时报告任务端点指标，49项报告代理指标；三个案例分别因对照局限、离线代理指标、未建立完成优越性而无法充分归因；跨案例分析识别出恢复与中断、干预时机、下游使用三类候选机制。
AI.conclusion: 综述明确区分了组件替换的任务级收益与局部决策质量的贡献，衍生出8项声明特异性报告条目；在线执行或局部与任务指标的同步改善本身不足以证明更好的局部决策能够解释任务级收益。

title: Who Verifies the Graph? Misspecification Attacks on Causal Action Verification for Language Agents
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents?"
summary: Causal action verifiers gate an agent's state-changing tool calls by checking whether each proposed intervention is identifiable against a committed action-state graph, and they issue a certificate that carries the identification argument and a one-sided lower confidence bound. One such verifier, CIVeX, reports zero false executions on a confounded tool-use benchmark. We red-team it by corrupting only the committed graph. Omitting a single bidirected edge takes it from zero false executions to 15.3% at the benchmark's published confounding strength, with 91% of its executions harmful and utility falling from +2.27 to +0.35. Reversing one arrowhead, so that a mediator is committed as a confounder, gives 48.9% false executions and no correct ones. Every one of these actions carries an internally valid certificate. An attestation step that tests each observationally certified execution against a bounded randomised sample detected both attacks, with 2 false alarms in 555 executions on a truthful graph; refusing what fails the test, or cannot be tested, gave zero false executions in every setting we measured. It does not restore beneficial execution: at the published strength 97.1% of beneficial actions are still never executed, because the same misspecification rejects them before attestation runs. Those rejections carry certificates too, and auditing them works, but its cost scales with the number of rejections rather than the number of executions. Recovering safety costs 127 experiments per 1,050 actions; recovering the lost value costs 614 more, at which point the audited verifier makes the honest graph's decisions on every instance and spends exactly its experiment budget. An audit that inspects only executions protects against wrongful action. Wrongful inaction has to be paid for separately.

AI.tldr: 本文对因果动作验证器 CIVeX 进行了红队测试，发现仅通过篡改其所依赖的"可信"动作-状态图（而非代码或证书格式），就能让原本零虚假执行的验证器完全失效。论文提出三种图错误（省略双向边、误把碰撞因子当混杂、颠倒中介变量方向），并提出了一种基于有界随机实验的"证明"防御机制，系统量化了恢复安全性与恢复效用之间的成本不对称性。
AI.motivation: CIVeX 等因果动作验证器通过检查提议干预相对于提交图的可识别性来把关状态变更工具调用，其证书内含识别论证和单侧置信下界。然而此类验证器的安全性完全依赖于一个它无法检查的输入——提交图（由领域专家提供并存储在注册表中）。图注入、调整集污染和版本漂移是 CIVeX 原始论文承认的开放问题，但从未被量化：失败有多快、失败长什么样、防御成本是多少。本文正是为回答这三个问题。
AI.method:
方法：保留 CIVeX 的分诊程序、证书检查器和对抗性 Causal-ToolBench 生成器不变，仅改变提交图这一唯一输入。

1. **基准设置**：每个实例是结构因果模型采样的工具工作流，1,050 个动作/单元；动作 T（提议行动）、效用 Y、两个观测协变量、一个对抗性隐混杂 U（强度参数 s 可调）；观测样本 500 行，随机化样本 500 行。

2. **验证器决策逻辑**：在提交图上搜索后门调整集，存在则用 OLS 估计并计算 95% 单侧下界，EXECUTE（≥0）或 REJECT；不存在则走 EXPERIMENT 或 ABSTAIN。

3. **三种攻击**：
   - 省略双向 T↔Y 边（denied 图）：让后门调整集变得不充分
   - 误把碰撞因子 C 提交为混杂因子
   - 颠倒中介变量方向（把 T→M 改成 M→T）

4. **防御**：在观测识别的 EXECUTE 上增加"证明"步骤——用 500 行随机化样本计算均值差及其 95% 区间，与证书区间对比；不相交则宣布图被证伪。两种响应：refuse（放弃）或 fallback（在随机化样本上重新决策）。

5. **拒绝审计**：对 REJECT 也进行相同的证明与 fallback，成本与拒绝数量成正比。
AI.result:
三种攻击结果：

1. **省略双向边**：在 s=2.5（发布强度）下，虚假执行率从 0% 跃升至 15.3%（种子范围 13.3–17.3%），91% 的执行有害，效用从 +2.27 跌至 +0.35。强度 ≥3.0 时所有执行都有害，效用为负（-1.36 至 -1.85），远低于永弃底线 +0.98。

2. **碰撞因子作混杂**：在无隐混杂的真实图下，正确执行从 52.9% 降至 7.9%，效用从 +2.79 降至 +1.39，但虚假执行仍为零——失败模式为瘫痪而非错误执行。

3. **中介方向颠倒**：完全反转——虚假执行 48.9%，正确执行 0%，效用 -1.36，100% 的有益动作丢失。

**防御效果**：
- 对省略边攻击：证明在 s≥2.0 时检出了所有有害执行；refuse 使虚假执行归零（1,050 动作的 95% 置信上界约 0.29%）。
- 在真实图上：仅 2/555 误报（0.4%），效用损失极小（+2.79→+2.76）。
- 但证明只在观测 EXECUTE 上触发，不能恢复有益动作：在发布强度下，refuse 仍丢失 100% 有益动作，fallback 仍丢失 97.1%。

**关键发现：成本不对称**
- 恢复安全性：127 次实验/1,050 动作
- 恢复效用：还需额外 614 次实验（约 4.8 倍）
- 完全审计所有拒绝 → 精确复现诚实图的决策并花费相同的 741 次实验
- 机制：被错误拒绝的 555 个有益动作中有 539 个在第一次分诊即被拒绝，证明从未检查它们；其证书与 EXECUTE 一样携带完整识别论证、估计和区间。

补充发现：fallback 若复用提交图的调整集，会在方向翻转攻击下重现错误（48.9% 虚假执行）；只有采用"图无关"的均值差策略才能归零。
AI.conclusion:
**核心结论**：因果动作验证器对其无法检查的提交图进行认证——一处省略的边或一个颠倒的箭头即可使所有认证执行全部错误，而证书在内部依然有效。基于有界实验的证明+拒绝/不可测时拒绝的方案，在生成的所有攻击下都达到了零虚假执行，但代价与执行数量成正比，并未恢复被同一错误拒绝的有益动作。这些动作可以通过审计拒绝来恢复，但账单与拒绝数量成正比；完全恢复成本恰好等于诚实图原本的开支。

**面向代理验证研究的三点建议**：
1. 将提交图视为具有独立完整性要求的攻击面；
2. 应同时报告错误行动与错误不作为；
3. 应分别为两者预算审计成本。

**对部署的警示**：仅监测虚假执行的部署会看到一个记录干净的验证器，却在悄悄不作为；错误不作为不会留下可观察的后果，因此必须主动付费去重新审视那些大多本就正确的拒绝决策。

**论文自我边界**：基准是合成的；攻击直接编辑图而非模拟有能力的攻击者；证明假设有界随机化样本存在且廉价（不可逆动作失败）；拒绝审计是均匀采样，未测试针对性策略。

title: PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems
summary: Particle transport under multiple scattering is central to radiative transfer and plasma physics, yet high-fidelity Monte Carlo (MC) simulations must trace prohibitively many particles. Learning-based surrogates can amortize this cost, but typically train on expensive, well-converged MC solutions. We propose the Particle Transport Neural Operator (PTNO), a neural operator that learns particle transport surrogates directly from noisy, low-cost MC labels. Such labels pose two challenges: (1) high variance, which destabilizes standard supervised learning, and (2) a high dynamic range (HDR) spanning many orders of magnitude. For the first, we learn the solution operator from noisy labels of many configurations, amortizing MC cost and generalizing to unseen configurations. Because MC labels are unbiased, we show that the squared loss on them shares its minimizer with the loss on converged solutions, and our budget-allocation study over training scenes $M$, MC samples per render $N$, and independent renders per scene $K$ shows that many noisy scenes beat fewer converged ones. For the second, a nonlinear transform such as the logarithm biases noisy supervision. Instead, PTNO keeps labels in physical space and enforces positivity with a softplus output layer that represents small values effectively. We further train with a pointwise relative $L_2$ loss (PRelL2), the stop-gradient relative loss of HDR denoising and neural rendering, which normalizes each residual by the stop-gradient prediction instead of the noisy label. We demonstrate PTNO on neutron transport in fusion reactors and radiative transfer in participating media. On the two neutronics tasks, PTNO is $10^4$-$10^5\times$ faster than converged MC on the same CPU and $10^3$-$10^5\times$ cheaper than MC at matched accuracy; on the two radiative-transfer tasks, MC at matched accuracy costs $0.8$-$11\times$ as much as PTNO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PTNO（粒子传输神经算子），首次将神经算子直接训练于高方差、未收敛的蒙特卡洛标签，用于学习辐射传输与中子传输的替代模型。核心创新在于：(1) 理论证明无偏MC标签与平方损失下，噪声标签与收敛解共享同一总体最小化解；(2) 提出软plus输出层保留正性与高动态范围表征；(3) 采用点相对L2损失(PRelL2)，以stop-gradient预测作分母避免对噪声标签的非线性变换，从而消除Jensen偏差。在四个数据集(远场辐射、3D通量、球形托卡马克、EU-DEMO反应堆)上验证了方法，相较收敛MC在CPU上提速10^4-10^5倍，匹配精度下MC成本为代理模型的0.8-11倍(辐射传输)或10^3-10^5倍(中子传输)。
AI.motivation: 粒子传输问题在辐射传输与聚变反应堆设计中至关重要，但高精度蒙特卡洛模拟需追踪海量粒子，成本高昂。现有学习替代模型通常依赖昂贵的已收敛MC标签，且面临两大挑战：(1) 高方差标签使标准监督学习不稳定；(2) 解跨越多个数量级(HDR)，常用对数变换对噪声标签引入Jensen偏差。如何直接从低成本的噪声MC标签学习算子成为核心难题。
AI.method: 方法包括三个核心设计：(1) 理论证明对无偏估计，平方损失下噪声标签与收敛解的总体最小化解相同(因噪声项均值为零且与模型无关)；(2) 采用软plus输出层B_θ=softplus(G_θ)保证预测正性，无需变换噪声标签；(3) 提出点相对L2损失(PRelL2)，以stop-gradient的预测作分母S(x)=max(sg(x),η)，残差保持在线性物理空间，避免Jensen偏差；同时进行梯度分析，证明该组合仅在B_θ=U处有输出空间不动点。预算分配研究表明，固定粒子预算下，覆盖更多噪声场景优于少数已收敛场景。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，PTNO+PRelL2均显著优于基线：远场辐射log10 SSIM达0.917(对比log MSE的0.470)，3D通量达0.952，球形托卡马克达0.863，EU-DERM达0.792。中子传输任务上PTNO比收敛MC在CPU上快10^4-10^5倍，比匹配精度MC便宜10^3-10^5倍；辐射传输任务上MC匹配精度成本为PTNO的0.8-11倍。消融实验表明预测归一化分母(PRelL2)是稳定关键，软plus头提供额外增益；显式Jensen去偏策略无法完全弥合性能差距。
AI.conclusion: PTNO成功证明可直接从高方差蒙特卡洛标签训练神经算子替代模型，避免昂贵收敛标签的生成。通过理论分析与实证展示了无偏MC标签的有效性、软plus输出层与预测归一化PRelL2损失的稳定性、以及大量噪声场景优于少数收敛场景的预算分配原则。该方法在辐射传输与中子传输领域均实现显著加速(中子传输10^3-10^5倍)，为聚变反应堆设计与多物理场耦合优化提供了实用的代理模型。局限性包括：假设线性物理空间无偏MC估计器、依赖算子容量、分布外泛化未验证。

title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
summary: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Agent Error Dataset（AED），包含50,228条跨33个环境、19种智能体框架和23个策略模型的错误-诊断对，并设计五阶段AET流水线将失败经验转化为诊断SFT和执行器恢复训练数据。配对回放实验显示首次提议修正将验证通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7 pp）；全诊断SFT在1,656个任务上训练后，Qwen3-8B在内部精确步骤一致率上从47.2%提升至63.6%，超越最强提示基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体后训练仅使用结果奖励，未指定应修订哪个决策以及应替换为什么动作。失败回滚中保留了可观察信息，但缺乏将这些失败经验转化为可学习诊断与修正监督的系统方法，亟需跨执行设置的失败诊断数据集与训练范式。
AI.method: 1) 五阶段AET流水线（Collect→Diagnose→Ground→Replay→Build Views）收集自然失败、生成诊断与提议修正、基于执行证据校验、对照原始动作进行配对回放；2) 构建诊断SFT、执行器恢复SFT和动作偏好三种训练视图；3) 在Qwen3-8B上进行全诊断监督微调，评估精确步骤一致率与公共基准迁移性；4) 比较成功监督、预防性修复、错误后动作监督与反思性修复四种执行器训练方案。
AI.result: 配对回放3062对中，首次提议将验证通过率从18.4%提升至51.1%（+32.7 pp，95% CI [28.4, 37.0]）；全诊断SFT在1656任务上三种子平均将内部精确步骤一致率从47.2%提升至63.6%，优于最强提示基线Claude Opus 5的54.7%；动作修复训练在WebShop-lite上比仅成功训练高6.67 pp，但在TextQuest上低约9 pp；公共基准迁移效果依赖协议，部分条件下出现显著负迁移。
AI.conclusion: AED通过结构化记录自然失败、诊断与配对回放证据，证实提议修正显著优于原始动作重试，且诊断监督可显著提升内部故障定位一致率；但公共基准迁移受提示协议影响呈现环境依赖性，执行器修复训练的收益因环境而异。内部定位改进明确，跨基准广泛迁移仍是未解问题。

title: Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training. Project page: this https URL
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach for improving reasoning during post-training. Recent work suggests that some difficult prompts remain resistant to learning even when they occasionally produce correct solutions. We revisit this unlearnability phenomenon and find that the affected prompts do improve, at roughly one third of the learnable rate, while the difficulty-defined set used to study them is much less reproducible than expected. These difficulty labels are estimated from a limited number of sampled responses. Combining them across seeds can further change which prompts are selected instead of simply reducing measurement noise. We develop a sampling-based framework for quantifying this instability and determining how much evaluation is required for difficulty assignments to reproduce reliably. We also revisit the gradient-similarity evidence proposed to explain unlearnability and show that part of the observed separation arises because difficult prompts provide fewer correct rollouts from which their gradients can be estimated. Matching this sample count weakens the gradient difference but does not remove it. Overall, the slow-learning phenomenon survives our reanalysis, while both the prompts used to define it and the evidence used to explain it require more careful measurement.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）中所谓的"不可学习"现象。作者发现这些被标记的困难提示确实在学习，只是学习速率约为可学习组的三分之一。同时指出，用于定义"不可学习"提示集的难度标签极不可靠，集合大小会因聚合规则不同从74变化到228；梯度相似度证据也因样本量不匹配而被显著削弱。论文提出了基于二项分布的采样预算框架，可预测难度标签的可重复性。
AI.motivation: Chen等人(2026)报告了RLVR中存在"不可学习"提示（即偶尔产生正确答案但训练中几乎不改进），并将其与组内较低的梯度相似度联系起来。这一结论依赖于通过对有限采样的成功率进行阈值化来识别困难提示。然而，作者质疑：这些标签本身是否可靠？如果集合定义不稳定，那么基于该集合的机制性解释是否仍然成立？该研究旨在从测量可靠性角度重新审视这一现象。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5-0.5B模型在1023条MATH提示上以GRPO训练五个独立种子，沿用原始的"易学/可学/不可学"分组与阈值τ=0.1。主要测量包括：(1) 训练奖励斜率以表征学习速度；(2) 在相同检查点上改变采样响应来分离评估噪声与训练种子变异；(3) 基于二项分布与Kiefer-Wolfowitz非参数MLE估计潜在通过率分布，建立预测Jaccard一致性的采样预算模型；(4) 匹配正确rollout数量后重算组内梯度余弦相似度比值。预先冻结两个未测量预算(N=40, N=64)的预测再生成对应评估进行前瞻验证。
AI.result: (1) "不可学习"组的奖励斜率为+0.0422/100步（95% CI [+0.0259, +0.0590]），可学习组为+0.1119，易学组为+0.3800——确实更慢，但非零，约为可学习速率的三分之一。(2) 固定292个候选提示，原始五种子构造返回74条，另一种聚合返回228条；N=32时同模型重采样Jaccard=0.798，可重现约81%的跨种子分歧。(3) 采样预算模型预测：8次rollout仅0.63一致性，达0.90需约242次；前瞻冻结的N=40预测[0.770,0.853]与实测0.845一致，N=64预测[0.798,0.879]与实测0.874一致。(4) 匹配样本量后，易学/不可学梯度相似度比从2.327倍降至1.539倍（CI [1.26, 1.88]），削弱但未消除。(5) 简单"曝光饥饿"假设不成立：D_u组平均仍有2.14次贡献步骤，22.4%的提示接收了不低于可学组的曝光仍改进缓慢。
AI.conclusion: RLVR中的"不可学习"现象经重新分析应理解为持续的缓慢学习效应，而非字面意义上的无法学习。但用于定义该效应的提示集合高度依赖聚合规则与采样预算，远比效应本身不稳定；解释该效应的梯度相似度证据在匹配样本量后被大幅削弱但未消除。当前低预算的难度标签不足以支撑将个别提示归类为"不可学习"或建立机制性主张；应将难度分配视为一个明确的采样预算问题，通过预测的Jaccard一致性来选择预算，而非依赖启发式的多种子聚合。论文的核心贡献不在于否定该现象，而在于指出测量选择对结论的关键影响。

title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution
summary: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restrict exploration and make adaptation reactive. Inspired by how human experts learn from the research literature for new solutions, we introduce ScholarEvolve, a framework that automatically draws on state-of-the-art research to guide harness evolution. ScholarEvolve organizes the harness evolution directions into functional modules and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for each module. It implements these strategies and evaluates their combinations to improve task performance. Moreover, the framework is designed to incorporate new publications over time, allowing research advances to drive proactive lifelong evolution. Experiments demonstrate improvements on AppWorld and Tau2-Bench. ScholarEvolve raises Qwen3.5-27B task goal completion from 49.6% to 63.6% on AppWorld Challenge, and raises GPT-5.4-mini pass@1 from 72.7% to 81.9% on Tau2-Bench Telecom.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScholarEvolve 框架，通过自动从最新研究文献中提取机制来驱动智能体执行框架（agent harness）的演化，在固定基础模型的情况下显著提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于元编码智能体修改执行框架的方法受限于智能体自身知识和已观察到的失败，存在探索范围窄、设计知识有限、适应滞后三大问题。作者借鉴人类研究者通过阅读文献寻找新方案的思路，让框架主动从学术文献中获取改进方向。
AI.method: 将智能体执行框架分解为五个功能模块（工具接口、上下文管理、技能、记忆、智能体工作流），通过失败审计、能力抽象生成检索查询，从 arXiv 检索论文并构建研究池；使用基于 TopicGPT 的主题建模将论文按机制正交分组；以轮询方式分配候选预算，实现研究引导的模块突变；采用类遗传算法进行模块交叉和选择，使用配对自助置信区间保留冠军；通过周期性文献更新实现终身演化。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 和 τ²-Bench 上显著优于初始框架和 Meta Harness 基线：Qwen3.5-27B 在 AppWorld Challenge 上 TGC 从 49.6% 提升至 63.6%（+14.0），GPT-5.4-mini 在 τ²-Bench Telecom 上 pass@1 从 72.7% 提升至 81.9%（+9.2）；终身演化三轮文献更新后持续改进（TGC 达 81.55%）；消融实验证实主题引导、模块化突变和研究引导三个组件均贡献正向收益；模块组合效果优于单一最强组件（如 Qwen 组合比最强单独模块 TGC 高 3.5 点）。
AI.conclusion: ScholarEvolve 通过从研究文献中主动学习机制，结合模块化分解与遗传式搜索，实现了智能体执行框架的终身主动演化，为固定骨干模型的能力提升提供了有效路径，并可泛化到训练时未见的应用场景。

title: Belief-Aware Multi-Agent Path Finding under Map Uncertainty
summary: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) aims to find collision-free paths for multiple agents in a shared environment. Classical MAPF assumes that all static obstacles are known in advance, but real-world environments can change unexpectedly due to fallen objects, spills, or other local disturbances. When such changes are spatially correlated, an observation can inform traversability estimates beyond the observed location. Prior approaches address uncertainty in traversability through contingent plans or replanning based on direct observations, but do not leverage this spatial dependence to infer the traversability of nearby unobserved locations. As a result, they cannot use one observation to anticipate nearby unobserved obstacles that may cause costly rerouting later. We focus on Belief-Aware MAPF, where map discrepancies are fixed during execution but initially unknown, and observations can be informative beyond the observed location. We propose Multi-Agent Gaussian belief Inference for Coordination (MAGIC), a framework that updates a shared belief about traversability online based on agents' observations. MAGIC uses a Gaussian Markov Random Field and Gaussian Belief Propagation to approximately infer traversability and construct detour-aware costs for standard MAPF planners. Our experiments on MAPF benchmarks show that MAGIC reduces the executed sum of costs compared to existing approaches on 96.3% of instances, across several planner families and teams of up to 800 agents, demonstrating its applicability to large-scale MAPF problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Belief-Aware MAPF 问题及 MAGIC 框架，通过高斯马尔可夫随机场与高斯置信传播将观测信息扩展到未观测位置，构造绕行感知代价，在标准 MAPF 基准上对多达 800 个智能体降低 96.3% 实例的执行代价。
AI.motivation: 经典 MAPF 假设环境地图完全已知，但现实中存在障碍物局部扰动；现有方法仅利用直接观测，无法利用空间相关性从一次观测推断邻近未观测位置的可通行性，导致代价高昂的重新规划。
AI.method: 使用 GMRF 建模不确定位置的潜在分数空间相关性，通过 GaBP 在线更新共享信念；将位置可通行信念与边绕行距离结合，构造绕行感知代价 c_t(e)=b̂·1+(1-b̂)·C_det，并嵌入标准 MAPF 规划器（CBS/EECBS/PBS/PIBT/PIBT+/LaCAM）的规划-执行循环中。
AI.result: 在 MAPF 基准地图（empty/random/maze/room/warehouse/game/city）上，n=10~800，ϕ=0.20、ρ=0.30、R=3 的标准设置下，MAGIC 在 15 种规划器配置中均优于乐观重规划，96.3% 实例的 SoC 更低；ϕ=0.30 时 MAGIC 仅高于最优全知 SoC 3.6%（乐观重规划 9.4%、MAPF-IM 14.9%）；先验与生成概率对齐时再降 3.4%。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC 证明了利用空间相关性将局部观测扩展到未观测区域、构造绕行感知代价可显著降低 MAPF 在不确定地图下的执行代价，框架与规划器无关且可扩展至 800 智能体；未来将扩展到终身任务和执行中可通行性变化的场景。

title: PivotOPD: Learning to Recover from Pivotal Mistakes in Multi-Turn Agents
comment: PivotOPD technical report; Project page: this https URL
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a promising approach for training language agents, providing dense teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, in multi-turn interaction, an incorrect action changes the states the student encounters later, so errors compound across turns. In preliminary experiments across three Qwen3 models (8B to 235B), we find that more than half of the failed rollouts contain a pivotal mistake, an action that moves the agent farther from completing the task, and this mistake typically occurs early. These pivotal mistakes often remain recoverable: guiding the model for only a few turns after the pivotal turn can restore task success. We therefore propose PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation framework that jointly trains the student to prevent pivotal mistakes and to recover from the states they create. At each pivotal mistake, a teacher model provides a gold action and then names a recovery action at each of the next few turns. Preventive distillation uses the gold action with reverse KL to steer the student away from the pivotal mistake, while recovery distillation uses the recovery actions with forward KL to transfer recovery behaviors that the student rarely samples. Against 13 baselines on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA, PivotOPD achieves the strongest average performance for both Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-8B students, improving over the strongest baseline on ALFWorld by +5.5% with the 1.7B student. The gains also transfer to another model family on the software engineering domain, where PivotOPD raises the resolve rate of a Nemotron-3.5 student on SWE-Bench Verified by +3.2%. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出PivotOPD框架，通过教师模型检测多轮智能体中的"关键错误"（pivotal mistake），并在关键回合及其后续恢复回合上对学生模型进行预防性与恢复性蒸馏，从而提升多轮语言智能体的任务完成能力。
AI.motivation: 标准在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在多轮交互中存在错误累积问题：一个错误动作会改变后续状态，导致学生模型偏离教师。作者发现超过一半的失败轨迹包含一个"关键错误"（早期发生的、显著拉远任务完成的错误），且这类错误通常仍可恢复，但现有方法未能有效学习恢复策略。
AI.method: PivotOPD框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 关键回合检测——教师模型读取失败轨迹，选择候选回合并给出"黄金动作"；(2) 预防性蒸馏——在关键回合使用反向KL损失，靠近黄金动作；(3) 恢复性蒸馏——在关键回合之后的K个恢复回合中，使用前向KL损失，让学生从自身错误产生的状态中学习恢复行为。该方法通过特权自教师（被提示黄金动作的冻结学生）生成密集的token级监督信号，并与基于组的强化学习结合在单一PPO更新中。
AI.result: PivotOPD在ALFWorld、WebShop和搜索式QA三个基准测试中对13种基线方法均取得最佳平均性能。Qwen3-1.7B学生在ALFWorld上比最强基线提升5.5%，在搜索式QA上提升5.9%。Qwen3-8B学生的恢复率达到72.7%，约为基线模型的9倍。在SWE-Bench Verified上，使用Nemotron-3.5学生模型将解决率提升3.2%（标准OPD仅提升0.2%）。自蒸馏设置下无需更强教师也能保持优势。
AI.conclusion: PivotOPD通过在关键回合及其后续状态上集中密集教师监督，有效解决了多轮智能体中的错误累积问题。理论分析表明，恢复性蒸馏在学生极少采样的恢复动作上提供了稳定的学习信号，其更新大小依赖于教师分布而非学生分布。实验验证了预防性与恢复性蒸馏的互补性，以及PivotOPD在不同模型族和软件工程领域的迁移能力。

title: How Much of a Harness Does a Strong Agent Need for Autonomous ML Engineering?
summary: Recent autonomous machine learning engineering (MLE) agents have made significant progress on public leaderboards. Often motivated by progress stagnation over long-horizon cycles and limited Large Language Model (LLM) primitives, modern MLE agents are deployed on top of increasingly elaborate machinery: multi-agent orchestrators, dedicated retrieval subagents, and more. While such harnesses expand, the use of more primitive but improved coding agents - where LLMs have direct access to the execution environment through read, write, and bash primitives - has received little attention in the field. In this paper we find that, under an equal time budget and the same frontier LLM backbone, open-source state-of-the-art harnesses provide no advantages over a single session of a minimal-harness coding agent baseline, pointing to the backbone as the primary driver for performance. Via a series of large-scale systematic ablation studies, we argue that the machinery layers become redundant in the coding agent setting. We conclude that the effort spent elaborating hand-crafted harnesses around strong models yields poor returns for current MLE benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过大规模系统消融实验证明，在自主机器学习工程（MLE）任务中，给LLM提供编码代理环境（coding agent environment）是最大的性能增益来源，而在此之上精心设计的多代理编排、树搜索等"harness"机制几乎不带来显著收益。论文提出的极简基线Malena（单一长会话编码代理）在固定预算和backbone条件下，在MLE-bench和NatureBench上匹配或超过了四个开源SOTA MLE harness。
AI.motivation: 当前自主MLE agent系统日益复杂化（多代理编排、专用检索子代理等），但这些精心设计的harness在强LLM backbone上的实际价值存疑。此前在SWE-bench等领域已有证据表明多agent工作流并不优于单agent，但MLE领域缺乏严格控制变量的大规模系统验证。论文试图回答：在相同backbone和预算下，harness的哪些组件真正重要？
AI.method: 采用受控消融研究方法：固定backbone（GLM 5.2等）、硬件（1×A100 80GB）和时间预算（24h），逐步添加harness干预措施。具体消融四类干预：(1) 编码代理环境（Chat→Oneshot）；(2) 搜索策略（Chain/Greedy/UCB1/Best-of-N）；(3) 自主性（Malena单长会话）；(4) 多代理编排（Delegation/Parallelism/Broadcast）。与四个开源SOTA harness（MLEvolve、AiScientist、Arbor、ScienceFlow）在MLE-bench（30任务）和NatureBench（40任务）上进行匹配对比，并通过checkpoint标注和trace分析研究agent的搜索行为。
AI.result: 关键发现：(1) 编码代理环境是最大单一增益因素，前沿LLM从Chat到Oneshot性能大幅提升；(2) 搜索策略间无统计显著差异（最佳配对UCB1 vs Best-of-N差值95%CI包含0）；(3) Malena单会话基线在所有前沿backbone上匹配或超过四个外部harness（GLM 5.2下Malena获奖率62.5% vs 最佳外部harness 47.1%）；(4) 多代理编排（Delegation/Parallelism）无显著改善；(5) Trace分析显示Malena自适应地平衡稀有技术与性能优化，无需显式harness结构。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出"苦涩教训"式结论：对于具有强编码代理能力的LLM，精心设计harness的投入回报率低。性能的主要驱动因素是backbone本身的代理能力和运行时环境，而非harness scaffolding。模型的后训练（特别是编码代理环境中的训练）正在替代harness原本要提供的功能——搜索、调试、恢复等。这意味着MLE领域的研发重心应放在模型和后训练上，而非harness设计上。

title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
summary: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove--verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using Gemini as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on five open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 Cogentic——一个用于开放式研究问题自动证明发现的多智能体编排系统。该系统通过迭代的"证明-验证"循环，调度独立的证明器探索不同方向，并由专门组件进行对抗性验证，将确认的中间结果存入持久化验证账本以供后续轮次使用。系统使用 Gemini 作为基础模型，在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计三个领域的五个开放问题上取得了新结果，均由领域专家独立验证。
AI.motivation: 前沿语言模型虽然能一次性生成优秀的数学想法，但单次生成不足以解决开放式研究问题，因为这类问题需要：探索多个相互竞争的猜想、克服微妙的技术障碍，并在长时程上保留中间进展。现有方法（如交互式定理证明器、程序搜索、推理预算扩展）各有局限：形式化方法缺乏自然语言可读性，程序搜索需要廉价可计算的评分函数，而简单的多采样或多智能体辩论缺乏系统性的验证与进展管理机制。
AI.method: Cogentic 采用多轮迭代的"证明-验证"循环架构，核心组件包括：(1) 编排器：中央控制器，分配证明器资源，管理全局状态和验证账本；(2) 文献综述员：检索相关定义和定理；(3) 证明器：基于简报独立并行生成候选证明；(4) 验证器：从不同角度对抗性审查证明（先假设错误直至被证伪）；(5) 记录与验证账本：记录尝试历史和已验证的中间引理；(6) 流程顾问：跨轮次调整指令和资源配置；(7) 整合阶段：格式化和审计最终稿件。每轮中，编排器规划方向，顾问为每个证明器定制简报，证明器并行起草，验证器单独和对比审查，通过双重验证的草稿才被接受。验证的中间引理被提取为独立引理重新验证后存入账本供后续使用。系统仅需问题陈述，无需专家提示，端到端自主工作。
AI.result: Cogentic 以 Gemini 为基础模型，在五个开放问题上取得新结果（均由领域专家独立验证）：(1) 高效在线逆线性优化：首次给出既高效（O(d²) 每轮）又 proper 的 O(d) 遗憾界，与最优 Ω(√d) 仅差 √d 因子；(2) 双边市场竞争复杂度：将常数从至少 20,000 降至 2，且只需在单边（卖方）招募，证明 STR(m,n+2) ≥ OPT(m,n)，且 +1 不够；(3) n 专家随时算法：证明随时遗憾与固定时界遗憾的领先常数在 n→∞ 时一致，消除 √2 因子差距；(4) 简单与最优机制比较：单加性买家情形下，将 5.2 因子改进至 3.52；(5) 自动竞价拍卖的无政府代价：两竞标者时 pFPA₁ 达到 PoA ≤ 1.5（紧界），n 竞标者时 pFPA_{2n} 达到 PoA ≤ 2 - 1/(4n+1)，匹配已知下界至常数因子。推理预算约为 O(100) 至 O(1000) 次 Gemini 调用。
AI.conclusion: Cogentic 证明了多智能体编排框架能够以相对适中的推理预算（O(100)-O(1000) 次模型调用）自主发现研究级别的数学和理论计算机科学新结果。其核心优势在于方向分配、对抗性验证、跨轮次经验持久化（验证账本）和流程级自适应调整的结合。然而，系统存在局限性：产生候选证明的速度可能超过人工审阅速度，且自然语言证明虽可由专家验证但缺乏形式化保证。未来需解决生成吞吐量与人类理解之间的平衡问题，例如与 Lean 等证明助手结合以实现机器检查的正确性保障。

title: WorldAuditBench: Interactive 3D World Auditing with Multimodal Agents
summary: As interactive 3D worlds are increasingly used to study intelligent behavior, it becomes important to develop efficient pipelines for identifying anomalies in these simulated environments, such as floating objects, traversable walls, or objects inconsistent with the surrounding scene. Multimodal AI systems, including vision-language models (VLMs) and vision-language-action models (VLAs), have shown potential for automating this task. However, 3D world auditing is complex, requiring the close coupling of two distinct capabilities: action, to navigate the 3D world and search for anomalies systematically and efficiently; and visual reasoning, to understand the environment and identify anomalies from multimodal observations. It remains largely unexplored whether multimodal agents can effectively couple these two capabilities, using visual reasoning to identify potential anomalies while taking actions to validate them. In this paper, we introduce WorldAuditBench, a benchmark for 3D world auditing comprising 213 anomaly tasks across 13 environments built with Unreal Engine 5 and this http URL , spanning five anomaly families. We evaluate five frontier models under a fixed exploration budget using two auditing paradigms: VLA-based exploration followed by VLM-based anomaly identification, and an end-to-end VLM agent in which visual reasoning directly guides action selection. Across the evaluated models and two paradigms, success rates range from 6.6% to 42.3%, substantially below human performance (83.4%). Through the task of world auditing, WorldAuditBench provides a testbed for studying how multimodal agents couple action and visual reasoning in interactive 3D environments, while highlighting current limitations in their ability to gather and interpret evidence during exploration.

AI.tldr: WorldAuditBench是一个用于评估多模态智能体在交互式3D世界中识别异常能力的基准测试，包含213个异常任务，跨13个环境。实验表明当前最先进的多模态智能体（VLM/VLA）在该任务上的表现远低于人类水平（6.6%-42.3% vs 83.4%），揭示了智能体在主动证据收集与视觉推理耦合方面的重大局限。
AI.motivation: 交互式3D世界被广泛用于研究智能行为，但这些环境中常存在物理、空间、时间和语义层面的异常（如漂浮物体、可穿越墙壁、场景不一致对象等）。现有基准测试要么仅评估静态视觉理解，要么仅关注简单的异常搜索，无法系统评估智能体在交互式3D环境中耦合"行动"与"视觉推理"来发现并验证复杂异常的能力。核心科学问题是：多模态智能体能否自主执行"世界审计"任务，即通过主动探索和推理来识别需要交互或多视角观察才能发现的异常？
AI.method:
1. **基准数据集构建**：在Unreal Engine 5和Three.js上构建13个交互式3D环境（覆盖室内、城市、历史、工业、自然五大场景类型），共213个手工艺异常任务，按五大类异常族组织（静态物理、交互式物理、空间一致性、时间一致性、语义一致性），共15个细分类别，每个任务经过至少两名独立评审验证。

2. **两种审计范式**：① **VLM-only范式**：单一视觉语言模型VLM接收初始输入（含审计指令、场景描述、异常类型提示、匹配上下文示例和初始RGB观测），通过40步动作预算进行探索，使用环境动作（移动/转向/观察/交互/等待）、记忆工具（回看帧/历史/笔记）和异常报告工具进行自主审计；② **VLA-VLM两阶段范式**：先用Open-P2P 1.2B VLA模型收集60秒固定轨迹（约120帧），再用VLM离线分析轨迹。

3. **评估协议**：评估GPT-6 Astra、Claude Opus 5、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Muse Spark 1.3、Qwen 3.8 Flash五种模型，使用VLM-as-a-judge（GPT-6 Astra）判定成功与否，并对比10名CS博士生的83.4%人类表现。

4. **消融实验**：系统研究起始距离、探索预算、任务指导（上下文示例与异常类型提示）、多异常共存等因素的影响，并分析异常暴露率（几何覆盖和人类评分）与识别准确率的分离效应。
AI.result:
**主要结果**：
- VLM智能体成功率范围28.2%-42.3%（GPT-6 Astra最佳42.3%，Gemini 3.8 Flash 32.4%，Claude Opus 5 28.2%）
- VLA-VLM两阶段智能体成功率仅6.6%-17.4%
- 所有模型均远低于人类水平83.4%
- 时间一致性异常最难（SR ≤12.5%），静态物理与语义一致性相对容易
- VLM-only范式比VLA-VLM范式快但成本高2.7-10.3倍

**关键发现**：
- 异常暴露率差异显著：VLM智能体几何覆盖91.1% vs VLA探索器47.4%；人类评分暴露68.1% vs 34.7%
- 记忆工具显著提升VLM智能体表现
- 异常类型提示比上下文示例更重要（移除提示导致VLM性能下降17.5个百分点）
- 多异常共存时，完全发现率极低（双异常仅7.1%，三异常仅4.8%）
- VLM优势不仅来自覆盖率，更来自记忆工具与交互能力
- VLA模型在大型3D世界中难以到达目标位置，限制后续分析证据
AI.conclusion: WorldAuditBench提供了一个系统性的测试平台，用于研究多模态智能体如何在交互式3D环境中耦合行动与视觉推理。研究揭示了当前VLM/VLA智能体在证据收集与跨视角/时间推理方面的重大能力差距：最优AI智能体（42.3%）与人类水平（83.4%）之间存在41个百分点的巨大鸿沟，特别是在时间一致性异常（异常消失/属性变化等需要前后对比的任务）上。未来瓶颈将强化VLM智能体，其推理引导探索的能力显著优于VLA-VLM分离范式。该基准为研究能够形成假设、通过行动验证假设、并跨多视角/时间连接证据的智能体提供了重要测试基础，对具身AI、自动化游戏/3D内容质量保证、模拟环境可靠性验证等领域具有重要价值。

title: Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization
summary: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates. Through numerical experiments, we show that Turbo Harness consistently outperforms existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.

AI.tldr: Turbo Harness提出了一种实例自适应（instance-adaptive）的harness优化框架，通过复用全局harness搜索过程中产生的"副产品"（执行轨迹、反思、评估等），将其蒸馏为结构化的playbook，并训练一个轻量级的harness editor（基于GRPO强化学习），在推理时为每个任务实例生成针对全局harness的定制化补丁（patch），从而在七个涵盖交互式agent、软甲工程和长horizon终端任务的基准测试上一致超越现有的harness优化基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有harness优化方法（如Meta-Harness、Harness-R1等）通常只能产出单一的全局harness，并将其统一应用于所有任务实例。然而，不同任务实例可能受益于不同的harness配置（例如SWE-Bench中不同GitHub仓库的开发流程和测试规范各异），单一全局harness难以同时适配所有场景。此外，harness优化过程中产生的丰富历史信息（候选harness、执行轨迹、成功/失败证据）在优化完成后大多被丢弃，造成信息浪费。
AI.method: Turbo Harness包含两个核心组件：(1) Playbook构建：从已完成的全局harness搜索档案中，通过提取（extraction）、反思（reflection）和策展（curation）三个离线阶段，将成功和失败的harness编辑策略蒸馏为结构化的playbook，记录策略的适用条件和正反证据；(2) Harness Editor训练：使用Qwen3.5-9B作为轻量级editor模型，以GRPO强化学习进行全参数微调，以任务性能作为奖励信号，学习如何根据任务实例和playbook对全局harness H*生成实例特定的补丁p_x，得到H_x = H* ⊕ p_x。推理时editor仅被调用一次，由冻结的执行模型M在适配后的harness下运行。
AI.result: 在7个基准测试（ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、DBBench、WebShop、SWE-smith-MR、SWE-bench Verified、Terminal-Bench-2.1）上，Turbo Harness一致优于Meta-Harness及其他基线：在SWE-smith-MR上，Claude Haiku 4.5的通过率从50.7%提升至64.0%，Gemini 3.7 Flash从70.7%提升至88.0%；在Terminal-Bench-2.1上以55.5%的通过率超越Meta-Harness（50.5%）和最佳人工设计harness Terminus-Kira（52.3%），同时降低了执行成本（如SWE-smith-MR上Gemini的执行成本降低约6.7倍）。消融实验表明，RL训练与playbook条件化是互补的，单独使用均不足以超越Meta-Harness。
AI.conclusion: Turbo Harness通过复用harness优化过程中产生的中间产物（而非将其视为一次性副产品），实现了实例级别的harness自适应，在提升任务性能的同时往往降低执行成本。该方法轻量（editor仅9B参数且每个实例只调用一次），但其有效性依赖于全局搜索的质量和多样性，且editor训练需要额外的环境rollout。未来工作可探索更样本高效的优化方法、editor和playbook在不同任务/域间的迁移，以及进一步挖掘harness优化副产物的可重用经验价值。

title: Instability Floors: Separating Bias from Noise in Fairness Audits of Clinical LLM Agents with FairMedAgent
comment: 27 pages (13 main plus 14 supplementary), 4 figures, 3 tables. Code: this https URL (v0.1.5, commit 3982974; concept DOI https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22165979 ). Trajectories: this https URL
summary: Counterfactual fairness audits of clinical language-model agents report a flip rate: how often an action changes when only the patient's demographic descriptor changes. Part of that rate is not demographic. A stochastic agent also changes its own action when nothing changes, and a flip rate cannot be interpreted without knowing how often. We measured it. Re-running one condition ten times over sixteen synthetic vignettes at default sampling changed a clinical agent's action in 8.7 percent of replicate pairs, from 2.2 percent for intensive-care escalation to 17.9 percent for controlled-substance caution, an output given no operational criteria. Across six models from five vendors, pooled floors ranged from 2.5 to 23.7 percent; in this panel neither disclosed size, vendor, nor hosting ordered them. The floor depends on the decoding configuration: majority voting over five draws removed 39 percent of it (95 percent confidence interval (CI) 18 to 64); at temperature 0 three of four locally served models showed no disagreement, but a hosted model still did. We also show that, for a binary action, the flip rate expected under no demographic effect equals the floor and a real effect adds only its square, so a flip rate inside the floor is not evidence of fairness, and direction must be tested with a signed paired test. We give a four-step reporting procedure and release FairMedAgent, the harness, with its protocol, vignettes and analysis scripts, so any team can measure the floor for its own agent.

AI.tldr: 本文指出临床语言模型代理的反事实公平性审计中，flip rate（翻转率）受到采样随机性引起的"零变化波动"（floor）的严重干扰，必须先量化并扣除该 floor，才能正确解读人口统计学效应。作者通过 16 个合成临床场景在 6 个模型（5 家供应商）上的实验，提出了四项报告规范，并开源了 FairMedAgent 评测工具。
AI.motivation: 当前临床语言模型代理的反事实公平性审计以"翻转率"为核心指标，即仅改变患者人口学描述时模型行为变化的频率。然而，随机性（即非确定的）在相同输入下也会产生行为波动，导致翻转率天然包含非人口统计学成分。已有审计普遍未对该随机性基线（floor）进行量化或扣除，使得人口统计学公平性的解读不可靠。
AI.method: 1. 设计 16 个合成临床小场景（vignettes），覆盖重症升级、管制药物谨慎等典型任务；2. 在 6 个模型（5 家供应商，含本地部署与托管模型）上对每个条件重复运行 10 次以量化采样随机性；3. 计算"零变化时"行动不一致的配对比例作为 floor；4. 评估多数投票（5 票）与温度（T=0）对 floor 的削减效果；5. 推导翻转率与 floor 的理论关系——二元动作下无人口学效应时翻转率等于 floor，实际效应仅按平方叠加；6. 提出有符号配对需求和四项报告流程；7. 开源 FairMedAgent 评测工具（包含协议、场景与分析脚本）。
AI.result: - 默认采样下，临床代理在 10 次重复 ×16 场景中，零变化配对行动不一致率达 8.7%；- 任务间差异显著：重症升级仅 2.2%，管制药物谨慎高达 17.9%（后者无明确操作标准）；- 6 个模型池化 floor 范围为 2.5%–23.7%，模型规模、供应商、托管方式均不能预测 floor 大小；- 5 次采样的多数投票可去除 39% 的 floor（95% CI 18–64）；- 温度为 0 时，本地 4 个模型中有 3 个不再出现不一致，但某托管模型仍存在不一致；- 理论推导证明：翻转率 ≤ floor 不构成公平证据，方向性须用有符号配对需求验证。
AI.conclusion: 临床语言模型反事实公平审计必须先测量并报告采样随机性 floor，否则翻转率无法解读；多数投票和温度 0 可显著但非完全消除 floor；公平性判断需使用有符号配对需求；作者提出四项报告步骤并开源 FairMedAgent，使任何团队都能为其代理量化 floor。

title: Travel Time Prediction in Supply Chain Management Using Machine Learning
summary: The purpose of this research is to find data and methods using machine learning and deep learning to correctly predict the estimated travel time for transportation and logistics in a supply chain system. The supply chain ecosystem is very complex and heavily relies on the transportation and logistics of raw materials and finished goods. Accurate travel time estimation is critical because it helps supply chain members to improve logistics consistency and performance. This helps in planning, demand forecasting, lead time management and assembly planning. The logistics on the delivery side of the customer also plays a crucial role in customer satisfaction and voice of customer. With the collection of huge historical data and using novel techniques, the research builds an accurate model to predict travel time of inventory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于一维卷积神经网络（1D-CNN）的深度学习方法，用于预测供应链中海上货物运输的航行时间（ETA）。研究利用2023年13000多艘船舶的2300万个AIS数据点，通过PCA降维后构建1D-CNN回归模型，最终实现了7.10%的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE），显著优于简单线性回归的14.75% MAPE。
AI.motivation: 供应链生态系统高度依赖运输与物流，准确的航行时间预测对计划、需求预测、交货期管理和客户满意度至关重要。现有研究多使用线性回归等传统机器学习方法，难以处理多式联运中天气、交通、路线等多变量影响的复杂非线性关系。
AI.method: 1. 数据采集：通过datalastic.com API收集13000+艘货船2023年全年的AIS轨迹数据，含18个特征。2. 数据预处理：去除速度≤1节的静止记录，过滤TIME_TAKEN>3000秒的异常值，标签编码分类变量，计算Haversine距离。3. 特征工程：基于线性回归重要性分析剔除3个无关特征。4. PCA降维：14个特征降至12个主成分。5. 1D-CNN建模：两层卷积（64和128滤波器）+最大池化+全连接层，ReLU激活函数，10个epoch训练。
AI.result: 1D-CNN模型取得MSE=29640.19、MAPE=7.10%、MAE=107.32秒的预测精度，相比简单线性回归（MAPE=14.75%）提升显著。最终验证损失降至0.3329，可通过将长航程拆分为多段预测并求和的方式估算总航行时间。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明1D-CNN能有效提取船舶航行数据中的特征相关性，可用于构建A到B点航行时间预测的包装应用。建议未来加入船舶吨位、交通密度、天气条件等特征，并可结合LSTM和注意力网络进一步提升精度。

title: A Moving-Horizon Approximate Branch-and-Reduce Method for Deep Classification Trees
summary: Despite the importance for interpretability, decision trees face severe scalability challenges. Existing global optimal methods are often limited by binary feature selection and shallow tree depths, whereas traditional heuristic approaches frequently sacrifice predictive accuracy. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a moving-horizon approximate branch-and-reduce method to train near-optimal deep classification trees on large-scale datasets with continuous features. Built on a hierarchical root-subtree optimization framework, the method solves the root-level problem via branch-and-reduce while approximating the induced subtree problem using greedy heuristics. Although the underlying framework is capable of guaranteeing global optimality, the approximation, which functions as a lookahead rollout in a reinforcement learning context, significantly boosts efficiency for deeper structures. A low-cost moving-horizon strategy is then employed to iteratively refine model accuracy. Extensive numerical results demonstrate that our method exceeds the testing accuracy of existing heuristic baselines while offering significantly greater scalability, in terms of both dataset size and tree depth, than global optimal solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MHABR的近似分支归约方法，用于在大规模连续特征数据集上训练深度分类树。该方法通过层次化的根-子树优化框架、根级的分支归约搜索、CART近似的子树求解和移动时域精化过程，在优化质量、可扩展性和深度树训练之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.motivation: 决策树因其可解释性在机器学习中具有重要价值，但面临严重的可扩展性问题：现有全局最优方法通常受限于二元特征选择和较浅的树深度，而传统启发式方法往往牺牲预测精度。该研究旨在弥合这一差距，提出一种既能保持高精度又可扩展到大规模数据集和深度树的方法。
AI.method: 该方法包含三个关键组件：1）层次化的根-子树优化框架，将根节点分裂参数与子树问题分离；2）基于Lipschitz型条件的分支归约（BR）方法用于根级搜索，利用上界/下界进行安全剪枝；3）子树的CART近似（ABR）替代精确求解以提高效率；4）移动时域（MH）精化策略，通过迭代重新优化子树来提升精度。该方法对深度-2树保证全局最优性，对深度-3树在扩展变体MHABR²下保证最优性。
AI.result: 在59个UCI数据集上进行了广泛实验：1）测试精度：在51个小数据集上，MHABR在深度2和3上达到最高平均测试精度，比DL8.5平均高出0.99%；在8个中大型数据集深度8上，比DPDT平均高出3.01%，比CART平均高出3.66%；2）可扩展性：MHABR能在深度8下处理高达6080万样本的数据集，而全局最优方法在该规模下无法在时间预算内完成；3）最优性：MHABR对深度-2树保证全局最优，对深度-3树在42个小数据集上训练精度与全局最优的平均差距仅为0.58%，扩展变体MHABR²对深度-3树保证最优。
AI.conclusion: MHABR提供了一种在优化质量、运行时间和可扩展性之间具有良好经验权衡的方法，特别适用于需要可解释深度树的场景。其LR型安全剪枝策略是计算效率的主要来源，使得精确BR的最坏情况复杂度从指数级深度降低到MHABR的二次复杂度。该方法特别适用于CART精度不足而全局优化计算不可行的中等规模应用场景。

title: Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble
comment: Published in ICONIP 2024 (Neural Information Processing), LNCS 15287, Springer Nature, 2025
summary: Accurate time series forecasting is critical across various domains, yet traditional ensemble methods often suffer from the disproportionate influence of extreme forecasts. We introduce the Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble (CAGE), a novel framework that combines generative modeling, adversarial discrimination, and conformal prediction to enhance forecast reliability and accuracy. CAGE employs multiple generative models to produce initial forecasts, which are then evaluated by a discriminative component using conformal prediction techniques. P-values derived from nonconformity scores help dynamically adjust model weights, minimizing the impact of unreliable forecasts. This approach ensures that only the most credible predictions contribute to the final ensemble output. Our empirical and statistical analyses of time series data from New Zealand's milk collection and the global health data from the public owid-monkeypox dataset show that the CAGE outperforms traditional ensemble methods, especially in handling outliers and noisy data. By incorporating conformal prediction, CAGE delivers accurate and statistically rigorous forecasts, enhancing decision-making. We have demonstrated performance on two different datasets deliberately to showcase that the proposed method offers a versatile solution potentially applicable across finance, weather, and supply chain management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的时序预测集成框架 CAGE（Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble），结合生成建模、对抗判别和保形预测（conformal prediction），通过基于非一致性分数的 p 值动态调整模型权重，有效抑制极端预测和噪声的影响，提升预测的准确性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统集成方法（如简单平均和加权平均）在时序预测中存在对极端预测过度敏感、难以处理噪声和离群点、缺乏不确定性量化机制等固有缺陷，亟需一种能够动态评估预测可信度并据此调整权重的框架。
AI.method: CAGE 框架包含三个核心组件：(1) 多个生成模型（Ridge、Elastic-Net、RANSAC、Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost、KNN）产生初始预测；(2) 基于保形预测计算每个模型的非一致性分数和 p 值，通过预设阈值进行接受/拒绝判别；(3) 根据 p 值动态调整模型权重（拒绝者权重置零），并对各模型进行偏差校正，最终以加权方式聚合生成集成预测。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上进行验证：(1) 新西兰 6 个地区牛奶收集量时序数据（2007–2024，预测 365 天），CAGE 在大多数区域显著优于 SimpleAvg 和 wEnsemble（如 Region A 的 MAE% 为 2.08 vs 4.41 vs 2.96）；(2) OWID 猴痘数据集 6 个国家（2022–2023，预测 30 天），CAGE 在 5 个国家显著领先（如澳大利亚 0.035 vs 1.084 vs 0.147）。ANOVA 和 post-hoc t 检验在多数区域/国家中证实了 CAGE 与基线方法的显著性差异（p < 0.05）。
AI.conclusion: CAGE 通过保形预测实现了统计严格的不确定性量化与动态权重调整，在处理离群点和噪声方面显著优于传统集成方法，展现了在金融、医疗、气象和供应链管理等领域的广泛应用潜力。

title: DualCast: A Dual-Path Language Model for Bimodal Financial Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Financial time-series forecasting must capture price dynamics across heterogeneous assets while incorporating news available at prediction time. We introduce DualCast, a dual-path framework that extends a frozen language model with a discrete financial vocabulary. Each log-return patch is represented by a learned summary token and three residual shape tokens, preserving local drift and volatility while allowing shape patterns to be shared across assets. To improve codebook utilization, we develop adaptive frequency-equalizing residual vector quantization, which rebalances overloaded codewords without compromising reconstruction accuracy. The fast path trains only the new financial-token embeddings and output heads on a frozen Qwen3-8B backbone. A toggleable LoRA adapter enables a slow path that conditions on the fast forecast and news available at the forecast origin to produce a revised prediction. The reviser is initialized by supervised fine-tuning and further optimized with a return-space group relative policy optimization objective that rewards improvements over the fast forecast. In zero-shot evaluations covering equities and energy prices at five-minute, daily, and weekly resolutions, the slow path achieves the lowest mean absolute percentage error among the compared methods in 8 of 12 dataset-horizon settings, including every longest-horizon setting. News ablations indicate additional gains in most tested settings, although their magnitude varies across markets. DualCast thus combines a fast numerical forecaster with an optional text-conditioned revision mechanism.

AI.tldr: DualCast 是一个基于冻结 Qwen3-8B 的双路径双模态金融时序预测框架，通过离散金融词汇表扩展语言模型，结合快速数值预测路径与可选的文本条件修订路径，在零样本跨市场预测中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 金融时序预测面临两大核心挑战：(1) 不同资产波动率差异巨大（跨数量级），传统归一化会丢失关键的尺度信息；(2) 价格变动信息部分来源于历史价格之外的事件（如新闻、公告），纯数值模型对此结构性失明。现有方法要么牺牲文本推理能力换取数值建模能力，要么反之，缺乏统一的框架。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 形状-尺度分化解码器：将每个 log-return patch 分解为归一化形状信号和保留下来的尺度统计量，分别用残差向量量化（RVQ）和学习得到的汇总词汇表离散化，每个 patch 表示为 1 个汇总 token + 3 个残差形状 token。(2) 自适应频率均衡 RVQ（AFE-RVQ）：周期性识别过载和欠载的码字，对过载码字的潜向量做小规模 k-means 切分，将子中心重定位到空闲槽位，无需额外参数且推理时禁用。(3) 双路径架构：Fast 路径仅训练新增金融 token 的 embedding 和输出头（冻结 Qwen3-8B 主干）；Slow 路径添加可切换的 LoRA 适配器（q,v, r=32），以 Fast 预测为条件输入新闻文本进行修订，先用监督微调初始化，再用返回空间 GRPO 优化（奖励包括相对改进 R_imp、截面排序一致性 R_IC、格式约束 R_fmt）。总可训练参数 48.9M（0.60%）。
AI.result: 在 4 个数据集（MTBench-short 5分钟美股、SP500 日频美股、HS300 日频中国股、Energy 周频美国汽油）、3 个预测长度（16/32/64）的零样本评估中，DualCast（Slow）在 12 个数据集-预测长度组合中的 8 个取得最低 MAPE，包括全部 H=64 设置。MTBench-short 上全部 horizon 领先；在 SP500 H=64 上从 Fast 的 15.26% 降至 Slow 的 9.80%，HS300 上从 18.06% 降至 9.19%。新闻消融显示真实新闻在 9 个组合中的 8 个降低 MAPE，能源市场方向准确率提升最显著（+6%/+12%/+6%）。AFE-RVQ 将 L0 层最差码字负载从 7.9× 降至 3.9×，同时保持重建精度（0.0783→0.0781）。Slow 路径延迟 5.85s（生成约 199 tokens），Fast 路径仅 0.37s（16 tokens）。
AI.conclusion: DualCast 验证了将多模态金融预测构建为"对强数值基线预测进行可选新闻修订"这一范式的有效性。冻结 LLM 主干 + 离散金融词汇表 + 双路径设计既能保持原始语言推理能力，又能获得稳健的数值预测能力。未来工作方向包括不确定性感知评估、跨市场泛化以及可学习的路由策略以平衡精度与效率。主要局限：(1) 新闻效益在不同市场和预测长度上不均匀；(2) Slow 路径推理开销较高（延迟约 16 倍），不适合对延迟敏感的场景。

title: Automatic estimation of verbal fluency index in people with Motor Neuron Disease using ASR alignment and pause modelling
summary: Monitoring cognitive impairment (CI) in motor neuron disease (MND) is essential for timely treatment and care, yet challenging due to co-occurring speech difficulties. The Edinburgh Cognitive and Behavioural ALS Screen (ECAS) provides a robust metric for CI assessment, with the Verbal Fluency Index (VFI) a central element. Building on recent advances in automated speech analysis, this study proposes a system for estimating VFI. It leverages a unique MND dataset and combines ASR (WhisperX) and VAD (Silero) with refined timestamping to predict the VFI and extract several clinically interpretable measures. Our approach outperformed systems based on traditional acoustic features and self-supervised embeddings, evaluated using multiple regression algorithms. Clinically inspired features consistently outperformed the other sets, with the best models achieving strong results (P-words: R2 0.9, NRMSE 0.05; S-words: R2 0.8, NRMSE 0.08), demonstrating the feasibility of automated VFI estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于WhisperX ASR与Silero VAD结合的自动言语流畅性指数(VFI)估计管道,用于运动神经元病(MND)患者的认知障碍监测。该系统仅利用言语流畅性生成阶段,通过精细化时间戳和临床可解释特征实现自动化评分,在P-words任务上R²达0.856,S-words任务上R²达0.832。
AI.motivation: 运动神经元病(MND)患者中高达50%会出现认知障碍,但由于伴随的构音障碍(dysarthria),传统认知评估面临挑战。ECAS量表中的言语流畅性指数(VFI)通过语速校正来区分运动功能与认知功能障碍,但其计算耗时且需要临床医生监督,亟需自动化方案以支持远程评估和大规模筛查。现有研究尚未专门针对MND人群的ECAS VFI自动估计。
AI.method: 提出四阶段自动VFI评分管道:1)使用WhisperX进行转录并获取词级时间戳;2)结合Silero VAD调整时间戳(采用Longest-Segment策略解决多VAD段对应单个ASR段的问题);3)临床特征提取器使用SpaCy和NLTK识别正确词汇(去除专有名词、重复、犹豫词),提取正确词数、平均词长、停顿比例等31个临床可解释特征;4)使用LASSO和SVR等回归模型估计VFI。数据集包含42名MND参与者(20名构音障碍、22名典型语音),采用5折交叉验证评估。
AI.result: 该方法显著优于基于传统声学特征(eGeMAPS等)和自监督嵌入(Wav2Vec2、HuBERT)的方法。最佳结果:P-words LASSO模型R²=0.856,NRMSE=0.053;S-words LASSO模型R²=0.832,NRMSE=0.083。临床自动特征(Clin-Auto)与临床手动特征(Clin-Man)性能无统计学显著差异,表明仅凭生成阶段即可可靠估计VFI。构音障碍患者估计误差较大(P-words NRMSE:典型0.05 vs dysarthric 0.117),但总体泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了集成先进ASR和VAD与可解释临床特征的自动管道生成准确VFI回归模型的可行性。仅使用生成阶段即可完成估计,无需控制性阅读阶段,从而减轻患者和临床医生负担。未来工作应纳入补充任务(阅读段落、图片描述)以更好地服务构音障碍人群。

title: How Should Diffusion Language Models Edit Code?
summary: Code editing requires a model to decide where to make changes, generate the new content, and preserve everything else. We study how masked diffusion language models divide these responsibilities across four editing interfaces: whole-file rewriting, search-and-replace, locate-then-infill, and token-level editing. Experiments on CanItEdit reveal a composition gap: diffusion models can generate coordinated changes when the correct edit locations are supplied, but much of this capability is lost when those locations must be predicted. Access to the intact original code helps the model fill multiple edit regions, yet does not resolve the difficulty of selecting those regions. By varying the editable regions while holding the generation model and decoding procedure fixed, we identify two distinct requirements for successful editing: covering every required change and placing precise boundaries around it. Missing a required region prevents the corresponding change, while widening regions to ensure coverage can sharply reduce success by requiring unchanged code to be regenerated. A sentence-level Wiki editing probe shows the same qualitative gap between supplied and predicted locations beyond code. These findings show why strong infilling capability alone does not ensure reliable editing: the interface must expose all required changes while limiting regeneration of unchanged code.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了掩码扩散语言模型(MDLM)在代码编辑任务中的四种编辑接口(全文重写、搜索替换、定位填充、寻位填充、token级编辑),发现MDLM具备已知位置的多区域协同填充能力,但当编辑位置需自行预测时能力大幅下降,即"组合鸿沟"。通过受控脚手架干预实验,作者将成功的编辑拆解为两个独立要求:覆盖所有必需修改区域与精确界定边界,二者缺一不可。
AI.motivation: 指令式代码编辑需要模型决定"在哪里改"(位置)与"改什么"(内容),同时保持其他代码不变。掩码扩散模型的双向去噪能力在理论上天然适合多区域填充,但如何设计编辑接口以让模型有效利用这一能力尚不清楚。本文旨在探究不同编辑接口如何分配"结构决策"与"内容生成"职责,以及为何已知位置的填充能力不能直接转化为可靠的自主编辑。
AI.method: 1. 定义并实现四种扩散代码编辑接口(全文重写、搜索替换、定位-后填充、token级编辑);2. 在CanItEdit基准上以DiffuCoder-Instruct为基座进行微调;3. 采用"oracle定位"控制(提供金色编辑位置)评估已知位置条件下的填充能力上限;4. 设计"匹配脚手架扰动"实验:固定填充器不变,仅改变脚手架几何形状(丢区域、扩边界、加假阳性孔),分离覆盖与边界精度两个独立变量;5. 在FineEdit Wiki上做句子级定向编辑探针,验证"已知位置vs预测位置"差距是否泛化至非代码领域。
AI.result: 在142个多跨度编辑实例上:金色位置+旧代码可见的填充达到25.4% pass@1,而直接搜索替换仅11.3%,预测位置混合方法仅10.6%,证实组合鸿沟存在。覆盖实验:丢失一个必需跨度降至6.3%,扩大每个边界±1行降至7.7%,加一个紧假阳性孔仍保持20.4%。Wiki探针显示0.927(金色)vs 0.376(预测)的编辑F1差距。结论:定位是主要瓶颈,边界精度同样关键,仅靠填充能力不足以实现可靠编辑。
AI.conclusion: 扩散代码编辑的核心不在于填充能力本身,而在于编辑接口如何划分结构分配、内容生成与源码保留。成功的编辑需同时满足两个独立要求:(1)覆盖所有必需修改;(2)精确界定边界避免过度重构正确代码。强填充能力不能保证可靠编辑——接口必须既能暴露所有必需修改,又能限制未修改代码的再生。这些控制原则为评估未来扩散编辑器提供了诊断框架。

title: ContextAdapt: Evaluating Contextual Adaptation and Value Alignment in LLMs
summary: Values such as honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality are often regarded as general principles underpinning AI alignment. However, what it means to act in accordance with these values can depend on the context in which a decision is made. In this paper, we ask whether large language models (LLMs) appropriately adapt the application of a value across professional settings, while remaining consistent when contextual changes do not alter the relevant professional norm. To study this, we introduce ContextAdapt, an evaluation framework covering honesty, autonomy, and confidentiality across medicine, law, finance, and national security. Drawing on primary-source professional and regulatory documents, we construct a value x domain framework and use this to develop scenarios testing both default professional rules and recognised exceptions. We evaluate 12 LLMs on both the actions they recommend and the justifications they provide. In our main experiment, models achieve 95.6% mean appropriateness, although the use of the correct domain-specific justification varies substantially across models, from 25.6% to 76.9%. In a separate factorial experiment, explicitly naming the professional domain and changing the role of the model have limited effect on behaviour. Varying stakes, however, reveals severe but localised failures: in some cases, models alter their responses even though the underlying professional obligation remains unchanged. In particular, perceived severity appears to act as a cue for disclosure across both honesty and confidentiality scenarios. These results show that evaluating value alignment requires us to consider not only whether models follow abstract principles, but whether they apply them appropriately across different contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContextAdapt评估框架,用于评估大语言模型在不同职业情境下能否恰当调整抽象价值观(诚实、自主、保密)的应用方式,同时在情境变化不改变职业规范时保持一致性。通过构建基于一手专业文献的价值×领域矩阵,对12个LLM进行主实验和因子实验,发现模型平均恰当性高达95.6%,但在专业依据使用上差异显著(25.6%–76.9%);领域标签和角色变化影响有限,但"风险高低"操控引发了严重但局部的失败,严重程度充当了披露行为的线索。
AI.motivation: 现有AI对齐研究多关注模型在抽象原则上是否一致,而忽视了同一价值在不同职业情境下应有不同的行为操作化方式。例如医疗中的诚实允许治疗特权例外,法律中的诚实以法庭为先。如何评估模型能否识别情境中哪些维度与规范相关、哪些无关,是价值对齐评估的关键缺口。
AI.method: 构建ContextAdapt框架:(1)基于24份一手专业文献建立价值(诚实、自主、保密)×领域(医疗、法律、金融、国家安全)的参考规范矩阵;(2)从领域无关模板派生场景,测试默认规则与例外(含充分证据、证据不足、边界模糊三类探针);(3)评估12个LLM,主数据集107个场景测恰当性,辅数据集144个场景做因子操控(领域标签显隐性、决策者vs顾问角色、高低风险);(4)采用三位LLM评判员(GPT-5.6 Luna、Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite、Command A)从行为恰当性与陈述依据两个维度编码,各模型每场景采样10次。
AI.result: 主实验:12模型平均恰当性95.6%(范围90.7%–99.4%),但正确领域特定依据使用率差异巨大(25.6%–76.9%),不存在按模型规模或训练方法的简单排序;Claude Sonnet 5(97.9%)最高,Command A(91.4%)与Llama 3.1 8B(90.8%)较低。辅实验:显性领域标签影响有限(86.2% vs 85.4%),角色影响小(86.8% vs 84.9%),但风险高低引发显著异质效应(90.7% vs 80.8%);最显著失败为Llama 3.1 70B在医疗×诚实上(100%高风险 vs 8.8%低风险),以及机构导向的国家安全保密(88.5% vs 10.1%);模式表明感知严重程度充当了披露线索。例外探针中欠触发(4.0%)略多于过触发(1.5%)。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出"校准的情境适应性"(calibrated contextual adaptation)概念:模型应在情境改变规范时调整行为,在规范不变时保持稳定。结论表明:(1)平均恰当性高不代表稳健价值学习,需同时评估行为恰当性与专业依据;(2)上下文敏感性不等于价值对齐,需识别哪些情境维度与规范相关;(3)基于原则的对齐方法(如Constitutional AI)需要更丰富的角色、目标、阈值、例外规范,或模型能可靠地从情境中推断这些结构;(4)评估抽象价值须追问模型是否知道何时该原则应导致不同行动。

title: NinaXander: Feasibility and Limits of Composing Frozen Language Models Across Architecture Families via a Shared Latent Space
summary: In this paper we propose NinaXander, a series of composed language models obtained by connecting layers of frozen language models from different architecture families with a single trained shared-latent adapter. A composed model runs the first layers of one model, converts the resulting intermediate representation once with the adapter, and then runs the remaining layers of the other model. Once the adapter is trained, several composed models that connect at different layers are obtained without retraining. Using the recurrent RWKV-4-Raven-7B and the Transformer-based Tulu-Pythia-6.9b, abbreviated as RWKV and Pythia, this study examines whether frozen models from different families can be recombined post hoc. The composed models answered multiple-choice questions, and those whose generations we examined produced syntactically well-formed text. The configuration that combines the first 5 layers of Pythia with the remaining 27 layers of RWKV reduced the Transformer key-value (KV) cache by 84.4% with accuracy not significantly different from that of RWKV alone. In multiple-choice accuracy, however, no composed model matched the parent model Pythia, and language-modeling performance decreased sharply on WikiText, a corpus of Wikipedia articles outside the training domain. The correspondence between intermediate representations was also obtained in one favorable case, with a shared tokenizer, the same depth, and the same hidden width, and does not show that the models share a general semantic space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NinaXander方法，通过训练一个共享潜在适配器(shared-latent adapter)将不同架构家族(RWKV循环模型与Transformer)的冻结语言模型在某一中间层进行拼接，生成"嵌合体"模型。以RWKV-4-Raven-7B和Tulu-Pythia-6.9b为父模型，仅用一个适配器即可在多个切换层获得多个嵌合体模型而无需重训。核心发现：(1)层间共享表征可学得(居中相关系数0.901)；(2) Pythia→RWKV(L=4)配置将Transformer KV缓存减少84.4%，且准确率与RWKV单独使用时无显著差异；(3)没有任何嵌合体超越更强的父模型Pythia；(4)域外WikiText上的语言建模性能急剧下降；(5)仅在共享分词器、相同深度和相同隐藏宽度的有利条件下成立，不表明模型共享通用语义空间。
AI.motivation: 现有改变语言模型推理时特性(如KV缓存大小)的方法需要重新预训练或微调整个模型，代价巨大。已有研究仅在同系列Transformer间或微调整个组合模型的情况下连接冻结模型，尚未探索跨架构家族(RNN类 vs Transformer类)将冻结检查点重组为组合模型的可行性。本文旨在探究是否可以通过小型训练网络(适配器)将不同家族冻结模型的中间表征相互转换，从而在冻结状态下拼接不同家族的模型层。
AI.method: 方法核心是共享潜在适配器(shared-latent adapter)，包含两个编码器E_A、E_B和两个解码器D_A、D_B，将两个模型的标准化残差映射到共享潜在空间(d_z=4096)。训练目标包含三项：自重构误差(A→A和B→B)、潜在对齐误差(λ‖z_A−z_B‖²，λ=1)、以及解码前的高斯噪声(σ=0.4)以防止潜在被公共模式(common mode)主导。适配器参数量268.5M(占父模型参数1.9%)，由输入线性投影、一个残差块和输出线性投影组成。在两个父模型(A=RWKV-4-Raven-7B, B=Tulu-Pythia-6.9b，均为32层、隐藏宽度4096、共享GPT-NeoX分词器)相同索引层对处进行训练，使用Alpaca训练集的2075个序列(232k标记位置)。训练后在指定的"切换层L"将前段模型的残差经适配器转换一次传给后段模型，构成嵌合体模型。比较4种配置：RWKV自重构控制、RWKV→Pythia、Pythia自重构控制、Pythia→RWKV，切换层L∈{4,8,16,24}。
AI.result: 1) 表征对齐：训练后共享潜在空间的居中相关系数ρ_ctr=0.901，跨家族读出R²(A→B)=0.559, B→A=0.590；随机重排后ρ_ctr降至0.000，读出R²降至负值，确认基于逐标记对应而非分布重叠。2) 准确性：8个嵌合体在ARC-Easy和SciQ选择题上均超过随机水平(25%)，但均显著低于更强父模型Pythia(ARC 65.3%, SciQ 81.0%)。仅RWKV→Pythia(L=4)在SciQ上显著超过RWKV。3) KV缓存：Pythia→RWKV(L=4)将Transformer层从32减至5，KV缓存减少84.4%(2.00→0.31 GiB)，准确率与RWKV相当。在保留≤17个Transformer层的5个配置中，嵌合体显著优于同等层数Pythia早期退出。4) 非线性分析：去除适配器非线性部分(α→0)使读出R²降至负值，准确率降低11-40个百分点(p<2×10⁻⁹)。5) 域外性能：WikiText上Pythia→RWKV(L=4)困惑度45.00(512上下文)，仍远高于RWKV的8.27；域内Alpaca上接近父模型。6) 生成质量：生成的文本句法良好(正确回答法国首都等)，但存在事实错误和格式偏离。
