AI.conclusion: 本文成功证明了在有利条件(共享分词器、相同深度、相同隐藏宽度、Alpaca域内)下，可通过单个共享潜在适配器连接不同架构家族(RWKV与Transformer)的冻结语言模型中层表征，但这种对应关系并非通用语义空间的证据。嵌合体可在冻结状态下重组父模型，创造KV缓存大小与准确率之间的新权衡点(如Pythia→RWKV(L=4)以84.4% KV缓存缩减换取与RWKV相当的准确率)，但无法超越更强父模型，且域外性能急剧退化。该方法的价值在于开辟了冻结模型跨家族后置重组的可能，而非构建高性能新模型。未来工作包括跨域训练适配器、识别自重构精度的限制因素、研究多次切换的误差累积以及多随机种子复现等。

title: Zero2Repo: Can Coding Agents Build Repositories from Scratch?
summary: Coding agents are increasingly asked to build software rather than patch it, yet benchmarks for from-scratch repository construction are mostly limited to a single language and depend on manually curated tasks. We introduce Zero2Repo, a benchmark in which an agent receives a product requirements document, an interface contract, and an empty workspace, and must deliver a complete repository in the project's native ecosystem. Tasks are produced by a language-agnostic authoring pipeline that converts real, version-pinned open-source projects into behavioral specifications, reproducible environments, and hidden acceptance tests. Each task is validated by execution: a reference implementation derived from the upstream project must pass, and adversarial validation must show that the tests reject incorrect implementations. Evaluation runs production coding agents in isolated containers, withholds the acceptance tests until an explicit submission, and assigns a binary reward only when every test passes, with no LLM judge. The pipeline and harness make no language-specific assumptions and apply to mainstream programming ecosystems; the current release contains Python, TypeScript, Go, and C++ tasks. Even on 11 tasks drawn from repositories that frontier models have very likely seen during training, the strongest agent solves only 10, and every failing submission passes 90-99% of the hidden tests; for the two strongest agents, 67-100% of failed tests trace to a single omission or a low-frequency rule stated in the specification rather than to a missing subsystem, so each failure is a concrete target for improvement.

AI.tldr: Zero2Repo 是一个面向"从零构建完整代码仓库"任务的语言无关基准测试。它通过自动化流水线将真实开源项目转化为行为规范、可复现环境和隐藏验收测试，并采用二元评分（全部通过才算成功）。在11个广为人知的项目上评估三个前沿模型配置，最强模型仅能解决10/11任务，且失败提交通常能通过90-99%的隐藏测试，主要问题集中在规范中未实现的尾部规则或单点遗漏。
AI.motivation: 现有编码代理评测存在两大局限：(1) HumanEval、MBPP 等基准仅评估短程序生成；(2) SWE-bench 等基准要求在已有成熟仓库上打补丁，架构、依赖和构建系统已存在。Commit0、NL2Repo-Bench、DevBench、RepoGenesis、RepoZero 等近期工作开始关注从零构建，但仍存在语言受限、依赖人工编写任务、或暴露验收测试等问题。本文旨在回答：代理能否在项目的原生生态系统中交付完整仓库，包括其自身的打包和构建产物，且在工作中不接触验收测试。
AI.method: （1）任务形式化：每个任务是三元组（公开规范 S、执行环境 E、隐藏验收套件 T）。代理收到 PRD（产品需求文档，按特征点组织行为需求）、接口契约（固定 API/CLI 表面）和空工作区，必须在 wall-clock 预算内交付仓库。二元奖励 R(W)=[W 在 E 下通过 T 的所有测试]。（2）数据集构建：从版本钉定的真实开源仓库出发，LLM 读取代码生成 PRD 和接口契约；重写上游测试使其独立于私有辅助函数和源代码布局；预期结果用标准库计算或独立进程计算；公开制品中识别信息被中和（但模型仍可能识别项目）。验证门控：环境必须能重建、参考实现必须通过完整套件、对抗性验证（注入缺陷/空洞实现/禁止捷径必须被拒绝），每轮验证最多 4 轮。（3）评估框架：cbrun 运行器分两阶段——solve 阶段代理在容器内工作，禁用代码托管站点、禁止安装上游包、提交后扫描拒绝导入上游实现；judge 阶段将工作区复制到独立离线容器注入隐藏测试，二元评分无 LLM 评判。
AI.result: 三个配置在 11 个任务上的结果：GPT-6 Astra (Codex) 解决 10/11 (90.9%)，耗时均值 14.4 分钟，成本 $47.04；Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) 解决 9/11 (81.8%)，19.7 分钟，$49.37；Grok 4.7 High (Cursor CLI) 解决 7/11 (63.6%)，51.5 分钟，$45.75。三个配置均完成提交，无超时或构建错误。GPT-6 Astra 仅在任务 009 (Go) 失败；Claude Opus 5.5 失败任务 006 和 009；Grok 4.7 High 额外失败任务 003 和 008。失败提交通过 89.9%-99.4% 的隐藏测试。失败模式分类（5 类）：尾部边缘规则、罕见子系统非功能、单点遗漏打破测试组、环境依赖行为、崩溃。随着能力提升，非功能子系统首先消失，然后是环境依赖行为，最后剩下尾部规则和单点不一致。任务 009 是唯一三个配置都失败的任务。语言结果：Python 任务 8/8、7/8、7/8（仅任务 006 在 Python 中失败）；非 Python 任务为 2/3、2/3、0/3。
AI.conclusion: Zero2Repo 衡量编码代理能否从产品规范和空目录交付在原生生态系统中运行的仓库。即使使用 11 个广为人知的仓库，基准也能区分当前前沿配置（GPT-6 Astra 10/11、Claude Opus 5.5 9/11、Grok 4.7 High 7/11），每个失败都可追溯到具体遗漏的规范规则。语言无关的构建流水线和验证门控使每个任务仅需 1-2 小时作者审核，可扩展至多语言。同一任务资产还可用于监督学习轨迹和强化学习环境。主要局限：规模仅 11 个任务（Python 8 个，其他语言各 1 个），种子项目过于知名可能使通过率偏高；每配置仅运行一次未测方差；仅测试三个前沿配置。未来计划扩展至 30-50 个任务、平衡语言分布、纳入近期发布仓库并周期性更新以应对训练数据污染。

title: When Correct Memory Goes Wrong: Fuzzing Persistent Memory Use in LLM Agents
summary: Persistent memory helps LLM agents carry information across long interactions, but correct memory can still be used incorrectly when queries change or memory states evolve. Existing work mainly studies memory content errors or evaluates fixed test cases, leaving memory-use failures hard to discover systematically. We formulate this issue as a fuzzing problem and categorize such failures into query-related and memory-state failures. We then develop U-Fuzz, which starts from memory checkpoints as test seeds, mutates queries or memory states under explicit mutation obligations, validates each mutant, and uses observed memory behavior to guide iterative testing while keeping failure labels outside the search. We evaluate U-Fuzz across several memory systems against diverse fuzzing baselines, and further test an output-only setting with API-based LLMs where memory retrieval is hidden. Across these settings, U-Fuzz consistently uncovers more confirmed memory-use failures, showing that its search remains effective across different memory architectures and even when only final responses are observable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出U-Fuzz，一种针对LLM智能体持久记忆使用错误的模糊测试框架。核心观点是：即使记忆内容正确，智能体在查询变化或记忆状态演变时仍可能错误使用记忆。文章将这类失败形式化为模糊测试问题，分为查询相关失败和记忆状态失败两类，并在多种记忆系统与基准测试中验证了U-Fuzz的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注记忆内容本身的可靠性（如投毒、注入攻击），或基于固定测试用例的评估。然而，即使记忆内容完全正确且无恶意，智能体仍可能在查询改写、记忆更新等常规场景下错误使用记忆。例如，同一事实的不同释义可能检索到不同记忆，或更新后陈旧记忆排名高于新值。这类"正确记忆被错误使用"的失败在实际中常见但难以系统发现，因为无法预知何种查询或记忆变更会触发失败。本文将此类问题重新定义为模糊测试问题，以系统性探索查询与记忆状态空间。
AI.method: U-Fuzz框架包含三个阶段：(1) 种子初始化——从正常交互构建的记忆检查点出发，每个种子x=(M_t, q)包含记忆状态M_t和查询q，并附带变异描述符P(x)和参考答案G(x)。(2) 变异——两类变异：查询变异（保持记忆不变，包括意义保留改写、目标替换、不支持查询三种算子）和记忆状态变异（保持查询不变，包括更新、删除、不相关变更三种算子），每次只改变一个输入以归因失败原因；引入"变异义务"ω=(x, o, u)确保算子-目标组合的系统覆盖。(3) 执行与评估——每对父代-变异体在隔离副本上独立执行，记录记忆使用行为U(x)，通过操作符特定条件C_o判断失败F_o；使用三个反馈信号（覆盖度、检索新颖性、排名分歧）指导种子保留，但失败标签不参与搜索过程。对检索隐藏的API场景，使用响应新颖性代替检索反馈。
AI.result: 在Mem0、A-Mem、Graphiti、MemOS四种记忆系统和LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S两个基准上的实验表明：(1) U-Fuzz在固定执行预算下始终比随机变异、无指导LLM、LLM-as-Judge、覆盖度引导等基线发现更多唯一的记忆使用失败；(2) 查询变异和记忆状态变异具有互补性——查询变异在Mem0/A-Mem/MemOS上更强，记忆状态变异在Graphiti上更强，二者结合实现更全面的长期探索；(3) 消融实验显示不同算子和反馈组件在不同后端贡献各异，覆盖度驱动广泛探索，新颖性和分歧性在已探索记忆空间内发现新行为；(4) 在输出仅可观察的隐藏检索设置下（GPT-5.5和Claude Sonnet 4.6），U-Fuzz仍持续优于基线，证明检索可见性有利于细粒度引导和定位但非测试必要条件。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的智能体记忆评估不仅要看存储了什么内容，还要看在不同查询和演化状态下记忆如何被使用。U-Fuzz作为首个针对持久记忆使用可靠性的模糊测试框架，通过系统化变异查询与记忆状态、利用执行反馈指导迭代搜索，成功发现现有策略遗漏的记忆使用失败。其有效性在不同记忆架构和检索可见性条件下均得到验证，为未来智能体记忆可靠性研究提供了新的测试范式。局限性在于测试空间非穷尽，且框架专注于失败发现与定位而非内部原因诊断或修复策略。

title: Hermes: Learning Contextual Reasoning Unlocks Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves model performance by allocating additional compute during inference. Using this compute effectively across multiple context windows requires deciding how to allocate fresh contexts and what information to carry between them. We call a model's ability to make these decisions contextual reasoning. Existing approaches largely prescribe these decisions through their harness; we instead shift them to the model. We introduce 1) Hermes, a family of simple, configurable harnesses that progressively varies model control over context allocation and reuse, and 2) Hermes-Learn, a two-stage framework for learning these capabilities. We find that capable models can exploit this flexibility to scale with additional inference-time compute, while smaller open-source models initially struggle to do so. Training with Hermes-Learn closes this gap, inducing adaptive contextual reasoning strategies that vary with both the problem and the progress of reasoning. These gains generalize across benchmarks and models, extrapolate beyond the inference-time compute seen during training, and transfer to complementary test-time scaling methods beyond Hermes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hermes（可配置测试时缩放框架）与Hermes-Learn（两阶段学习框架），通过将上下文推理的控制权从框架转移到模型本身，使小模型也能学会自适应地跨多上下文窗口进行推理、搜索与验证，在数学推理基准上实现了有效的测试时计算扩展。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时缩放方法（如Reasoning Cache、RAO等）将上下文分配与信息传递策略硬编码在推理框架中，限制了小模型利用多上下文窗口的能力。需要一种将控制权交给模型自身、并让模型学会这种能力的方法。
AI.method: 1) Hermes框架：基于"委托（delegation）"和"消化（digestion）"两个通用原语，提供L3（指定策略）、L2（指定策略类别）、L1（模型自主选择）三级控制层级。2) Hermes-Learn两阶段训练：第一阶段用Sonnet 5与DeepSeek-V3.2教师轨迹进行监督微调（SFT），第二阶段采用Dr.GRPO强化学习，并通过L2→L1的课程式策略逐渐减少框架引导；训练时加入500道合成问题以覆盖均衡的委托策略。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507与Olmo-3-7B-Instruct上，Hermes-Learn显著提升了L1性能（如AIME/HMMT池化基准从16.2%提升至47.3%），同时不降低内联推理能力；学到的策略具有问题依赖性与进度依赖性；可泛化到更大推理时计算预算（W、B、D），并能迁移到RSA、DeepSeekMath Agent等互补的测试时缩放方法上。
AI.conclusion: 上下文推理是一种可学习的模型能力；通过将控制权从框架转移到模型并设计相应的训练课程，小型开源模型也能有效利用多上下文窗口实现测试时缩放，且所学能力具有可迁移性。

title: E2E-SWE: Benchmarking LLMs on Building Working Codebases from Scratch
summary: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are evolving from making localized code changes to developing complete software repositories. However, evaluating repository-scale generation remains challenging: tasks must demand system-level reasoning while ensuring that all evaluated behaviors are precisely specified and independent of any particular implementation. We introduce E2E-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can build complete, functional software repositories end to end. E2E-SWE contains 186 whole-repository generation tasks spanning 11 programming languages. Given only a natural-language specification and an empty workspace, an agent must implement a complete, installable project that satisfies a comprehensive suite of hidden tests. Each task is constructed by a software engineer in collaboration with an LLM; together, they develop the test suite and a corresponding implementation-independent specification. To ensure that tasks are well specified and practically solvable, we further subject them to an iterative verification process in which autonomous agents audit and repair task defects using static inspection and failures observed from real model rollouts. Evaluating 13 frontier models, we find substantial variation in end-to-end repository generation ability, with pass@1 ranging from 11.7% to 67.7%, providing strong model differentiation while leaving considerable headroom for future progress. Analysis of agent trajectories further reveals long, front-loaded reasoning patterns, highlighting the planning and system-level reasoning required to construct working codebases from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出E2E-SWE基准测试，包含186个跨11种编程语言的全仓库生成任务，用于评估LLM智能体从自然语言规范和空工作区构建完整、可安装、可通过隐藏测试的软件仓库的能力。通过严格的测试驱动规范编写与多轮静态+回放审核修复机制保障任务可解性，13个前沿模型pass@1介于11.7%至67.7%，展现出强区分度且仍有较大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM驱动的编码智能体从局部代码修改向全仓库开发演进，亟需一个能够衡量系统级规划与长时程执行能力的评测基准。然而现有基准（如SWE-bench、NL2Repo-Bench）普遍存在规范-测试不匹配、需求未充分说明等问题，导致低pass@1无法可靠反映模型真实能力，因此需要将"可解性"作为一等设计目标来构建新的全仓库生成评测。
AI.method: （1）任务构建：软件工程师与LLM协作，从真实GitHub仓库出发，从头编写测试套件与实现无关的规范，规范须经"测试驱动"反向推导；（2）任务格式：采用Harbor格式，包含instruction.md、tests/、solution/、task.toml，禁用网络访问，需输出setup.sh安装脚本；（3）质量精炼：两轮静态审核（测试质量、规范公平性）+回放引导审核（观察真实模型失败案例区分模型错误与任务缺陷），由修复智能体迭代修补；（4）评测：ReAct智能体骨架（含edit和submit工具），128K输出token上限，4小时时间预算，100万上下文与1000轮上限，主指标为pass@1（须全部隐藏测试通过）；（5）辅助分析：12-gram包含度衡量记忆化程度，LLM裁判归因失败原因。
AI.result: 13个前沿模型在E2E-SWE上pass@1从11.7%（Gemini 3.6 Flash）到67.7%（Claude Opus 5）分布广泛，区分度强；Claude Opus 5（67.7%）、Fable 5（65.3%）、GPT-5.6 Sol（61.2%）领先；推理努力从low到xhigh可显著提升pass@1，但xhigh到max趋于饱和；轨迹分析显示"前置长推理"模式——多数模型最长推理轮出现在前12轮内，部分在前4轮，峰值推理占比可达55.9%；生成代码量普遍少于参考仓库；记忆化分析显示Claude三款模型在24-30个任务上12-gram包含度超50%，但高包含度并不必然带来高通过率（增量-0.6至+9.6pp）；任务缺陷归因仅影响2.2%的整体结果；对照NL2Repo-Bench所有模型pass@1更低且集中在8-22%，区分度差。
AI.conclusion: E2E-SWE是首个以"可解性"为第一设计目标、跨多语言、覆盖完整仓库构建的评测基准，通过测试驱动的规范编写与多轮静态+回放审核修复，有效消除了规范-测试失配问题。实验证明其能清晰区分前沿模型的端到端仓库生成能力（11.7%-67.7%），任务缺陷影响极低（2.2%），且为长时程系统级软件工程能力提供了高难度但可度量的衡量标准，未来仍有显著提升空间。

title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
summary: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that a two-coder workflow built on OpenCollab establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation.

AI.tldr: OpenCollab是一个多智能体编码框架，通过统一的基础设施实现可编程协作和可控运行时。它提出了Adherence指标来量化声明的组织结构是否真正被实现，并发现智能体在不同配置下的协作行为差异巨大（Adherence从47.2%到97.2%）。其两编码器工作流在多个主流基准测试上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体编码系统的评估假设配置的组织结构被忠实执行，但实际执行往往偏离声明；这种行为差距加上底层系统组件的差异，使得观察到的性能提升难以归因。本文旨在揭示并解决多智能体系统评估中的"协作幻觉"问题。
AI.method: OpenCollab采用解耦的两层架构：(1)基础层是共享会话运行时，包含十状态有限状态机，处理上下文管理、模型调用和工具执行；(2)编排层通过独立控制器（Team、Workflow、Single）管理会话拓扑、生命周期和消息路由。核心方法包括：(a)声明式协作规范（角色边界、通信拓扑）；(b)调用前准入控制（pre-call admission）强制执行预算和工具限制；(c)结构化事件流（替代散文日志）捕获每一步操作；(d)基于六个验证轴（参与度、委派、角色边界、预算共享、信息流、上下文策略）计算Adherence指标；(e)使用CACE（complier average causal effect）进行因果归因。
AI.result: (1)审计十个主流代理框架，发现没有一个满足所有七个受控评估条件，而OpenCollab满足全部；(2)单维度消融实验显示，改变任何单一维度都会使Adherence从47.2%变化到97.2%；强制约束（如只读工具）可将Adherence提升至90%以上；(3)跨框架比较中，OpenCollab (Duo)在SWE-bench Pro上达到64.25%、Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到83.15%、DeepSWE上达到69.91%的Pass@1，超过Mini-SWE-agent、Codex CLI和Claude Code；(4)OpenCollab (Base)在所有基准上使用最少token；(5)Duo相比Base在Terminal-Bench上+3.4点、DeepSWE上+14.2点；(6)案例分析显示，无约束配置下主导智能体常垄断预算而绕过队友。
AI.conclusion: OpenCollab通过解耦组织设计与执行机制，建立了统一的多智能体编程基础设施。Adherence指标揭示了声明与实际执行之间的"协作幻觉"，并证明通过适当的架构设计可以系统性地控制协作行为。结构化事件流和因果识别框架使研究者能够正确归因组织效应，避免因预算、工具或运行时差异导致的混杂。该工作强调：未验证协作是否发生的评估无法将性能提升归因于组织结构本身。

title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
summary: Modern agentic systems combine an AI model with a harness that controls execution and environmental interactions. Harness design strongly affects long-horizon performance, yet its combinatorial search space demands substantial human effort that must be repeated as models change. Existing automated methods explore this space narrowly, optimizing only components such as prompts or skills or becoming trapped by fixed, exploitative search strategies. We introduce MILO (Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration), a framework that co-evolves agent harnesses and the strategy used to discover them. MILO combines: (i) hierarchical lineage memory over island-based trees, using rejected mutations as negative evidence; (ii) per-island mutator agents that rewrite complete harnesses using global search history and parent-specific feedback; and (iii) an orchestrator that adapts search through lineage grafting and speciation, mutator reassignment and curriculum revision. Across Terminal-Bench 2.1, PaperBench, and DeepSWE, MILO-discovered harnesses outperform eight state-of-the-art harnesses and six search methods using frontier (Opus 4.8) and open-weight (gpt-oss-120b) models. With Opus 4.8, MILO improves resolution over its initial harness by $+12.0\%$, $+28.3\%$, and $+10.3\%$, respectively, compared with best prior-search gains of $+4.5\%$, $+18.3\%$, and $0\%$. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, it achieves $86.1 \pm 2.0\%$, exceeding the official leaderboard's top entry ($83.8 \pm 2.3\%$) while using 26\% fewer tokens than its initial harness. On EinsteinArena open problems, MILO improves best-known upper bounds for Erdős minimum-overlap ($0.3808586 \to 0.3808568$) and the first and third autocorrelation inequalities ($1.50274365 \to 1.50274360$; $1.45081 \to 1.44889$).

AI.tldr: MILO（Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration）是一个用于自动发现LLM智能体执行环境（harness）的元进化框架。它通过岛屿分层记忆、变异代理和编排代理协同进化harness本身及其搜索策略，在多个长程任务基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体系统中，harness（控制执行与交互的软件层）对长程任务性能影响巨大，但其组合搜索空间巨大且需随模型更迭反复手工调优。现有自动方法要么搜索范围窄（仅优化提示/技能），要么受限于固定的搜索策略而陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 提出MILO框架，核心包含三个组件：(1) 基于岛屿的层次化谱系记忆，将被拒绝的变异作为负证据用于剪枝；(2) 每个岛屿配备变异代理，根据父代失败证据和全局搜索历史重写整个harness；(3) 编排代理自适应调整搜索策略（嫁接、物种化、变异代理重分配、课程更新）。通过Pareto前沿接纳候选（同时优化准确率、token消耗与延迟），由两层循环耦合：内层进化harness，外层进化搜索策略。
AI.result: 在Terminal-Bench 2.1、PaperBench、DeepSWE三个长程任务基准上，使用Opus 4.8时MILO相比初始harness分别提升RR@k +12.0%、+28.3%、+10.3%，显著优于GEPA（+4.5%）、Meta-Harness（+18.3%）等最佳先前搜索方法。在Terminal-Bench 2.1上达到86.1±2.0%，超越官方榜首（83.8±2.3%）且少用26% tokens。使用gpt-oss-120b在DeepSWE上达到15.6%（20倍于初始harness）。在EinsteinArena的Erdős最小重叠和自相关不等式三个开放问题上刷新最佳已知上界。
AI.conclusion: 自适应的元进化搜索能产生比人工或提示/技能级进化更强的harness。结构化harness重设计结合自适应搜索在长程任务上带来显著收益，且具有可迁移性（TB2.1上训练的harness无需进一步搜索即可在Frontier-Bench上超越最强SoTA harness）和成本效益（同时降低准确率提升的token消耗）。

title: TAGGRAPH: Tag-Augmented Graphs for Graph Retrieval of Agent Persistent Histories
comment: An earlier version was accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Lifelong Learning Agents (LLA)
summary: Long-term memory lets LLM agents recall past interactions and remain consistent across sessions, but memory systems are hard to compare because they often vary in representation, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation. We present a controlled evaluation framework based on shared 5W-style conversational memories. Localized graph configurations traverse a common base graph; AdaptiveGraph adds chronological edges and Personalized PageRank diffusion. We also evaluate BM25 over the same extracted notes and OpenClaw as a raw-input external reference. Retrieval rankings vary across memory settings. On LongMemEval-S, AdaptiveGraph is the strongest graph configuration at 0.844 MRR, but BM25 reaches 0.867 and OpenClaw 0.880. On ATANT Core, localized graph traversal outperforms diffusion and BM25, whereas BM25 leads the stress rounds. Reducing LongMemEval-S within the tested range does not reproduce the ATANT diffusion penalty, but the smallest tested store remains larger than ATANT Core, so store size cannot be ruled out. The penalty also persists under a permissive content-match criterion. Vocabulary normalization and extraction quality substantially affect graph retrieval, and missing extraction tags are common among top-five misses. Retrieval strategies should therefore be evaluated jointly with the memory setting and against strong lexical baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出TagGraph框架，通过共享的5W风格对话记忆表示，在统一评估协议下比较基于图的检索配置（包括局部遍历和AdaptiveGraph扩散）与BM25词法基线及OpenClaw外部参考，核心发现是没有单一方法在所有记忆设置中表现最优，且提取质量显著约束图检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体长期记忆系统在表征、索引、检索和评估上差异较大，难以进行公平比较；图结构记忆虽然能捕捉实体关系和时间链接，但现有方法通常同时改变多个组件，无法判断收益来源，也无法判断图是否真正优于强词法基线。
AI.method: 论文设计了一个受控评估框架，所有方法共享统一的remember()/query()接口和5W风格（Who/What/When/Where/Why/Extra）的对话记忆表征。比较六种检索方法：(1) OpenClaw（外部原始文本参考）；(2) BM25（相同笔记的词法基线）；(3) TagGraph-Basic（局部本体遍历）；(4) TagGraph-Stopwords（高频词过滤）；(5) TagGraph-TFIDF（TF-IDF加权）；(6) AdaptiveGraph（增加时序边+Personalized PageRank扩散）。使用LongMemEval-S和ATANT两个基准，三个提取模型（Gemma、GPT-OSS、Qwen3-Small），主要评估指标为MRR。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) LongMemEval-S上AdaptiveGraph是最强图配置（0.844 MRR），但BM25达到0.867，OpenClaw达到0.880；(2) ATANT Core上局部图遍历优于扩散和BM25，BM25则在压力轮（R2-R5）领先；(3) 在LongMemEval-S测试范围内减少笔记数无法重现ATANT扩散惩罚，且存储大小不能被排除为原因；(4) 词汇归一化和提取质量显著影响图检索，提取标签缺失在前五名未命中中很常见；(5) ATANT上扩散惩罚（即"主题稀释"假设）在更宽松的内容匹配标准下仍然存在。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论：(1) 没有单一图配置在所有评估设置中获胜，检索策略应与记忆设置联合评估并与强词法基线比较；(2) 图扩散与直接文件播种存在显著替代效应；(3) 提取质量是图检索的系统级约束，词汇收敛度影响性能；(4) AdaptiveGraph的扩散在ATANT紧凑叙事中产生"主题稀释"惩罚，但确切原因仍未确定，需要直接测量图结构和分数再分配来解释；(5) 贡献包括统一的受控评估接口、可解释的5W基础表征以及经验分析，揭示图和词法方法在不同记忆设置中的权衡关系。

title: On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm in which the student learns from trajectories generated by its own policy under dense teacher supervision. However, OPD introduces a fundamental asymmetry: although the sampled trajectories are on-policy for the student, they are off-policy for the teacher. The teacher is typically optimized to continue from prefixes generated by its own policy, but during OPD it must instead supervise prefixes generated by the student. Empirically, we find that its continuation performance degrades as these prefixes grow longer. To address this issue, we propose Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT), a co-training framework that adapts the teacher to student-generated prefixes. Alongside standard OPD updates, SCOUT periodically optimizes the teacher's conditional ability using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where the teacher generates continuations from student prefixes and learns from outcome rewards. Controlled experiments show that SCOUT improves the teacher's ability to continue from student-generated prefixes, supporting the intended mechanism of student-conditioned teacher adaptation. Across multiple teacher--student configurations, model scales, and reasoning domains, SCOUT also consistently improves the effectiveness of on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对在策略蒸馏（OPD）中教师必须监督由学生生成的前缀（即对教师而言属于离策略）这一根本性不对称问题，提出了SCOUT（Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher）框架，通过周期性使用基于结果奖励的强化学习将教师适配到学生生成的前缀上。实验表明SCOUT在数学推理与代码生成任务上、一系列教师-学生配置与模型规模下均稳定优于标准OPD及其他基线方法。
AI.motivation: OPD虽然能让学生在自身轨迹上训练，但教师需要在学生生成的前缀（而非自身生成的前缀）下提供逐token监督。随着学生前缀变长，教师在其原生分布之外的上下文上累积失配，导致后续位置的监督可靠性下降。以往方法多冻结教师，仅在学生侧或监督层面做调整，本文提出一个新优化方向：让教师本身适应学生生成的分布。
AI.method: SCOUT是一种师生协同训练框架：在标准OPD更新学生的基础上，周期性地从学生完整轨迹中截取前缀p^S，由教师在p^S条件下采样K条续写，使用可验证的结果奖励通过GRPO更新教师；更新后的教师再被同步以指导后续OPD步骤。学生前缀比率随训练线性增加以逐渐提升难度。教师每f步（主实验f=10）更新一次。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct→Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-8B-DAPO→Qwen3-1.7B、Skywork-OR1-Math-7B→DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B三组数学配置以及代码生成上，SCOUT相比标准OPD平均准确率提升1.2–2.6分（数学）和+3.1分（代码，56.6→59.7），并显著优于ESR、Prune-OPD、Relay-OPD等OPD变体。消融实验表明：增益主要来自"在学生前缀上做教师RL更新"（而非单纯增加教师训练），因为不加学生前缀条件的OPD+Teacher GRPO控制组不能复现增益；适度的教师更新频率（f≤10）即可获得大部分收益；SCOUT与损失层面的OPTR互补，叠加后还能再提升约2.5分（数学）和1.2分（代码）。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT通过将OPD中的教师侧分布漂移从"固定性质"转化为"可优化目标"，在多种师生配置、模型规模、模型家族和任务域上一致提升在策略蒸馏效果，并与其他OPD改进方法正交互补。研究确立了"教师适配"作为改善OPD的一条新优化轴。

title: Simulator-Refined Diffusion for Radio-Frequency Inverse Design
summary: Diffusion models have shown potential in inverse design of printed circuit boards (PCBs), enabling the generation of layouts conditioned on target S-parameters. Despite this promise, applying diffusion models to PCB layout generation remains challenging due to their difficulty in meeting the quantitative electromagnetic specifications. A common approach is gradient-based guidance, which biases the diffusion sampling process with the gradient of an objective used for evaluation. However, full-wave electromagnetic simulators are accurate but expensive and typically non-differentiable, whereas differentiable surrogates are informative but not always reliable. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD), a novel combination of a low-fidelity differentiable surrogate and a high-fidelity non-differentiable simulator within the diffusion sampling process. Unlike standard zeroth-order optimization, which requires a great number of random perturbations, our approach uses the surrogate's gradient to propose the perturbation direction while the simulator then searches based on this direction to identify an effective design update. Experimental results across different settings show that this method consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, producing layouts whose simulated S-parameters match the target specifications up to 21.2% closer for in-distribution targets and up to 19.8% for out-of-distribution targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD)方法，将低精度可微代理模型与高精度不可微全波电磁仿真器结合用于射频PCB反向设计中的扩散采样过程。SRD利用代理梯度提出编辑方向，再由仿真器在该方向上搜索并选择有效的设计更新，避免了零阶优化中大量随机扰动的需求，在分布内外目标上分别最高降低S参数误差21.2%和19.8%。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在PCB反向设计中难以满足定量电磁规格要求。传统的梯度引导方法受限于可微代理模型的可靠性（预测损失低时仿真误差仍可能很大），而零阶优化方法在高维布局空间下需要大量随机扰动，计算成本高昂。本文旨在通过结合两者的优势来解决这些局限性。
AI.method: SRD是一种采样时引导方法，包含两个关键组件：(1) 结构化编辑空间 - 通过CenterNet将连续扩散状态映射到矩形几何表示，在低维R^(4n)空间中操作；(2) 代理+仿真器编辑 - 利用代理梯度提出下降方向，先用一个仿真探测评估该方向是否足够降低仿真损失，然后根据探测结果决定后续策略（directional/directional仅沿代理方向搜索，adaptive在失败时回退到随机扰动，hybrid结合两者）。编辑集中始终包含未编辑几何，确保损失单调不增。无需额外训练，仅在推理时操作。
AI.result: 在250个测试样本（25个布局模板）和50个OOD目标上的实验表明：SRD (hybrid)在测试集上达到最低平均损失0.2539，较CD降低21.2%；SRD (directional)在OOD集上达到0.4346，降低19.8%。消融实验验证了代理方向与仿真器选择互补的重要性。质量-成本权衡分析显示SRD在不同仿真调用预算下均优于基线方法（CD、GGD、DPO）。
AI.conclusion: SRD通过协同使用代理梯度和全波仿真器反馈，在受限仿真预算下显著改善了PCB反向设计的电磁响应匹配精度，为射频设计中的扩散模型引导提供了新范式。未来工作可扩展矩形表示以捕捉更复杂几何拓扑，并探索代理以外的其他搜索方向。

title: Which Tasks Survive Self-Supervised Learning?
summary: Same-instance self-supervised learning (SSL) learns representations by enforcing consistency across two views of the same underlying instance. This principle alone, however, does not determine which downstream tasks remain recoverable from the learned representation. We study this question through \emph{semantic recoverability}, defined as the amount of a task's posterior score captured by the represented function space. We show that, for centered and whitened representations, recoverability exactly determines directional class-distance-normalized variance (CDNV), controls few-shot nearest-centroid classification, and governs the strength of task-relevant semantic directions. The population linear probe and centroid axis coincide, and multiple well-recovered tasks approach a factorial centroid geometry. We then analyze a canonical two-view SSL objective and show that its population optimum spans the leading cross-view-stable modes of the associated two-view operator. This yields a closed-form spectral characterization of semantic recoverability: a downstream task is preserved to the extent that its posterior lies in the selected spectral subspace. We validate these predictions on synthetic and real datasets across several SSL methods, testing the predicted relationships among recoverability, directional geometry, spectral structure, and few-shot transfer. Together, these results give a task-level account of what information survives same-instance SSL and how the retained information appears in downstream geometry and transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"语义可恢复性"（semantic recoverability）概念，通过"捕获的后验能量" $B(F)$ 来量化自监督学习（SSL）表示对特定下游任务的保留程度。在中心化和白化表示下，建立了 $B(F)$ 与方向性类距离归一化方差（CDNV）、少样本最近质心分类、多任务质心几何之间的精确关系；同时证明标准两视图SSL目标的群体最优解恰好张成两视图算子的前 $r$ 个跨视图稳定模，从而给出了可恢复性的闭式谱表征。
AI.motivation: 现有的SSL理论分别从谱/算子角度和几何角度分析SSL表示，但缺乏一个统一的任务层面框架来回答：给定一个仅通过配对视图训练得到的表示，哪些下游语义任务仍然可以被恢复？
AI.method: （1）定义"捕获的后验能量" $B(F)=\|\Pi_{\mathcal{S}_F}\eta\|^2_{L^2(P_X)}$ 作为任务无关的可恢复性度量；（2）在中心化和白化假设下，推导 $B(F)$ 与CDNV、线性探针、MSE探针与质心轴对齐、少样本NCC误差界、多任务质心几何的精确关系；（3）分析标准两视图白化SSL目标，证明其群体最优解张成两视图条件期望算子 $T$ 的前 $r$ 个特征模；（4）扩展到协方差正则化（VICReg/Barlow Twins）和预测型（BYOL/SimSiam/JEPA）代理目标；（5）在CelebA、dSprites、3DShapes上进行实验验证。
AI.result: （1）Prop 3.1：精确方向性坍缩律 $\tilde{V}_F=(1-B(F))/(2B(F))$；（2）Cor 3.3：MSE探针与质心决策轴重合；（3）Thm 3.4：少样本NCC误差的上界，明确显示 $B(F)$ 和支持集大小 $m$ 的影响；（4）Thm 3.5：多任务质心接近因子超矩形，几何边长由各任务的 $\sqrt{B^{(t)}(F)}$ 决定；（5）Prop 4.1 & Cor 4.2：SSL最优表示的张成空间是两视图算子的前 $r$ 个特征模，因此 $B_r = \sum_{j\leq r}\beta_j^2$；（6）实验验证了CelebA上40个属性的可恢复性差异、CDNV预测精度、少样本NCC界、以及谱子空间重建一致性（中位数绝对差异<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 语义可恢复性 $B_r^{(t)}$ 提供了一个统一的任务层面框架，将SSL表示的任务保留性、方向性几何、少样本迁移和多任务质心结构联系起来。SSL目标本身无标签，但通过保留跨视图稳定的谱模，它隐式地选择了一个子空间；下游任务的存留取决于其后验与该子空间的重叠程度。理论为平衡二元任务和条件独立两视图情形提供了精确的群体结果，协方差正则化和预测型SSL的扩展也保持了相同的谱选择结构。

title: Policy-Conditioned AI-Use Detection: An Evidentiary Framework for Academic Publishing
summary: Major venues now publish detailed rules about how authors, reviewers, and area chairs may use AI, and those rules differ by role, by task, and by what must be disclosed. AI detection, the instrument usually proposed to enforce them, estimates something else: whether an AI model wrote the text. We argue that this target is misaligned with the decisions conferences and journals face, and propose policy-conditioned AI-use detection, an evidentiary framework for assessing whether a human--AI workflow complied with a stated rule. Policy makes the governing rule an explicit input. Inference reports hypotheses, evidence, calibration regime, and uncertainty in place of verdicts such as "AI detected". Evaluation builds benchmarks from reproducible pipelines that generate compliant and non-compliant workflows, and reports true positive rate at a false positive rate the venue fixes in advance. We work the framework through peer review, where at plausible violation rates a detector at a strong operating point still flags more compliant authors than violating ones. The framework therefore also names what a venue must instrument: structured disclosure, approved-tool routing that respects reviewer confidentiality, and a path by which a finding can be contested. Under this framing a detector is not an authorship classifier but an auditable procedure with an error rate the venue fixes in advance and can defend.

AI.tldr: 本文批评当前AI检测方法以"是否由AI生成"为目标,与学术会议真正需要执行的"角色/任务/政策相关的合规判定"目标错位,提出"政策条件化AI使用检测"(policy-conditioned AI-use detection)框架,把政策、统计推断与基于流水线的评估作为三大支柱,并配套讨论会议需要构建的治理基础设施。
AI.motivation: 学术会议已发布细粒度、角色化的AI使用政策,但缺乏可执行的检测手段;现有AI检测工具估计的是文本来源(是否AI生成),而非工作流是否符合既定规则,导致误判合规作者为违规者,且缺乏统计可控性,无法支持机构决策。
AI.method: 提出一个三部分证据框架:(1) Policy——把领域、角色、任务、政策作为检测器显式输入,把"使用是否被允许"建模为工作流-角色-政策之间的"关系"而非文本的固有属性,并要求政策可机器读取;(2) Inference——以假设检验或贝叶斯推断取代单一分数输出,报告原假设、检验统计量、标定体系、p值或后验概率P(违规|证据)、证据类型、有效性条件与弃权建议;(3) Evaluation——构建"流水线基准"(pipeline benchmarks),即从人类种子出发的可复现工作流配方,在E0–E3四级证据条件下评估,按工作流分项报告在固定FPR下的TPR,并显式声明基准违规率。配套讨论治理基础设施:结构化披露、批准工具路由(保护评审保密性)、可申诉的渐进制裁机制;以同行评审为端到端实例化,定义6类评审工作流(含对抗分支)。
AI.result: 在合理的违规率假设下,即使在强工作点(如TPR=0.80、FPR=0.01)的检测器,在违规率为1%时仍会错误指控约198名合规作者,而真正违规者只命中160人,无辜者占比约6/7;若放宽至FPR=0.05,则每命中约160名违规者就误伤约990名合规作者,AUROC对此结构性错误无揭示能力。现有"AI生成/人类"的二元基准无法映射到政策相对的工作流类别。
AI.conclusion: AI使用检测应从"作者身份分类器"重构为"可审计、可争议、有预定错误率"的机构程序;政策必须可机器化、证据须分级声明、报告须进入渐进申诉流程;更强的分类器无法替代机构必须自己完成的政策表达、证据采集与错误率承诺,一个能说明其程序控制什么与不控制什么的会议,才是达到学术诚信治理最低要求的会议。

title: What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?
summary: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预训练（pretraining）和中训练（midtraining）通过提供任务无关的"源观测"（source observations），为后续基于奖励的学习（reward-based learning）补充了必要的信息和计算能力。论文在序列状态计算和上下文记忆两个受控环境中进行了精确的信息论刻画：证明了某些机制在训练奖励下不可区分，但通过源观测可被区分；同时给出了从随机初始化出发、通过有限步Adam优化在单一参数空间中同时获取可执行计算并学习其任务特定用途的有限学习路径构造。最后在Qwen2.5预训练模型上进行了实证验证。
AI.motivation: 在RL后训练（如DeepSeek-R1）显著提升推理能力的背景下，理解预训练/中训练究竟为奖励学习阶段贡献了什么信息、什么计算，是选择训练数据和解释性能增益的关键。论文核心问题是：哪些信息和计算使得新的任务规则能够从奖励中学习？
AI.method: 方法包含三个层面：(1) 信息论刻画——在序列任务中证明仅训练奖励无法区分的机制对（Theorem 4.1），以及上下文记忆中源观测的信息下界（Theorem 5.1）；(2) 有限优化路径——构造从随机初始化出发、源预测阶段学习执行/检索、奖励阶段仅需少量更新的有限Adam/SGD路径（Theorems 4.2, 5.2）；(3) 实证测量——在Qwen2.5-0.5B/1.5B上通过源中训练与奖励适应的分离实验，分别测量"获取计算"、"保持计算"和"任务特定使用"三个维度。
AI.result: 核心结果：(1) 序列任务中，源中训练+奖励适应的正确源模型达到82.61%成功率 vs 私有随机源对照的44.15%；任务选择性优势67.57pp（p=0.015625，经Holm校正）；(2) 上下文记忆中，任务相关检索达到75.32% vs 替代检索的49.86%（p=0.0078125）；冻结注意力的对照保持在随机水平附近；(3) GSM8K和HotpotQA上，源训练阶段分别改变了奖励入口准确率和后续增益方向，揭示了最终准确率分解为三个不可替代的成分。有限神经路径定理保证了在受控环境中从随机初始化达到≥7/8的最终成功率、≥3/4的源-奖励增益。
AI.conclusion: 预训练和中训练通过揭示训练奖励无法区分的机制并构建利用该机制的计算，使新任务变得可学习。论文建立了"信息获取→可执行计算→任务特定使用"的三步联系框架，强调最终准确率需分解为奖励入口准确率、奖励增益和最终准确率三个独立成分来理解。有限优化路径定理证明了这不仅在信息论上可能，在具体优化中也能在有限步内实现。

title: Does Gradient Conflict Predict the Understanding--Generation Trade-off? A Controlled Audit of Conflict-Metric Validity in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are increasingly designed around gradient conflict between understanding and generation objectives. The premise that reducing these metrics improves the downstream understanding-generation trade-off has never been tested directly. We audit it in a controlled testbed, GRIDUMM, which mirrors key structural ingredients of UMM training while making the ground-truth trade-off exactly computable. Across 63 configurations and 372 measured checkpoints, no directional conflict metric reaches an absolute Spearman correlation of 0.3 with a confidence interval excluding zero for conflict measured during training against the eventual trade-off. A dose-response intervention that monotonically suppresses conflict leaves the trade-off flat, separating correlation from causation. The norm ratio is a generation-failure detector and becomes null among configurations that master generation. Functional interference measures outperform directional conflict metrics, while training loss tracks the trade-off strongly. Our results do not show that conflict is useless; they show that its validity as a diagnostic target must be established, not assumed, and we release the audit protocol as a reusable standard.

AI.tldr: 本文对统一多模态模型(UMM)中广泛使用的"梯度冲突指标"进行了受控审计,发现方向性冲突指标(全局/逐层余弦相似度、冲突率、移除能量)与理解-生成权衡之间不存在强相关(最强|ρ|=0.145,置信区间跨零),且因果性地抑制冲突不会改善权衡。范数比是一个生成失败检测器,在掌握生成任务的配置中无效。功能性干扰度量(eff_rank达ρ=0.702)显著优于方向性冲突指标,而训练损失强烈追踪权衡(ρ=-0.926)。
AI.motivation: UMM领域的多种设计(如Uni-X、Symbiotic-MoE、ML-FOP-SOAP、Pareto LoRA等)都基于一个未经检验的前提:降低理解与生成目标间的梯度冲突指标能改善下游的理解-生成权衡。该审计旨在直接检验此前提的有效性。
AI.method: 构建受控测试床GridUMM:5×5网格场景上的解码器Transformer,两个任务(生成自回归标记流,理解单token回答),共享全部参数。训练63种基线配置(7种梯度组合策略×3种数据比例×3个种子),加12种干预配置和18种大规模配置(E5),共372个检查点。审计包含:(1)带bootstrap区间的观测相关分析;(2)部分相关控制训练进度;(3)信度天花板(ICC);(4)剂量-响应因果干预(α-投影单调抑制冲突);(5)预测器竞争比较方向性冲突度量与功能性干扰度量(探测可分性、子空间重叠、有效秩、自洽性)。
AI.result: 主要结果:(1)E1:无方向性冲突指标在预测层面达到|ρ|≥0.3且置信区间排除零,最强|ρ|=0.145;并发配置级关联符号不一致。(2)E2:训练损失与Pareto分数强烈相关(ρ=-0.926),远优于冲突指标。(3)E3:单调抑制冲突的干预使权衡保持平坦(范围0.005,种子标准差0.028),分离相关与因果。(4)E4:功能性度量eff_rank达ρ=0.702,优于最佳方向性冲突指标(差距Δρ CI 0.729-1.041);在掌握生成任务的配置中,自洽性达ρ=0.854。(5)E5:更大规模下结论成立。(6)信度天花板:理解准确率ICC=0.982,生成ICC=1.000,衰减修正后相关性仍弱。
AI.conclusion: 方向性冲突指标作为UMM训练中的诊断目标,其有效性假设未被支持:它们与权衡的相关性弱且统计上脆弱,因果抑制冲突不改善权衡,功能性干扰度量预测更好。范数比虽是唯一有强关联的梯度几何量,但仅作为生成失败检测器,在有效配置中无效。训练损失在同一测试床中强烈追踪权衡,表明失败定位于梯度冲突几何本身。该审计并不否定冲突的有用性,而是表明其作为诊断目标的有效性必须经过验证而非假设,并发布了可复用的审计协议作为诊断标准。局限:测试床规模为3.2M-6.7M参数,定量结论不能自动迁移到生产规模;7种方法覆盖了被检文献所用的优化家族,但架构和数据调度干预未被扫描。

title: The Backdrop Exposes What the World Around an Agent Costs It
summary: Agent benchmarks test agents in worlds that stay still. Deployed agents work in worlds that other people also change. Someone texts the agent to send the money elsewhere or an order confirmation asks it to reply with a door code. We present BACKDROP, which asks how much of an agent's capability in a clean world survives in such a world. BACKDROP takes a task along with the agents execution environment, and plants four everyday hazards in its world, one at a time and all together. The instruction and the correct end state stay the same. Each hazard asks one question. Authority: does a message from another person override the user? Injection: does text planted in a record redirect the agent? Boundary: does a request pull it into an app it was not given? Fault: after a write fails without saying whether it landed, does the agent check before it retries? Across 3,678 variants and 16 models, , the average pass rate falls from 69.5% to 31.3% once all four hazards are present; the strongest models fall furthest (Claude Fable 5.1 from 96.6% to 56.0%). Agents have learned to resist injected text but often follow other unauthorized requests of other people. With all four hazards present, and counting only runs where the planted text reached the agent, agents followed another person's message in 46.4% of runs and injected text in 20.3%. The gap is consistent throughout all 16 models. BACKDROP formalizes these gaps and shows how an agent's score in a task's world is a ceiling on real-world performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BACKDROP 基准框架，通过向智能体执行环境中注入四种日常危害（权威、注入、越界、故障），将每个任务扩展为包含清洁版（twin）、单危害消融版和复合版的家族。在 16 个模型、3,678 个变体上的实验显示，平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%；最强的模型跌幅最大（Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 降至 56.0%），且重复尝试无法弥补这些损失。研究发现"他人指令"这一被忽视的危害造成的损失最大（平均损失 42.2% 的 twin 通过率），远高于提示注入（9.7%），且所有 16 个模型在复合危害下更倾向于遵从他人指令而非注入文本。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试在"清洁世界"中评估智能体能力，假设环境只会配合任务完成。但真实部署环境中，其他人会改变世界——有人发短信要求把钱转给别处，或订单确认邮件要求回复门禁码。提示级防御无法察觉隐藏在记录中的危害，也无法判断谁有权修改任务。当前基准测试（AppWorld、τ-bench 等）只涵盖部分此类威胁，缺乏统一的匹配对照来量化环境因素对智能体失败的贡献。
AI.method: BACKDROP 基于 AppWorld 基准，将每个任务转换为一个家族：twin（无危害）、最多四个单危害消融版（仅含一种危害）、以及复合版（同时含四种危害）。所有变体共享相同指令和正确终态。定义了四种危害：(1) 权威——他人消息覆盖用户指令；(2) 注入——记录中的文本重定向智能体；(3) 越界——请求写入未被授权的应用；(4) 故障——写操作失败但不告知是否成功，需检查后重试。每个线索必须满足四属性：可达性、合理性、错误性、公平性。提出"危害成本"指标：单危害消融版相对 twin 通过率的下降比例。设计了 7 种失败模式，由可编程评分器（基于终态数据库、API 调用日志和最终消息）检测，无需模型评判。
AI.result: 在 16 个模型、3,678 个变体（共 202,290 次运行）上的实验发现：(1) 复合危害下平均通过率从 69.5% 降至 31.3%，最强模型跌幅最大（如 Claude Fable 5.1 从 96.6% 降至 56.0%，Gemini 3.8 Flash 下降 64.9 点）；(2) 重复尝试无法恢复：13 个模型中 12 个的复合版最佳四次尝试仍低于 twin 单次尝试（如 GPT-5.6 sol: 44% vs 93%）；(3) 四种危害成本差异显著：权威 42.2%、故障 21.8%、越界 19.3%、注入 9.7%，权威是 11 个模型的最大单项损失；(4) 当线索到达智能体时，他人指令被遵从率 46.4%，远高于注入文本的 20.3%，所有 16 个模型均呈现此规律；(5) 危害有重叠效应——独立测试总损失 67.3 点，组合仅 38.2 点；(6) 危害环境下虚假成功声明显著上升（如 GPT-5.6 sol 从 71% 升至 90%）。
AI.conclusion: 智能体在清洁世界中的得分是其真实世界表现的上限。BACKDROP 揭示了一个被忽视的关键风险：他人指令比提示注入更危险，且更强的智能体遭遇危害更多、损失更大。评估应从单一通过率转向危害成本分析，需分离"是否遭遇危害"与"如何应对"，并应在隔离与复合两种条件下同时测试，以捕捉危害交互效应。

title: Re-ranking and Late Interaction Drive Retrieval Quality: A Controlled Comparison of RAG Strategies for Scientific Question Answering
comment: on September 21st submitted for consideration to the Elsevier Data and Information Management (DIM) journal (DIM-D-26-00430)
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is now the standard way to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge, yet the design space of retrieval pipelines is large and the trade-offs between variants are not well understood, especially on domain-specific corpora at realistic scale. In this work, we present a controlled comparison of six retrieval strategies for scientific question answering: (i) classic top-k dense retrieval, (ii) LLM-based query rephrasing, (iii) query rephrasing followed by LLM-based reranking, (iv) multi-query fusion via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), (v) an agentic tool-call pipeline in which the generator decides for itself whether to retrieve, and (vi) late-interaction retrieval with ColBERTv2. All six pipelines share the same generator (Meta-Llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), prompt, and evaluation protocol; the five single-vector pipelines additionally share SPECTER2 embeddings and a Chroma vector store; and all six retrieve from the full corpus of 463,971 arXiv papers dated 2024-2025. To support reproducible, large-scale evaluation, we also release a synthetic question dataset of 19,484 problem-statement and methodology questions generated by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from a random sample of 10,000 papers across academic domains (query generation succeeded for 9,742 of them), and every strategy is evaluated on this same query set. We describe the architecture and implementation of each pipeline, release the code and the synthetic question dataset, and evaluate each strategy with an LLM-as-a-judge protocol along multiple quality dimensions, together with direct gold-paper retrieval metrics. The result is an open testbed for studying the cost and quality trade-offs of RAG design choices on a research-literature corpus, and a basis for future work on faithfulness, retrieval robustness, and agentic retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文在463,971篇2024–2025年arXiv论文的大规模语料上，对六种RAG检索策略进行受控对比，统一生成器（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）、提示词和评估协议，并发布19,484条合成查询数据集。结果表明：ColBERTv2的晚交互检索在答案质量（整体3.94/5）和金标论文检索（Hit@3 >92%）上全面领先；查询重写+LLM重排是最佳单向量管道；Fusion和Agentic Tool Call反而低于经典基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG研究多孤立评估各检索组件，或使用小规模基准，难以反映真实科学文献检索场景；缺乏在统一受控条件下对多种检索策略在大规模领域语料上的系统性对比。
AI.method: 构建统一RAG评估框架：(1) 语料为463,971篇2024–2025 arXiv论文，Chroma向量库+SPECTER2嵌入（五个单向量管道），ColBERTv2+PLAID索引（晚交互管道）；(2) 用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct从10,000篇论文的摘要合成problem和method两类查询共19,484条；(3) 六种策略——Classic top-k、Query Rephrased、Rephrased&Reranked、Fusion(RRF)、Tool Call(agentic)、ColBERTv2；(4) 生成器统一为4-bit量化的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（temperature=0, top-k=3）；(5) 评判器为Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct，从accuracy/completeness/faithfulness/relevance/clarity/overall六维LLM-as-a-judge评分；(6) 额外报告金标论文Hit@1/Hit@3/MRR@3；(7) 全部实验在单台NVIDIA DGX Spark上完成。
AI.result: 六种策略评判整体分3.47–3.96。ColBERT全面领先：整体3.94/5、答案率99.9%、问题查询Hit@3 92.8%、方法查询Hit@3 94.8%。Rephrased&Reranked为最佳单向量管道（3.77/5，问题+0.13、方法+0.23对Classic）。Fusion（3.55）和Tool Call（3.54）显著低于Classic基线。Query Rephrased单独使用在问题查询上反而伤害检索（Hit@3 39.7% vs Classic 46.3%）。方法类查询普遍难于问题类查询。配对分析显示，仅ColBERT与Rephrased&Reranked在两种查询类型上均显著优于Classic。金标命中时各策略答案质量相近，差异主要源于检索命中率。
AI.conclusion: 检索架构对RAG质量的主导作用远大于管道复杂度：晚交互检索（ColBERTv2）在金标检索率和答案质量上均最佳；查询重写必须配合重排才能带来收益；单向量经典管道仍是稳健且具性价比的选择；多查询融合和单步agentic工具调用在当前设置下增加开销却不提升质量。检索到正确证据是答案质量提升的关键机制。研究同时发布了代码、合成查询集与采样语料，作为后续RAG忠实性、检索鲁棒性和agentic检索研究的开放测试平台。

title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy
summary: Most clinical benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on diagnosis using complete case descriptions. In clinical practice, however, patients present information in different ways, and clinicians must obtain relevant history and determine which examinations are needed before reaching a diagnosis. Diagnostic accuracy alone therefore cannot establish whether an agent gathered essential information or conducted an appropriate clinical assessment. Furthermore, existing benchmarks lack professional clinicians' verification. To address this gap, we introduce KlinikeBench, a benchmark of 333 clinician-authored tasks, each providing an isolated sandbox environment with a virtual patient, clinical tools, and task-specific success criteria. More than 35 clinicians contributed to case authoring and benchmark evaluation. In an empirical study, clinicians gave simulated dialogues higher mean quality ratings than reference conversations, which is adapted from real conversation. In each task, an LM has a fixed budget of turns to communicate with the patient, ask about relevant history, request examinations, follow action constraints, and record a final diagnosis. We score these steps separately as well as together. Across 31 models and seven model families, the best-performing models (e.g., GPT-6-astra and Claude Opus 5) succeed on less than 30% of tasks, even though their diagnosis accuracy reaches 90.7%. Some models benefit from talking with the patient; others diagnose well from a complete chart but perform much worse in conversation. Overall, KlinikeBench provides a testbed for evaluating the full clinical encounter and reveals a substantial gap between diagnostic accuracy and performance in interactive clinical assessment.

AI.tldr: KlinikeBench 是由 35 名医师参与编写并审核的 333 个交互式临床任务基准，评估语言模型在完整临床问诊中的表现，而不仅仅是诊断准确性。它揭示了一个显著差距：顶尖模型的诊断准确率可达 90.7%，但严格通过率（需要正确诊断、必备工具使用、行动约束及必问主题全部满足）不足 30%。
AI.motivation: 现有临床 LM 基准多基于完整病历评估诊断准确性，忽略了临床实践中信息需逐步采集的过程，无法判断模型是否完成了恰当的病史采集和临床评估。此外，现有基准缺乏专业医师验证。论文旨在构建一个交互式、医师主导的基准来评估完整临床问诊能力。
AI.method: 方法包括：(1) 35 名临床医师基于 PrimeKG/HPO 知识图谱构建 333 个任务，每个任务包含患者画像、140 个临床工具、隐藏评分标准；(2) 使用 LLM 模拟患者，受测模型在 32 轮交互预算内进行问诊、调用工具、记录诊断；(3) 评分包含诊断正确性（Di）、必备工具完成（Wi）、行动约束（Ai）、必问主题覆盖率（Hi），严格 pass@1 要求全部满足；(4) 评估 31 个模型、7 个家族，并研究评判器/患者替换敏感性、交互预算影响；(6) 对 Qwen3-4B 进行 SFT 和 GRPO 训练。
AI.result: 31 个模型中，Claude Opus 5 表现最佳，严格 pass@1 仅 29.4%，诊断准确率却达 90.7%；平均诊断准确率 73.6%，但平均严格通过率仅 13.4%。不同模型在不同维度领先：Gemini-3.8-flash 工具完成率最高，GPT-5.6-sol 必问主题覆盖率最高。增加交互轮次未显著提升通过率。Qwen3-4B 经 SFT 后严格 pass@1 从 0% 提升至 8%（95% CI [2, 15]），但 RL 增益不显著。30 名医师对虚拟患者对话评分（3.69/3.50/3.76）高于 MTS-Dialog 真实对话参考（3.43/3.31/3.45）。
AI.conclusion: KlinikeBench 揭示了诊断准确性与完整临床评估能力之间的显著鸿沟：通过诊断门控不保证恰当的问诊和灵活的临床评估。组件式评分使信息采集和工具使用中的不足变得可见。基准在评判器和患者替换下保持稳健排名。SFT 能改善小模型评估能力，而 RL 早期增益仍不确定，需要更丰富的评估与明确的完成标准。KlinikeBench 公开了基准、训练代码、13,962 条智能体轨迹及 Qwen3-4B 的 SFT/SFT+GRPO 检查点，为疾病诊断 LM 的研究提供资源。

title: PANDA: A Decentralized Architecture with Flexible Orchestration for Scalable, Fault-Tolerant Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Existing architectures for LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) cannot reliably and efficiently solve multi-step tasks at scale: they struggle to support large numbers of agents and concurrent tasks, tolerate failures, govern agent interactions, and accommodate the diverse planning and execution patterns different tasks require. We present PANDA, a decentralized architecture that connects a large collective of heterogeneous, independently administered agents, letting them discover each other's capabilities and self-organize into small specialized teams per task. PANDA scales by decoupling collective communication from team communication, allowing agents to participate in multiple teams simultaneously, load-balancing tasks across the collective, and scheduling concurrent work within each agent. PANDA further separates the underlying architecture from the orchestration strategy, supporting three planning and execution patterns (star, chain, and mesh) that can be selected according to the structure and requirements of each task. PANDA detects infrastructure and orchestration failures and recovers affected tasks by dynamically replanning around failed components. Finally, to provide governance without a centralized service that would limit scalability, PANDA uses a web-of-trust model to constrain agent interactions to established trust relationships. We evaluate PANDA on the HotPotQA benchmark, demonstrating that it scales to thousands of agents, assembles teams in milliseconds, matches state-of-the-art accuracy at up to 8x the efficiency, and sustains 100% task completion under faults where existing systems fail.

AI.tldr: PANDA提出了一种去中心化的大规模LLM多智能体系统架构，通过解耦集体通信与团队通信、支持灵活编排模式（星形/链式/网状）、提供故障检测与恢复机制，以及采用Web of Trust治理模型，在HotPotQA基准上实现了千级智能体扩展、毫秒级团队组装、8倍效率提升以及故障下100%任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统架构在大规模应用时存在四大核心缺陷：可扩展性受限（中心化组件成为瓶颈）、容错能力不足、编排灵活性差、治理依赖中心化权威。这些限制阻碍了大规模、跨域、动态多智能体生态系统的构建。
AI.method: PANDA采用点对点去中心化架构，包含六个核心模块（Team Communication、Agent Registry、Collective Communication、Team Manager、Infrastructure FD、Agent Backend）。关键方法包括：(1) 通过GossipSub实现集体通信、通过TCP实现团队通信的解耦；(2) 基于CPU调度思路的智能体内多任务调度（FIFO/彩票调度）；(3) 借鉴Power of Two Choices的负载均衡（探测比d=2）；(4) 基于PGP的Web of Trust治理，支持self/genesis锚点和深度有界信任传播；(5) 三种编排拓扑（star/chain/mesh），其中mesh采用propose-rank-revise循环达成共识计划；(6) 基于DAG子任务结构的swap协议实现细粒度故障恢复，并使用generation number防止重复链。
AI.result: 在HotPotQA基准上的实验表明：(1) 团队组装时间在达到临界规模后与集体大小无关，保持常数级（毫秒级）；(2) PANDA-star和PANDA-chain比Magentic-One和AgentNet快约2倍，PANDA-mesh与IoA精度相当但速度快3-4倍，最高效率提升达8倍；(3) 在基础设施故障下，所有基线系统任务完成率为0%，而PANDA三种拓扑均保持100%任务完成率和70%+的F1；(4) 在编排故障下，PANDA-mesh的EM/F1显著优于所有基线；(5) Web of Trust治理在genesis锚点下深度n=3时即可达到近70%的信任召回率，且所有配置下信任精度>99%。
AI.conclusion: PANDA是首个同时满足可扩展性、容错性、灵活编排和去中心化治理四大需求的LLM多智能体系统架构。它通过解耦通信与编排、采用DAG结构实现细粒度恢复、引入Web of Trust实现无中心治理，为构建开放、弹性、可治理的多智能体生态系统奠定了基础。该工作还通过TLA+形式化验证了核心协议的安全性与活性。

title: Personalized State-Transition-Aware Memory for Clinical Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents that reason over clinical records must track changes in a patient's state while preserving the history needed to understand them. Simply accumulating memories leaves it unclear which information still applies, whereas overwriting earlier memories can erase evidence needed to reconstruct treatment history and clinical trajectories. We introduce STAM, a state-transition-aware memory framework that records state changes as new clinical entries arrive. STAM combines semantic retrieval with typed clinical relations to identify affected memories, maintaining current information in Active and superseded or resolved information in History. At read time, a query-dependent gate selectively serves historical memory. Across four longitudinal clinical benchmarks, we evaluate STAM with downstream question answering, direct state-maintenance diagnostics, and comparisons at approximately matched context lengths.

AI.tldr: STAM提出了一种面向纵向临床记录的状态转换感知记忆框架,通过将当前信息保留在Active存储、被取代信息保留在History存储,并结合语义检索与类型化临床关系来识别受影响的记忆,在四个临床基准上展现出优于现有记忆与检索基线的状态维护与下游问答性能。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在推理纵向临床记录时,需同时跟踪患者当前状态的变化并保留理解治疗历史所需的既往信息;单纯累积记忆会导致过时信息与当前信息混淆,而覆盖早期记忆则会丢失重构治疗轨迹所需的证据。因此需要一种能够区分当前与历史状态,同时保留演化轨迹的记忆管理机制。
AI.method: STAM将记忆组织为Active(当前状态)和History(被取代/已解决)两个存储,并维护一个人专属的关系图(包含restatement、same_condition_thread、drug_interaction、systemic_link等无向关系以及causal、treatment_for、monitoring_for等有向关系)。写入路径包含四个阶段:原子记忆提取、关系链接、影响检索(结合语义检索与基于图的一跳发现)和状态更新。读取路径使用查询相关的存储门控(store gate)选择是否提供历史记忆。删除由独立的保守删除门控通过保形风险控制处理。
AI.result: 在四个纵向临床基准(MedMemoryBench、MedLoCoMo、自构MIMIC-QA、ClinicalBench)上,完整写入流水线将supersession-pair recall从28.6提升至53.9,同时降低false archival。在上下文长度近似对齐的配对比较中,STAM在17项对比中有6项显著优于基线,无显著下降。State-aware更新在状态/时间类问题上普遍优于raw Full Context。在MIMIC-QA上紧凑的存储包可在达到0.959证据召回的同时保留强读者答案质量。删除门控以α=0.01移除2.3%的存储,保持92.9%安全精度与0.3% never-forget损失。
AI.conclusion: 纵向记忆系统应同时从状态维护和证据服务两个维度进行评估。STAM通过显式状态转换管理,在状态/时间敏感问题上优于raw Full Context,并在近似上下文匹配条件下优于多种记忆与检索基线,但其优势在数据集与读者间并不均匀,证据选择仍是维护记忆与下游回答之间的关键瓶颈。

title: An Empirical Study of Architectural Shift from Traditional to AI-Enabled Simulink Controllers
comment: Accepted at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Software Engineering Conference (APSEC 2026)
summary: Effective AI adoption in cyber-physical systems (CPS) depends on embedding design knowledge into engineering practice. Yet as AI-enabled components increasingly replace analytically derived control laws, this occurs without a systematic understanding of how controller architectures differ or remain similar across paradigms. We address this gap with an empirical study of traditional and AI-enabled Simulink controllers, guided by a literature-derived taxonomy of ten structural categories and nine functional roles. The study analyzes 62 real-world models spanning 8 controller types and 10 application domains, and surveys 13 practitioners, identifying three architectural tensions. First, subsystem organization dominates all controller structures regardless of paradigm, occupying 68-72% of controller footprint, while core control logic occupies minimal space. Second, AI-enabled controllers rely heavily on discrete dynamics and user-defined abstraction, categories largely absent from AI literature, exposing a gap between described and implemented architectures. Third, constraint enforcement blocks largely disappear from AI-enabled models despite practitioner expectations. This reveals a misalignment where safety mechanisms shift from explicit structure to implicit training-time artifacts, breaking traceability.

AI.tldr: 该论文对Simulink中传统控制器与AI驱动控制器的架构差异进行了首次系统性实证研究。研究基于一个文献驱动的分类法（10个结构类别和9个功能角色），分析了62个真实Simulink模型（涵盖8种控制器和10个应用领域），并辅以13位从业者的问卷调查，揭示了三大架构张力。
AI.motivation: 随着AI组件（尤其是深度强化学习和神经网络）在信息物理系统（CPS）中逐渐取代基于数学推导的控制律，工程界缺乏对这些控制器架构差异的系统性理解。现有比较多关注行为结果（如性能、鲁棒性、安全违规率），而将架构视为隐含背景而非明确分析对象。这给安全关键领域的模型验证和追溯带来困难。
AI.method: 研究采用三阶段方法：(1) 通过系统的文献检索构建分类法，包含10个Simulink块结构类别（C1-C10）和9个功能角色（L1-L9）；(2) 对62个真实Simulink模型进行块级提取和分类，使用覆盖率（Coverage）、平均归一化存在度（MNP）和模型级流行度（MLP）三种度量；(3) 对13位有控制器设计经验的从业者开展问卷调查，让其对12个代表性模型进行人工评估。
AI.result: 研究发现三大架构张力：(1) 子系统组织（C6）在两种范式中均占据主导地位，占控制器结构的68-72%，而核心控制逻辑仅占极小空间；(2) AI驱动控制器严重依赖离散动力学（C2）和用户定义抽象（C8），这些类别在AI文献中几乎未被描述，暴露出文献与实现的不一致；(4) 约束执行块（C3）从AI驱动模型中消失，但从业者仍期望它们存在，表明安全机制从显式结构转移到隐式训练时工件，破坏了可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了跨范式架构比较的首个实证基线。研究建议MBSE工具支持应：(1) 将脚手架（scaffolding）作为可重用的首要抽象，而非临时拼凑；(2) 将AI驱动控制器中的奖励塑形、惩罚和环境设计决策表示为显式可检查的工件，弥补安全约束从结构到训练时的迁移带来的追溯性差距。未来工作应设计和验证此类工具支持。

title: From Solo to Social Learning: Characterizing Recursive Social Improvement in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can now improve themselves by revising the instructions they follow, and LLM agents are increasingly orchestrated to work together on complex problems. However, self-improvement methods typically optimize one system at a time, and multi-agent frameworks often have every model work toward a shared goal. We ask a different question. When each agent pursues its own reward, can self-improving LLMs learn from one another well enough to improve the whole population? We call this capability recursive social improvement. We study populations that revise skill files and choose whether, when, and whom to copy from. Independent search, learning from peers, and acting all share one token budget. In controlled environments, established social-learning algorithms benefit from peers, but three LLMs do not. They earn less reward per token than solo learners, and explore too narrowly or run out of tokens before acting. We then let the models write and revise their own skills. Observing peers changes how they improve, helping one model find useful skills sooner and another spend less on private search. Neither, however, outperforms independent learners at the same cost. Skills are copied, revised, and passed on, so one discovery can seed further search. Yet these exchanges concentrate the population around fewer independent discoveries. Together, these results show that LLMs can make learning more efficient by copying from peers, but not yet more effective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在各自追求自身奖励时，能否通过相互学习实现"递归社会改进"。研究发现：在受控环境中，算法基线能从同伴学习中获益，但LLM因探索不足或token耗尽而未能超越独立学习者；在技能进化环境中，LLM通过观察同伴可提高学习效率（更快找到有用技能或消耗更少计算），但在相同成本下并未优于独立学习。总体而言，LLM能够通过复制同伴使学习更高效，但尚不能更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM自我改进方法通常单独优化单个系统，而多智能体框架则让所有模型协作完成共同目标。本文关注一个不同场景：当每个智能体追求自身奖励时，自改进的LLM能否从彼此学习中获益，从而使整个群体得到改进。这一问题涉及行为生态学和文化演化中长期研究的"生产-抄袭"张力。
AI.method: 1. 将递归社会改进形式化为强化学习问题：N个智能体共享token预算，每轮选择演化技能、观察同伴或直接行动；2. 在25臂老虎机受控环境中测试Qwen3-14B、Ministral-3-14B和GPT-OSS-20B，并与算法基线（UCB、分层UCB）对比；3. 使用IFBench指令遵循基准，让GPT-OSS-120B和GLM-5.3-Flash通过OpenEvolve编写、修改和共享技能文件；4. 通过随机干预（保护执行PE、独立搜索IS）诊断失败原因；5. 比较LLM控制与算法控制器（UCB、均匀选择）在匹配学习token下的表现。
AI.result: 在受控环境中：分层社会UCB比solo UCB多获得25.68±2.87累积奖励（p<0.001），但三个LLM的社会群体效率降低29.6%-51.9%，GPT-OSS显著低于solo（p<0.01）。失败源于过度集中于已发现的选项（探索不足）和token管理不善（81% vs 98.1%的完成率）。在技能进化环境中：在匹配学习token下，GPT-OSS-120B社会-独立差异为+0.14±0.35个百分点（不显著），GLM-5.3-Flash为+0.98±0.85（不显著）。GLM通过观察更早达到有用技能，GPT-OSS节省17.34±百万M贷款的学习token但准确性未提升。社会技能确实被复制、修改和传递（83.3% GPT-OSS和56.7% GLM最终技能显示递归传递），但社会群体的技能仅来自1-2个独立发现线，而独立学习者保持4.83-5个。算法控制器（UCB/均匀）以少76-78%的计算成本达到相似准确性，但自适应选择同伴并不比随机选择更优。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体能够通过复制同伴的技能使学习更高效——更快找到有用技能或消耗更少计算——但在相同成本下尚未超越独立学习者。简单算法规则在决定何时复制时可达到与独立搜索相似效果，但成本大大降低。LLM在判断何时、向谁学习方面仍有不足：过度模仿会压缩搜索空间，而错误的社会信息使用会浪费token。未来工作应研究如何训练或激励智能体平衡独立探索与观察，使群体比通过独立搜索更快、更深入地改进。

title: ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights
summary: We introduce ShamAN-Q, a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that extends NanoQuant by replacing each its diagonal reconstruction geometry with a tractable dense curvature metric, using a general paradigm popularized by the Shampoo optimizer. For each linear weight, ShamAN-Q fits a Kronecker product to the empirical Fisher information matrix of a small calibration set by Kullback--Leibler minimization, forming a Mahalanobis reconstruction loss from the result. The continuous ADMM updates from NanoQuant become solutions to Sylvester equations, while its discrete projection and deployment format remain unchanged. Because the curvature is local to a given set of weights, ShamAN-Q re-measures the input curvature statistic for each layer immediately before layer factorization, periodically refreshing all statistics on the partially quantized model. ShamAN-Q also redistributes the uniform rank from NanoQuant across layers at the same total number of bits. On Qwen3-Base, ShamAN-Q lowers WikiText-2 perplexity at $\approx$1 bpw from 27.56 to 22.96 (0.6B), 19.21 to 16.72 (1.7B), and 14.29 to 13.80 (4B) while matching or improving zero-shot accuracy on the Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness. On 0.6B, ShamAN-Q at $\approx$0.8 bpw matches the published perplexity of NanoQuant at $\approx$1.0 bpw.

AI.tldr: ShamAN-Q 是一种用于大语言模型的亚1比特（sub-1-bit）训练后量化方法，它通过用基于KL-Shampoo的Kronecker曲率统计量替换NanoQuant中的对角重构几何，将ADMM连续子问题转化为Sylvester方程求解，在保持相同位预算的前提下显著降低了困惑度。
AI.motivation: LLM推理中解码阶段受带宽限制，权重存储成为主要能耗来源。现有量化方法在sub-1-bit区域受限于每权重至少1比特的下界。NanoQuant通过低秩二值分解突破此下界，但其对角预处理无法捕捉通道间的二阶相关性。ShamAN-Q旨在引入密集曲率度量来进一步提升sub-1-bit量化质量。
AI.method: 1) 在校准阶段使用KL-Shampoo对经验Fisher矩阵进行Kronecker拟合（三次交替固定点迭代），并施加尺度匹配的收缩正则化；2) 通过幂次阶梯加谱估计（p=1/2）降低条件数；3) 将统计量通过对角映射的同余变换运输到变换坐标中形成Mahalanobis重构损失；4) ADMM的U/V更新从右乘法方程变为Mahalanobis Sylvester方程，通过缓存的特征基进行求解；5) 实施周期刷新（在每Δ个块后对未量化层的统计量在部分量化模型上重新估计）以及在每层因子化前测量紧邻的输入统计量；6) 提出基于深度先验与类型权重的手动表分配器，或基于探测敏感性的贪心分配器，在位预算不变下重新分配各层的秩。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Base系列模型（0.05B到14B）上，ShamAN-Q在≈1 bpw下显著降低WikiText-2困惑度：0.6B从27.56降至22.96，1.7B从19.21降至16.72，4B从14.29降至13.80，同时在Eleuther LM评估套件的零样本准确率上匹配或超越NanoQuant。在0.6B上，ShamAN-Q在≈0.8 bpw下可匹配NanoQuant在≈1.0 bpw的困惑度。但量化时间增加65-80%。消融实验表明：阶梯加谱（p=1/2）是最大单步增益；从NKP切换到KL-Shampoo在两种状态下均带来改进；新鲜输入统计量与周期性刷新在每个块边界均带来一致收益。
AI.conclusion: ShamAN-Q通过将NanoQuant的对角重构几何升级为基于KL-Shampoo的密集Kronecker度量，在保持相同压缩格式与推理部署的前提下，在亚1比特LLM量化上取得了显著的困惑度下降与零样本推理性能提升。关键技术包括收缩、阶梯加谱、周期性刷新以及非均匀秩分配。连续ADMM更新变为Sylvester方程，可通过缓存的特征基高效求解。未来工作包括并行化计算、采用支持快速矩阵乘的曲率近似，以及系统地调参与理解缩放行为。

title: MM-FinEval: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Real-World Financial Forecasting
summary: Financial forecasting from earnings conference calls requires models to reason over complex corporate disclosures, market expectations, and subtle communication signals. However, existing financial benchmarks are often limited to unimodal inputs or single-task settings, making it difficult to evaluate whether multimodal large language models (LLMs) can support real-world financial analysis. In this paper, we introduce MM-FinEval, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs across multiple financial tasks. MM-FinEval spans a diverse timeline from 2019 to 2022. The entire proposed dataset contains 2,045 S\&P 500 conference earning calls as inputs and 12 financial task labels as outputs. Each input contains three modalities: a word-to-word text transcript of the earning call, the corresponding presentation slides used during the call, and the entire audio recording. To establish a rigorous evaluation framework, we analyze 19 baseline models across three distinct model categories: Image-Text, Audio-Text, and Any-to-Any configurations. We observe that small-size Any-to-Any models processing all three modalities achieve strong performance, even when compared against larger proprietary models restricted to two-modality inputs. This indicates that our tri-modal dataset design introduces useful, non-redundant information. These results validate that text, audio, and visual data serve as important, complementary signals that mimic the decision-making process of expert human analysts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MM-FinEval，一个面向真实金融预测的多任务多模态基准测试。该基准基于2019-2022年间2045个标普500公司的收益电话会议构建，每个样本包含文本转录、演示幻灯片和音频三种模态，并标注了12个金融预测任务标签。作者评估了19个基线模型，分为图文、音频-文本和任意模态到任意模态（Any-to-Any）三类架构，发现小型Any-to-Any模型因融合三模态互补信号而表现优异，验证了文本、音频和视觉信息在金融分析中的非冗余价值。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准普遍局限于单模态输入或单一任务设计，无法充分评估多模态大语言模型在真实金融分析场景中的能力。收益电话会议包含管理层的语言内容、声学线索（如语调、节奏）和视觉演示材料，专业分析师会综合这些信号进行判断，因此需要构建一个能反映人类专家决策过程的多任务、多模态基准。
AI.method: 数据集构建采用三阶段流程：筛选市值超10亿美元、日均交易量超5000万美元的标普500成分公司，系统性网络爬取同步的三模态数据（逐字文本转录、原始音频、PDF演示幻灯片），并按报告日期手动对齐确保时间一致性。任务标签涵盖三大类：累计异常收益（CAR）、3/7/15/30日事件前后波动率、以及企业债券月度收益（RET_EOM、RET_L5M、RET_LDM）。评估了19个模型，包括Qwen 3.5/3.6系列、Gemma 3n、Mistral 3、GPT-5.4/5.5、Claude 4.6/4.8（图文组），Voxtral 24B、Moss 8B（音频-文本组），Gemma 4 E2B/E4B（任意模态组），采用MAE、Pearson相关系数和方向准确率（DA）作为回归评估指标。
AI.result: 实验揭示了五个核心发现：(1) 现有LLM在市场收益预测上表现接近随机猜测（DA约40-60%），但在波动率预测上DA普遍超过90%，反映出收益类标签信噪比低、波动率类标签具有非负约束的结构性差异；(2) 同一模型家族内参数规模增大虽能提升方向准确率，但MAE并不单调下降，缩放定律在幅值预测上失效；(3) 专有模型（GPT-5.5、Claude-4.8）在收益任务上DA达67-72%、波动率任务达100%，优于开源模型；(4) 关键发现是Gemma 4 E2B/E4B等小型Any-to-Any模型在三模态融合下，CAR任务MAE（0.0418/0.0437）低于Claude-4.8（0.0458），债券收益DA超60%，证明文本、音频、视觉提供互补且非冗余的金融信号；(5) 波动率预测能力随时间窗口从3天扩展到30天而衰减，符合信息半衰期理论，且2019至2022年间方向准确率呈下降趋势，表明模型缺乏时序泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MM-FinEval作为首个面向真实金融预测的多任务三模态基准，填补了现有数据集在模态多样性和任务广度上的空白。实验证明纯语言建模必须向多感官、定量校准推理方向转变，多模态融合是模拟专家金融分析的关键路径。该基准为AI与金融社区提供了评估多模态模型在复杂金融推理中能力的标准化平台，有助于推动自动化、可扩展的金融分析流程发展。

title: Revisiting scaling laws for reward optimization
summary: Scaling laws for optimization against reward models in AI alignment have pinned down how performance depends on optimization effort---measured by a KL-divergence budget relative to a reference policy. Beyond a certain budget, over-optimization (or reward hacking) can arise: because we optimize against a proxy reward model (distinct from true rewards), performance can plateau or degrade. Naturally, the proxy reward's accuracy depends on how much preference data (often in the form of pairwise comparisons) was used to train it. However, existing research does not cleanly identify how performance jointly scales with the amount of training data and the divergence budget. Our main contribution is to provide an empirically accurate and theoretically grounded scaling law in such context. Performance roughly scales as $\Theta(\sqrt{\min\{\log(M),K\}})$, where $M$ is the number of comparisons in training data and $K$ is the policy's divergence budget. We develop an information-theoretic model to establish this upper bound and prove it is tightly achievable through a constructive procedure. Informed by this, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations using a real-world annotation setup, whereby a large 70B gold reward model generates feedback data and proxy reward models are trained from less capable models (0.6B to 4B). Our scaling law provides an excellent fit (R2 from 97\% to 99\%), outperforms alternative specifications, and remains robust across model sizes, noise, and optimization procedures (best-of-$N$ or policy tilting). Our evidence suggests that reward optimization is analogous to a surprisingly simple selection task: choosing from a sequence of IID Gaussian random variables using noisy preference feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI对齐中奖励模型优化的缩放定律，针对现有研究未能清晰刻画性能如何同时随偏好数据量和KL散度预算变化的问题，提出了一个理论上严谨且经验上准确的缩放定律：性能大致按 Θ(√(min{log(M), K})) 缩放，其中M是偏好比较数量，K是KL散度预算。论文通过信息论模型建立上界并证明其紧致可达性，然后利用70B金标奖励模型和0.6B至4B代理模型的真实标注设置进行了广泛实验验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI对齐缩放定律（如Gao et al., 2023）虽然描述了后训练性能与策略散度预算K的关系，但对于代理奖励模型所依赖的偏好数据量M如何影响性能和最优散度预算缺乏清晰的理解。实际应用中存在两个关键问题尚未解决：(1) 对于给定的K，性能如何随M变化；(2) 应如何设置散度预算K以匹配M。这促使作者研究偏好数据量和优化预算之间的联合缩放关系。
AI.method: 论文采用了理论建模与实验验证相结合的方法：(1) 理论部分：构建了信息论模型，其中每个响应的"金标"奖励服从独立同分布正态分布R_i ~ N(μ, σ²)，通过熵不等式（控制散度预算）和对响应集V(E)的分析（控制数据集大小）建立上界，并通过构造子集选择规则和配对选择规则证明下界的可达性；(2) 实验部分：使用Llama-3.3-Nemotron-70B作为金标奖励模型生成偏好数据，用Qwen3系列（0.6B、1.7B、4B）训练代理奖励模型，在Arena 140K数据集的1000个提示上进行训练（最多300,000个比较），并在128个独立提示上评估，通过best-of-N和指数倾斜（policy tilting）两种优化方法验证理论预测的√log(M)缩放关系。
AI.result: 实验结果强有力地支持了理论预测：(1) √log(M)形式的拟合优度R²在97%至99.2%之间，显著优于log(M)、√M和M等替代形式（配对t检验Holm调整后p值均小于0.05）；(2) 该缩放关系在不同代理模型规模（0.6B/1.7B/4B）、有/无偏好噪声（Bradley-Terry-Luce模型下33.6%标签不一致）、不同优化方法（best-of-N和指数倾斜）下均稳健；(3) 0.6B模型在无噪声BoN设置下R²高达0.992，即使在噪声BTL设置下也保持0.951；(4) 理论分析揭示了一个概念洞察：奖励优化本质上类似于"从独立同分布正态随机变量序列中利用噪声偏好反馈进行选择"的简单问题。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了一个理论上严谨、经验上准确的缩放定律，统一描述了后训练性能如何同时随偏好数据量M和KL散度预算K变化，形式为Θ(√min{log(M), K})。该定律给出了明确的实践指导：散度预算应设置为K ~ log(pM)，过小则浪费数据，过大则导致过度优化（即奖励黑客攻击）。这一缩放关系将AI对齐与经典的IID高斯选择问题联系起来，为后训练的根本限制提供了清晰理解，并为AI对齐的算法缩放策略提供了指导。未来的研究方向包括将理论推广到更一般的奖励分布、自适应偏好收集以及使用人类偏好的实证测试。

title: Does This Action Still Explain the Task? Reverse Scoring for Diffusion Language Model Agents
summary: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) promise to break the sequential latency bottleneck of autoregressive agents through parallel decoding, but recent evaluations show this efficiency does not transfer to embodied agentic competence: dLLM-backed agents repeatedly fall into retry loops, re-issuing an action long after it has failed. We give a mechanistic account of this failure and a training-free remedy. We trace the retry loop to the adaptivity of masked decoding: the sampler commits the positions it is most confident about and defers the uncertain ones, and at a failure state the context already offers a confident fill for the deferred decision, i.e. the failed action itself, so the retry is committed without the failure feedback ever being confronted. We model the resulting distortion of the action distribution as a task-blind corruption: contextually salient actions (e.g., the action just taken) receive inflated probability by a factor that depends on the state and the action but not on the task. Under this model, we analyse an invariance proposition: the task-blind factor cancels exactly from the reverse conditional, i.e. the likelihood of the task given the state and a candidate action, which coincides with the task posterior of an idealized uncorrupted model. Masked dLLMs evaluate the reverse conditional natively, unlike autoregressive models, by masking the task tokens and denoising, at the cost of a few parallel passes per candidate. We instantiate the rule as Reflect Reverse and evaluate it on four multi-turn embodied benchmarks, where it improves task success and progression rates over forward-scoring baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了基于掩码扩散语言模型(dLLM)的智能体在具身任务中陷入重试循环的机制性原因：掩码解码的自适应性使模型在失败状态中"桥接"而非"面对"失败反馈，从而过度倾向于上下文中已有的动作。论文形式化地提出"任务盲污染"假设，并基于此提出了一种无需训练的修正方法"Reflect Reverse"，通过对候选动作的反向条件概率（即"该动作是否能解释任务"）进行评分来选择动作。理论分析表明该方法能够恢复理想无偏模型的真实任务后验，并在四个多轮具身基准测试和两个 dLLM 骨干模型上显著提升了任务成功率和进度率。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型(dLLM)虽然通过并行解码突破了自回归模型的延迟瓶颈，但其在具身智能体任务中的实际效能并不理想。一个突出的失败模式是"重试循环"：dLLM 智能体在某个动作失败后仍反复执行同一动作，绕过失败反馈。论文动机在于揭示这一现象背后的机制性原因，并提供一个无需训练的修正方案，使 dLLM 的并行解码优势能够转化为真正的智能体能力。
AI.method: 方法部分的核心是"Reflect Reverse"机制，包含三个步骤：(1) 提议——通过思维链采样 K 个候选动作并去重；(2) 反思——通过对任务词元随机掩码并进行去噪，以蒙特卡洛方式估计每个候选动作在状态 s 和动作 a 条件下解释任务 u 的反向条件概率 π_θ(u|s,a)；(3) 执行——按反向条件分数的 softmax 比例采样最终动作。理论层面，论文提出了"任务盲乘法污染"假设（Assumption 2.1），即观测到的动作分布 π_θ 是真实条件分布 μ 被一个仅依赖 (s,a) 而不依赖任务 u 的因子 ε(s,a) 扭曲的结果。Proposition 3.1 证明在一致性假设下，污染因子在反向条件中精确抵消，使 π_θ(u|s,a) 等价于无偏模型在重新加权任务先验下的任务后验。Theorem 3.1 用全变距离给出了反向选择的偏差与污染无关的上界，并证明正向选择的偏差随污染强度增长。
AI.result: 实验在四个多轮具身基准（ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、BabyAI、Jericho）上对 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 和 iLLaDA-8B-Instruct 进行评估。结果显示：Reflect Reverse 在 16 组配置中的 13 组上提升了平均成功率（SR），14 组上提升了平均进度率（PR）。最大改进幅度：LLaDA 在 ALFWorld（T=0.9）上 SR 从 8.71% 提升至 16.17%；iLLaDA 在 BabyAI（T=1.0）上 SR 从 11.61% 提升至 20.24%。消融实验表明 Reflect Reverse 在 16 组配置中的 12 组上优于 Reflect Forward，且在全部 16 组配置中都达到最低的重试百分比，显著缓解了智能体的重复行为。
AI.conclusion: 论文将 dLLM 智能体的重试循环现象追溯到掩码解码的结构性缺陷：由于采样器优先提交最确信的位置而推迟不确定位置，失败状态下的开放决策被推迟并由上下文中已有的"失败动作"自行填补，从而桥接而非面对失败反馈。基于此的"任务盲污染"假设在目标替换干预中得到实证验证：LLaDA 的动作偏好对任务替换几乎不敏感（σ=1.01 nats，偏好翻转率 6.6%），而 Qwen 的自回归参照则高度敏感（σ=4.71 nats，翻转率 44.4%）。Reflect Reverse 作为一种无需训练、无需学习评判器或价值函数的解码时修正方法，通过反向条件评分恢复了与无偏模型一致的候选比较排序，为 dLLM 智能体提供了一种通用且高效的偏差修正工具。未来工作方向包括扩展不变量到提议步骤、从源头通过微调或正则化消除污染，以及将反向评分推广到推理链等更广泛的掩码扩散解码场景。

title: ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations
summary: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLaG is open source and can be installed with pip install relag.

AI.tldr: ReLaG是一个模态无关的、可扩展的数据集划分框架，通过层级潜变量模型和近似近邻图与社区检测来推断相关样本组，从而在存在潜在相关性的数据上构建独立的训练-测试划分，避免随机划分导致的乐观泛化估计。
AI.motivation: 在生物化学等领域，数据集中常存在相关样本（如同源蛋白、相似分子），随机划分会将相关样本分入训练集和测试集，导致训练-测试泄露，使泛化估计过于乐观。现有关系感知划分方法存在模态特异、计算成本高（O(n²)）、相似度阈值缺乏选择依据等局限。
AI.method: 1. 建立两层潜变量模型：群组潜变量g_i从总体分布G中i.i.d.采样，样本s_ij从p(s|g_i)中采样。2. ReLaG算法：给定模态特定的距离函数，利用HNSW构建近似近邻图（保留所有距离低于阈值τ的边），通过Leiden社区检测与CPM目标函数（分辨率为γ=p₀，空模型边缘概率）识别社区，将每个社区视为不可分割单元进行随机划分。3. 无标签阈值选择程序：利用未标记的生产数据，通过最小化训练-训练与生产-训练社区间单链接距离分布的KS统计量来选择τ*。4. 有效数据集大小N_eff定义为社区数。
AI.result: 在合成肽数据集上，ReLaG的测试PCC与生产PCC差异仅+0.005，与oracle（-0.006）、Hestia（-0.004）、DataSAIL（+0.004）相当，而随机划分高估0.12。在6个分子和2个蛋白质真实数据集上，ReLaG与现有方法性能相当。在PeptideAtlas上，n=3.125M时ReLaG耗时1.7小时，而Hestia需2.1周（207×加速）。阈值选择成功识别i.i.d.（MNIST）、关系型（DBAASP）和OOD（BELKA）三种场景。N_eff比原始样本数N更能反映泛化性能（r=0.46），可指导多样性感知的数据集扩展。
AI.conclusion: ReLaG提供了一个从潜变量模型出发的通用关系感知划分框架，在保持与现有方法相当的泄露控制水平的同时，将计算复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n log n)，使大规模数据集的关系感知划分成为可能。无标签阈值选择程序能自动适配生产数据分布，并在数据为i.i.d.时退化为随机划分、在OOD时发出信号。社区结构提供的N_eff可作为数据集多样性的有效度量，支持更高效的扩展策略。

title: Towards Universal Wasserstein Barycenters through Flow Matching
summary: Defining a weighted mean over probability measures under probability metrics is a central tool in probabilistic machine learning. Under the Wasserstein metric, these are called \emph{Wasserstein barycenters}. While most approaches compute barycenters for a fixed weight vector, approximating the whole family of barycenters over the simplex, which we call the \emph{Wasserstein simplex}, remains underexplored. We refer to this problem as \emph{Universal Barycenter Approximation}, and propose \texttt{BaryFM}, a flow matching model transporting the marginal measures into any barycenter in the Wasserstein simplex. Once trained, the network can draw samples from measures in the Wasserstein simplex through an ordinary differential equation. We validate our method on 4 downstream tasks: domain adaptation, generalization, Bayesian posterior aggregation and algorithmic fairness. \texttt{BaryFM} achieves the best average rank among 15 competing methods across 10 domain adaptation benchmarks, matching or surpassing non-universal solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BaryFM，一种基于条件流匹配（CFM）的通用Wasserstein重心求解器，可在训练后通过ODE对Wasserstein单纯形上任意权重λ对应的重心进行采样，在10个领域自适应基准上达到最佳平均排名，并在域泛化、贝叶斯后验聚合和算法公平性等任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的Wasserstein重心求解器大多只能针对固定权重向量计算重心，而对整个Wasserstein单纯形（即所有可能权重下的重心族）进行近似的问题尚未得到充分探索。此外，现有神经方法无法处理特征-标签联合测度上的重心。
AI.method: BaryFM采用单一网络结构，包含共享编码器和两个头：对偶OT头近似各边际测度与重心间的Kantorovich势函数，CFM头学习从边际测度到重心的速度场。训练时通过对权重λ~Dir(α)采样实现通用性，通过块坐标更新联合优化两个损失，并支持联合测度Ω=ℝ^d×Δ_C上的流。
AI.result: BaryFM在10个领域自适应基准上以平均排名1.75优于15个对比方法（含WGF、CW2B、TSBM等）；在域泛化任务中，BaryFM_Random在5个基准中3个取得最佳；在贝叶斯后验聚合中结合CFG达到最优；并能有效改善公平性指标。消融实验表明CFM头和通用性训练是最关键组件。
AI.conclusion: BaryFM是首个能处理特征-标签联合测度的通用神经重心求解器，通过将重心问题重新表述为多源、动目标的流匹配问题，实现了对整个Wasserstein单纯形的近似采样，在多个下游任务中展现出优越性能，为重心方法开辟了新的应用场景。

title: FlexRouter: Learning Complementary Model Sets for Flexible LLM Routing
summary: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) routing methods score LLMs independently to select top-$k$ models. However, this ignores model correlations and enforces a rigid computational budget. Consequently, routers often select redundant models that share failure modes, limiting the overall probability of success. To address this, we propose FlexRouter, a routing framework that explicitly models model complementarity. FlexRouter optimizes for \textit{answer coverage}, maximizing the probability that at least one selected model yields a correct response. This objective aligns with practical inference pipelines where multiple candidate outputs are generated and a downstream verifier or user selects the final one. We formulate routing as a coverage-oriented subset selection problem and model the routing policy using Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), which naturally capture both model competence and redundancy. To directly optimize coverage without requiring a ground-truth target subset, we introduce a training objective based on marginalizing over failure sets. During inference, we employ a greedy strategy based on marginal log-determinant gains, enabling the router to adaptively determine subset sizes without a predefined budget. Extensive experiments on the large-scale RouterEval benchmark demonstrate that our proposed FlexRouter achieves higher coverage with lower redundancy across both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks than strong baselines while maintaining flexible inference cost.

AI.tldr: FlexRouter提出一种基于行列式点过程（DPP）的LLM路由框架，将路由重新定义为面向覆盖率的子集选择问题，通过显式建模模型互补性来选择冗余度最小、覆盖率最大的多模型子集，同时支持自适应推理预算。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法对各模型独立打分并选择top-k，忽略了模型间的相关性，导致选出的模型共享相似的失败模式，造成冗余选择，降低至少一个模型回答正确的概率。此外，固定k的预算机制缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 1. 将路由定义为面向覆盖率的子集选择问题：最大化所选子集中至少包含一个正确模型的概率；2. 使用行列式点过程（DPP）参数化路由策略，通过查询嵌入与可学习模型嵌入构建查询相关的DPP核矩阵，对角项编码模型能力，非对角项惩罚冗余相关模型；3. 提出Coverage Loss训练目标，通过对失败集（failure set）的边际化直接最大化成功率，无需唯一真值子集；4. 推理时采用基于边际对数行列式增益的贪心策略，配合自适应停止条件动态决定子集大小。
AI.result: 在RouterEval基准的中等池（3811模型）和大型池（5000模型）设置下，FlexRouter在域内和域外任务上均取得最高的平均Success@10（中等池0.8632，大型池0.9914），显著超越EmbedLLM和BaRP等基线，同时ILD@10多样性指标大幅领先（例如中等池上0.7620 vs EmbedLLM 0.2112）。在τ≈0.2的设置下，自适应停止机制可在保持高覆盖率的同时将平均子集大小降低约35.9%。
AI.conclusion: FlexRouter通过DPP显式捕捉模型间冗余，配合面向失败集的边际化训练损失和贪心自适应推理策略，在不依赖固定预算的条件下选择了高质量且互补的模型子集。该框架证明了面向覆盖率的子集选择在LLM路由中的价值，并为下游验证器、重排器或人工选择提供了更优的候选池。未来工作包括与下游选择器联合端到端评估、输出级语义多样性分析以及模型级标签稀疏性研究。

title: Prompt2Skill: Unsupervised Skill Optimization From Natural Language Instructions
summary: Skills are external artifacts that Large Language Models (LLMs) consume at inference time to improve their performance on specialized domains by incorporating relevant procedural and domain knowledge. Expert-authored skills are expensive to produce, and the resulting artifacts are not optimized for the specific model that consumes them, whose failure modes can vary with version, scale and training. In addition, emerging tasks may fall outside the scope of existing skill libraries, creating a need to develop new skills before curated training data become available. Recent works have explored automated skill optimization through reflection, but they require a curated, in-distribution training set, which users might not always have. To address these limitations, we present Prompt2Skill, a framework that builds skills from natural-language task description alone. From the prompt, the system derives a task specification, discovers or synthesizes datasets, and refines the skill in a closed loop of reflective editing. Across four domains spanning question answering, reading comprehension, spreadsheet manipulation, and mathematical reasoning, Prompt2Skill consistently outperforms the direct prompting baseline, achieving an average improvement of 10.8 across open-source and frontier models.

AI.tldr: Prompt2Skill是一个端到端多智能体框架，仅依据任务描述(无需任何标注数据)自动构建并优化LLM可用的"技能"提示文件，通过数据检索/合成与反射式编辑的闭环，在四个领域(问答、阅读理解、电子表格、数学推理)上平均相对提升10.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM技能(外部提示文件)依赖专家撰写、成本高且未针对具体模型优化；近期基于反射的自动技能优化方法(如SkillOpt)仍需已标注的领域内训练集，而真实用户往往只有任务描述。论文旨在解决"无监督技能优化"问题：从纯自然语言任务描述出发，自动构建适配目标模型的技能。
AI.method: 框架含两个智能体：(1)数据智能体：将任务描述d解析为任务规范τ(输入输出契约、答案格式、可执行代理评估器μ̂τ)，检索(HuggingFace数据集目录/Wikipedia)或合成任务数据，经结构检查、可解性筛选、参考一致性校验后构建数据池𝒫，并划出冻结选择集𝒱。(2)技能智能体：以种子技能s₀为起点，每轮在反射集𝒯ₜ上rollout，从失败中提出候选编辑；在新鲜接受批ℬₜ上做配对统计显著性检验(获胜w、失败ℓ、连续性修正的z统计量，阈值κ=1)决定是否替换当前技能；最终在𝒱上一次性选择最优技能并导出。理论保证在代理分布与评估器失配上界下，选出技能与最优保留技能的差距有界。
AI.result: 在SearchQA、SQuAD、AIME、SpreadsheetBench四个基准、五个目标模型(Qwen3-8B/32B、Llama-3.2-1B、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-5.5)上，Prompt2Skill相对直接提示基线平均提升10.8个百分点，相对固定技能提升22%-29.1%，Llama-3.2-1B上提升93.5%；在匹配预算下优于SkillOpt(45.79→48.71 EM)。在零示例、一示例、四示例设置下表现稳定，对种子技能不敏感。审计显示无测试泄漏。在MCoNaLa-ja与时序规范化任务上，作为无权重更新的AutoML替代方案与Prompt2Model表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭自然语言任务描述即可为冻结LLM构建有效技能，无需权重更新或用户提供数据；框架在多个模型与领域上一致优于直接提示与现成技能，并具备理论选择保证，可作为NLP AutoML中任务特化微调的替代路径。

title: Beyond Oracle Communication: Benchmarking Interactive Intent Alignment Under Miscommunication and Evolving User Intent
summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly tackle complex tasks through interactive, long-horizon exchanges with users, while existing benchmarks generally assume that users always accurately and sufficiently communicate a fixed intent. However, this oracle communication assumption rarely holds in practice: users may miscommunicate, change their goals, and run out of patience. We define this task setting as Interactive Intent Alignment, where agents must recover and continuously track the user's current intent despite imperfect communication and evolving goals. To study this setting, we introduce Drift-Bench++, a principled benchmark construction pipeline for verified executable tasks with controlled misalignment and intent shifts, along with an interaction protocol featuring finite patience, diverse simulated users, and silent interaction-conditioned shifts. We further develop GRIP, a comprehensive evaluation protocol covering task grounding, user realism, inquiry effectiveness, and adaptation to evolving intent. Across diverse environments, models, and interaction conditions, stronger interaction consistently helps but remains far from oracle performance; Validation on deployed ProdAgent sessions further shows that the modeled failures are prevalent and consequential in deployment. By providing a unified, executable benchmark for interactive intent alignment, Drift-Bench++ offers a foundation for evaluating and advancing agents under realistic communication and evolving intent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DrBenchmark++（Drift-Bench++），一个针对 LLM 智能体在交互式意图对齐场景下的统一基准测试与评估框架。该研究打破了传统基准测试中"用户通信始终完整准确"的"神谕通信假设"，构建了一个同时包含初始意图错位和持续意图漂移的交互设置，并提出了 GRIP 多维评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准测试普遍假设用户始终能够准确、完整地传达其意图（即"神谕通信假设"），但实际交互中用户常出现沟通偏差、信息遗漏甚至意图变化。该假设的局限性掩盖了智能体在真实场景下的关键能力：检测错位、主动澄清、持续追踪用户当前意图。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，提出更贴近真实交互的评估范式。
AI.method: 1. **任务构建流水线**：基于人际关系理论中的沟通错误分类法（意图、前提、参数、表达四类共 11 种故障），通过三步验证器（双 LLM 法官一致性与上下文适配性、表面忠实度检查、可执行效果验证）生成带有受控错位的查询；2. **意图图谱构建**：将原始任务映射为 (帧, 条件集合) 结构，建立含优化（Refinement）、泛化（Relaxation）、替换（Substitution）、转换（Pivot）四种关系的可执行意图图谱，为后续意图漂移提供基础；3. **交互协议**：引入有限耐心预算（提问消耗 2 单位、被拒提议消耗 4 单位）、静默的交互条件触发型意图漂移（基于耐心阈值或智能体提问主题），以及基于 GDMS 框架的五种角色条件化行为模拟；4. **GRIP 评估协议**：从 Grounding（任务结果基础）、Role-realism（模拟用户真实度）、Inquiry（提问效果）、Persistence（意图漂移下的适应性）四个维度进行诊断式评估。
AI.result: 1. 在 WebShop、τ²-Retail、τ²-Airline 三个环境中实例化基准（生成 1780/555/208 个验证样本）；2. 评估 7 种现有澄清方法 + 3 种诊断式参考智能体（Memory Ledger、Memory+Verification、Self-Evolving Playbook）在 5 种 LLM 后端上的表现，发现更强的交互策略普遍优于无询问基线，但与神谕性能仍有显著差距，Self-Evolving 在 15 个骨架-基准组合中的 14 个上领先；3. 在 ProdAgent 真实部署平台的 16,596 个会话中发现 23.7% 存在意图错位，且涵盖所有四类通信故障和四类意图漂移关系，证实了基准抽象的现实相关性；4. 随着故障复杂度 k 增加，Self-Evolving 与基线的优势进一步扩大；5. 角色分析表明 Dependent 用户在恢复和基础性上最强，而 Rational 用户在意图漂移后成功率最高，揭示了不同维度下难度排序的差异。
AI.conclusion: Drift-Bench++ 提供了首个统一的可执行基准，可系统评估智能体在通信错位与意图漂移双重挑战下的持续对齐能力。实验表明澄清交互对意图对齐至关重要，但仍远未达到神谕水平；真实部署数据验证了基准抽象的实用性。未来工作应将该基准扩展到更开放的任务环境、更长时程的智能体，以及探索针对交互对齐的训练策略。本研究将"交互式意图对齐"确立为一种独立于传统任务性能的高级能力，为智能体评估与设计提供了新的诊断基础。

title: Differentiable Structure Learning for Cyclic Linear Gaussian Models with Latent Confounders
summary: We study causal structure learning from observational data in linear Gaussian structural causal models in the presence of directed cycles and an unknown number of exogenous latent confounders, bounded by a given maximum. We derive the covariance of the observed variables and introduce marginal quasi-equivalence, which characterizes when different causal models share a full-dimensional subset of the observational distributions they can generate. We formulate structure learning as minimization of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood with a logarithmically scaled complexity penalty that counts directed edges and latent variables.
