AI.motivation: Jiang和Gong (2026)的精确增量BPE算法在最坏情况下需要 O(log²t) 时间（t为最大规范token长度），其瓶颈来自CST中基于区间计数的平衡有序点定位。两个对数分别来自质心层级深度和每层的有序分支搜索代价。由于各区间所选递归组件大小不均，简单的计数平衡未能充分利用组件尺寸信息。
AI.method: 在Jiang和Gong的规范化/正确合并阶段模型框架下，保留所有匹配、自动机、有效性区间和质心分解结构，仅替换局部有序点定位方法：每个区间按其所选递归组件的大小 w_i 加权存储于字母树中，每次选择使左右两侧严格权重均不超过当前权重一半的枢轴。一条从大小 m 到 m' 的转移代价为 O(1 + log(m/m'))，从而使所有成功下移的对数比率求和形成望远镜级数 Σ(log m_j - log m_{j+1}) ≤ log t，再加上 O(r) 的常数、有效性检查和向上转移贡献，最终实现 O(log t) 的每次追加时间和 O(n log t) 的整体复杂度。同时构造了一个基于固定字母表的规范化正确BPE族（递归嵌套的"重组件"树 T_k），使计数平衡搜索需 Θ(log²t) 探测而加权搜索只需 Θ(log t)，并证明在真实流更新上可达。
AI.result: Rust实现验证：对抗性构造中 t=8192 时探测数从92降至13，符合预测的二次vs线性分离；在GPT-2、RoBERTa-base和GPT-NeoX-20B三个真实词汇表上，权重搜索使p99探测数从5降至2，端点比较p99从5降至4；但完整更新时间反而慢0.3%-13.1%（因普通查询度数小且原搜索已足够浅），内存从38.3-38.5 MB增至44.6-44.7 MB。提出低度数混合方案作为工程选项。
AI.conclusion: 在Jiang和Gong的精确逐前缀框架内，用组件大小加权每个CST区间的有序点定位使搜索代价沿质心层级望远镜式求和，将最坏情况更新时间从 O(log²t) 降至 O(log t)，不改变返回的token语义；可达反例族证明该渐近分离对规范化正确BPE字典可实现；实验支持预测的探测规模，但实际改进主要体现为最坏情况保证而非平均吞吐量提升。

title: OPTS-TTPO: Enhancing Finite-Sample Policy-Gradient Learning with Tree Search
summary: The policy-gradient theorem gives the exact gradient under the current policy, but finite on-policy samples may miss rare high-return trajectories. We study whether tree search improves their coverage within a fixed budget while controlling gradient bias. We introduce On-Policy Parallel Tree Search (OPTS) and Tree Trajectory Policy Optimization (TTPO) using on-policy tree trajectories, which sample new suffixes from the current policy at visited states. This needs no action-distribution correction, although branching changes state visitation. Our Branch Aggregation Lemma shows that branch-weighted tree statistics recover chain expectations when branch choices and weights are fixed before outgoing transitions are sampled. OPTS selects expansion states using estimated performance differences. Under deterministic dynamics, exact values, and max-backup advantages, the induced search policy's expected return improves monotonically with the budget. We bound the gradient bias from adaptive expansion and show that max backup assigns prefix credit to actions leading to better discovered suffixes. Against a finite chain reference, TTPG's measured bias stays near its no-branching level, while NaivePG's bias grows from 0.1251 to 0.4884. At matched budgets, reward- and value-guided OPTS improve correct-answer coverage and majority-vote accuracy over independent sampling. At matched branch counts, OPTS + TTPG gains coverage with a modest bias increase relative to Fixed-branch + TTPG. Under matched interaction or rollout budgets, OPTS-TTPO improves MuJoCo tail returns over PPO by up to 28.6%, achieves a 34-22-1 win-loss-tie record against PPO on Atari-57 under the last-100-log mean-return metric, and improves micro-averaged avg@32 and pass@32 over PPO across all four Qwen3 models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OPTS-TTPO框架，通过树搜索改善有限样本下策略梯度学习中罕见高回报轨迹的覆盖问题，同时控制梯度偏差。核心贡献包括：分支聚合引理（Branch Aggregation Lemma）使得树加权统计量恢复链式期望；OPTS使用性能差异估计指导有限搜索预算的分配；并对后验自适应扩展的偏差进行了显式分解和界定。实验在MuJoCo、Atari-57和Qwen3 LLM数学推理任务上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 有限采样预算下，独立的on-policy轨迹采样可能遗漏罕见的高回报轨迹，导致策略梯度估计不准确。需要一种方法能够在固定计算预算内提高高回报轨迹的覆盖率，同时控制由此引入的梯度偏差。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心组件：(1) TTPO（Tree Trajectory Policy Optimization）：通过分支聚合引理证明，当分支决策和权重仅依赖于前缀信息时，分支加权树统计量可以恢复链式期望，从而将树形轨迹转化为有效的策略梯度学习数据。(2) OPTS（On-Policy Parallel Tree Search）：基于性能差异估计（performance difference lemma）选择有价值的扩展状态，在已访问状态处并行采样新的on-policy后缀。分支使用max-backup或mean-backup TreeGAE进行优势估计；理论证明了在确定动力学、精确值函数和max-backup条件下，搜索策略的期望回报随预算单调改善。对自适应扩展违反引理条件所产生的偏差，论文将其分解为后验轨迹重加权和max-backup前缀信用两部分，并给出上界。
AI.result: 1. 分支聚合验证：TTPG的偏差保持在无分支水平（0.1221-0.1260），而NaivePG的偏差从0.1251增长到0.4884。2. 搜索质量：精确值下1920个相邻预算比较均显示改善；学习评论家下四个汇总指标总体随预算增加。3. 匹配预算下，奖励引导的OPTS将pass@k从0.7295-0.8082提升至0.7561-0.8259；价值引导的OPTS提升多数投票准确率。4. 跨域学习：MuJoCo尾回报提升达28.6%（HalfCheetah-v4）；Atari-57上对PPO取得34-22-1胜负平记录；四个Qwen3模型上micro-averaged avg@32和pass@32均优于PPO。
AI.conclusion: OPTS-TTPO成功地将树搜索集成到策略梯度学习中，通过分支聚合解决了树形数据的有效利用问题，通过性能差异指导实现了有限预算的高效分配。理论分析明确了后验自适应扩展引入偏差的来源（轨迹重加权+前缀信用）。跨域实验验证了方法在连续控制、离散控制和LLM推理任务中的通用性。论文也指出了局限性：单调性保证仅在确定动力学和精确值函数下成立；理论仅界定而非消除偏差。未来方向包括在前缀可测采样下的方差缩减和从成功OPTS轨迹的自蒸馏。

title: Robust and Learned Online Matching in Growing Trees
summary: We study irrevocable maximum-cardinality matching in trees revealed by successive leaf attachments, with a known horizon and an exogenous growth law that is misspecified or unknown. For deterministic affine attachment forecasts with nonnegative degree reinforcement, the optimal threshold policy loses at most twice the cumulative expected conditional total-variation error relative to an online oracle knowing the actual growth law. This follows from a unit-span property of the Bellman continuation score and has no additional horizon factor. A four-vertex example attains the coefficient two for the specified deterministic policy, and a two-model argument gives a lower bound linear in the model-error budget for arbitrary policies under general misspecification. For uniform-preferential attachment, the local error has an exact expression through the leaf count. When its constant mixture parameter is unknown, we estimate it from the same growing tree and update the threshold policy at geometric times. A parameter-sensitivity bound for individual Bellman prices and uniform degree-moment estimates yield expected regret $O(\sqrt{n}\log^2 n)$, using $O(n^2\log n)$ arithmetic operations and $O(n)$ stored entries. The exact minimax rate remains open.

AI.tldr: 研究在增长树上的不可撤销最大基数在线匹配问题，针对仿射依附预测在模型误指定下的稳健性以及从单棵树学习未知参数的问题。核心贡献是一个单位跨度(unit-span)性质，使得误指定损失至多为模型误差的两倍且无额外horizon因子；并设计了通过几何时间更新阈值策略实现O(√n·log²n)的期望遗憾。
AI.motivation: 在线匹配算法需在观察到未来附着前决定是否接受每条边。顶点未来可能吸引更多子节点，因此"等待"的价值取决于增长机制。若使用错误的增长模型，传统有限horizon扰动分析会让局部误差承担整个剩余奖励作为代价。需要一个更精细的结构性估计。
AI.method: 1. 对确定性仿射依附预测建立Bellman表示和阈值策略；2. 利用单位跨度性质(单位跨度意味着对于任何两个分布在期望上的差最多为总变差距离)证明误指定模型下的稳定性界；3. 在uniform-preferential族中精确表达局部误差；4. 使用叶节点计数反均值估计器，按几何时间(2,4,8,16,...)更新阈值策略，结合Bellman价格参数敏感性和均匀度矩估计推导遗憾界。
AI.result: 1. 模型误指定下OPT_on(P) - E|M_n^{π_Q}| ≤ 2·E_n(P,Q)，无horizon放大；2. 四顶点例子达到系数2，任意策略有线性下界；3. 叶节点计数误差在uniform-preferential族中有精确闭式表达；4. 学习算法实现O(√n·log²n)期望遗憾，O(n²·logn)算术运算，O(n)存储；5. pilot-and-commit策略获得O(n^{2/3})遗憾。精确minimax速率仍开放。
AI.conclusion: 单位跨度条件连续分是本问题的核心结构性观察，允许在任意外生误指定下获得无horizon放大的模型误差界。几何时间更新策略显著优于单次pilot-and-commit，但√n的对数因子可能是均匀敏感性界的伪影。精确最小最大速率仍未解决。离线最大匹配的比较需要超越oracle遗憾的额外竞争性分析。

title: Comparison of techniques for fine-tuning open-weight models for entity extraction from radiology reports
summary: Converting free-text radiology reports into structured labels supports cohort building, quality assurance, and monitoring of clinical imaging models, but the strongest label extractors are hosted proprietary models whose use raises privacy, cost, and reproducibility concerns. We asked whether a fine-tuned open-weight model (Gemma-3-12B) can match GPT-4o at multi-label intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) acuity extraction from non-contrast head-CT reports, and which ingredients matter. Using a 2x2 design, we crossed two adaptation strategies (a discriminative classification head, CH; generative instruction fine-tuning, IFT) with two training-data sources (distillation of real GPT-4o-labeled reports; synthetic reports generated by GPT-4o from real exemplars), across five training sizes, benchmarked on 100 expert-adjudicated reports against GPT-4o and the un-tuned open-weight base. The distilled instruction-tuned model (DIFT) matched GPT-4o (macro-F1 0.845 vs 0.850; p = 1.000) and exceeded the base model by 0.178. The decisive factor was the training-data source, not the fine-tuning method: both synthetic-data models failed to exceed the un-tuned open-weight base at any training size and underperformed the distilled models across all acuity classes. Fine-tuning and inference fit within the memory envelope of a single 24 GB consumer GPU. For narrow, high-value clinical label-extraction tasks, distilling real reports, rather than generating synthetic ones, is what closes the gap to a hosted model, enabling a private, low-cost, version-stable on-premises alternative.

AI.tldr: This study investigates whether a fine-tuned open-weight model (Gemma-3-12B) can match GPT-4o in multi-label intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) acuity extraction from non-contrast head-CT reports. Using a 2x2 design crossing adaptation strategies (classification head vs. instruction fine-tuning) with training data sources (distilled real reports vs. synthetic reports), the authors find that distilled instruction-tuned models match GPT-4o performance, with training data source being more critical than fine-tuning method. Synthetic data approaches consistently underperformed, even failing to exceed the un-tuned base model.
AI.motivation: Strongest label extractors for converting free-text radiology reports into structured labels rely on proprietary models (e.g., GPT-4o), which raise concerns about privacy, cost, and reproducibility in clinical settings. The authors aim to determine if open-weight models fine-tuned appropriately can serve as private, low-cost, on-premises alternatives that match proprietary model performance for clinical NLP tasks.
AI.method: The study employs a 2x2 factorial design crossing two adaptation strategies (discriminative classification head [CH] vs. generative instruction fine-tuning [IFT]) with two training data sources (distillation of real GPT-4o-labeled reports vs. synthetic reports generated by GPT-4o from real exemplars), across five training sizes. The model used is Gemma-3-12B, evaluated on 100 expert-adjudicated reports for multi-label ICH acuity extraction. The primary metric is macro-F1, with statistical significance testing (p = 1.000) comparing the best fine-tuned model against GPT-4o and the un-tuned base. The approach fits within a single 24 GB consumer GPU memory envelope.
AI.result: The distilled instruction-tuned model (DIFT) matched GPT-4o (macro-F1 0.845 vs. 0.850; p = 1.000, indicating no statistically significant difference) and exceeded the un-tuned base model by 0.178 in macro-F1. Training data source was the decisive factor: synthetic-data models failed to exceed the un-tuned open-weight base at any training size and underperformed distilled models across all ICH acuity classes. Fine-tuning and inference fit within the memory envelope of a single 24 GB consumer GPU.
AI.conclusion: For narrow, high-value clinical label-extraction tasks, distilling real GPT-4o-labeled reports, rather than generating synthetic ones, is the critical factor that closes the performance gap to a hosted proprietary model. This approach enables a private, low-cost, version-stable on-premises alternative suitable for deployment on consumer-grade hardware, addressing privacy, cost, and reproducibility concerns associated with proprietary clinical NLP models.

title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text
summary: Web text makes up the majority of pretraining data and is increasingly AI-generated. After applying FineWeb quality filtering, we find that 27.5% of tokens from June 2026 web data are labeled as AI-generated by Pangram, rising to 31.1% by August. Unlike synthetic data or model-collapse setups, this *wild* AI text comes from many models, is written for human readers, and arrives unlabeled in pretraining corpora. How does AI text in the wild affect language model pretraining? To answer this question, we pretrain 800 language models, varying the ratio of added AI tokens to human tokens, and fit scaling laws to held-out losses on both human and AI-generated text. For data-starved models, adding AI tokens to pretraining data initially lowers loss on human text, but the benefit saturates as more are added and quickly *reverses* into harm. For models trained on high budgets of human text, AI tokens raise loss almost immediately, while the same number of fresh human tokens keeps lowering it. Scaling laws such as Hoffman et al. (2022) fail to predict this behavior. We propose a new scaling law with separate benefit and harm terms that allows the value of an AI token to change sign while also reducing to Chinchilla in the absence of AI text. When fit on smaller models, our scaling law predicts the effect of AI text on held-out human-text loss for models up to 3.6x larger with 41% lower error than the best existing law over all AI ratios. We recommend filtering AI text when the target is human text, repeating human text before expanding the training dataset with AI-generated web text, and reporting validation loss on human and AI text separately AI text remains valuable when the target is AI text. We release WildAI, an 83B-token corpus with AI, topic, and format labels, all 800 models and code at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文研究了"野生"AI生成网页文本（即由各种模型产生、面向人类读者、未标记地混入预训练语料库的AI文本）对语言模型预训练的影响。通过训练800个不同规模的语言模型，作者提出了一种新的扩展定律，量化了AI token的"价值"（以等效人类token衡量）随人群建模而非人类预算增加而递减的现象，并提出了过滤AI文本、重复人类文本而非添加AI文本等实用建议。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成内容在网页中占比不断攀升（2026年6月达27.5%，8月达31.1%），且未来还将继续增长，但当前预训练流程缺乏对此领域的系统量化研究。已有研究要么关注合成数据，要么关注模型崩溃（模型递归训练自身输出），但二者都不能刻画"野生"AI文本（来自多种模型、为人类读者撰写、未标记地进入预训练数据）的真实场景。本文旨在填补这一空白，量化野生AI文本对语言模型预训练的影响。
AI.method: 1. 构建WildAI数据集：基于FineWeb v1.4.0扩展至2026年6月，包含9604万文档、833亿token，使用EditLens和Pangram 3.3.2进行AI/人类标注，使用WebOrganizer提取话题和格式标签。2. 训练800个模型：规模从1990万至9730万参数不等，人类token预算从2.9至87.5 TPP_h（人类token每参数），AI与人类token比例r从0至64不等。3. 提出新扩展定律：在Chinchilla定律基础上，将AI token的效益建模为指数饱和函数（与Muennighoff et al.和Qin et al.类似），将危害建模为对数递减的惩罚项γt^u n^v[log(1+r)-r/(1+r)]。当r=0时退化为Chinchilla定律。4. 在726个模型（1999M至268M）上拟合，在3970万和9.73亿模型上测试，预测效果优于所有现有定律。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：1. AI文本在人类token预算不足时（低于约10 TPP_h）有益，但从Chinchilla最优20 TPP_h起几乎立即开始有害。2. 新定律在所有人类文本评估集上预测效果最佳（C4上配对RMSE为0.83×10^-3，优于现有最佳定律的1.41×10^-3，降低了41%误差）。3. 预测在3.6倍更大模型上的效果，误差比Chinchilla降低41%。4. 在2026年8月的31.1% AI占比下，训练在未过滤爬取数据上需要1.6倍计算量才能匹配仅训练人类数据的效果，到2028年将增长至3.0倍。5. 重复人类文本优于添加AI文本（在C4上，1个epoch后损失降低2.3%，8个epoch后降低6.3-6.4%）。6. 当目标是AI文本时，最佳训练AI占比超过90%。7. FineWeb过滤管线保留AI文档的概率是人类的2.3倍，DCLM为9.8倍。8. 在22.3% AI占比的混合验证集上，95.5%的有害运行被误报为改进。9. 用AI文本训练的模型写作风格更接近AI（AI典型短语增加）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了针对野生AI生成文本的扩展定律，量化了AI token的价值（以等效人类token衡量）随人类预算和模型规模增加而递减的现象。研究表明野生AI文本在网页中占比不断增长（预计2028年底达50.7%），对预训练产生负面影响，尤其对训练预算充足的模型。提出了实用建议：（1）当目标是人类文本时过滤AI文本；（2）数据不足时重复人类文本而非添加AI文本；（3）在人类和AI文本上分别报告验证损失，因为AI文本更易预测，混合验证集会掩盖危害（掩盖率95.5%）；（4）当目标是AI文本时，AI文本仍然有价值。发布WildAI数据集（830亿token，带AI、话题和格式标签）以及全部800个模型和代码。

title: Absorbing State Phase Transitions in Multi-Agent Search
summary: Nontrivial dynamics can emerge in large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems, and preliminary evidence exists that formalisms from statistical mechanics can be effective at modeling and predicting such behaviors. In parallel, designing multi-agent communication topology for optimal task-solving is an active research question. In this paper, we focus on predicting the success of multi-agent search tasks using the formalism of absorbing state phase transitions. We first taxonomize search tasks into four types, informed by classical results in combinatorial search. We then theoretically derive a critical communication degree $d_c$, the minimum number of agents each agent can communicate with, above which incorrect hypotheses do not proliferate uncontrollably and the search enters the solved state. Finally, we evaluate frontier LLM-based multi-agent systems on real-world search and discovery tasks, software configuration debugging and physical mechanism discovery, and find that agreement with theory is mixed. LLM agents may not communicate with their neighbors and can develop strategies that are individually beneficial but limits the benefits of collaboration.

AI.tldr: 本文将统计力学中的吸收态相变理论应用于LLM多智能体搜索系统,提出了一种搜索任务分类法,并推导出关键通信度$d_c$,以预测多智能体在搜索任务中的协作成败。理论在确定性规则智能体上得到验证,但在LLM智能体上吻合度较差,因LLM智能体存在沟通不完整、herding行为等问题。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统在LLM任务中展现出复杂集体动力学,但目前对通信拓扑如何影响搜索任务的协作效果缺乏理论指导。本文旨在用统计物理的形式化方法(吸收态相变)来预测和解释多智能体搜索的成功条件。
AI.method: 1. 将搜索任务形式化为候选图$\mathcal{G}(\mathcal{C},\mathcal{E})$,分支因子为$b$,并提出四类搜索任务(needle、chain、hierarchical、factorizable),基于证据可复用性区分。2. 用均值场动力学推导每类任务的临界通信度$d_c$,分析不正确候选数量$A_t$随$d$的指数增长/衰减行为。3. 在三类可分解搜索任务(合成配置、TCAS配置调试、物理机制发现)上测试40个智能体,对比确定性智能体与四种LLM(Qwen3.5-4B/9B、GPT-5.4 Nano、GPT-6 Luna)在三种通信策略(Team-Auto、Team-Free、Indiv-Free)下的表现。
AI.result: 1. 确定性智能体在三个任务上均与理论$d_c$吻合良好(Lin's CCC=0.93/0.97/0.94)。2. LLM智能体普遍需要比理论值更高的$d_c$,尤其在自由通信策略下(因智能体经常不报告负面证据),GPT-6 Luna与Qwen模型差距显著,Qwen报告率仅49-66%。3. 提高推理努力反而增加$d_c$(因herding行为降低路径多样性:TCAS任务中独立字面量测试数从25.5降至11.3),但个体任务完成率仍上升。4. 温度$T=0.2$对不同模型影响不一致。5. $d_c^{Team-Free}/d_c^{Team-Auto}$与智能体报告率呈强负相关($r=-0.91$)。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了多智能体搜索的吸收态理论框架,揭示了通信拓扑设计与搜索任务结构耦合的重要性。结论指出未来需设计联合考虑搜索策略与通信协议的机制,以确保共享证据既能有效剪枝又维持探索多样性。LLM的herding行为、不完整沟通、个体最优策略等行为使现有理论假设失效,这为多智能体系统安全与能力提升提供了新的设计原则。

title: Recursive Organization Improvement: A Modeling Specification for Human--Agent Organizations
summary: Stronger AI agents do not automatically produce better organizations: teams must also learn which work arrangements to retain and when to reconsider them. We propose a modeling specification for recursive organization improvement and evaluate it through an executable checker, a public-record mapping, and controlled simulation. The specification connects actor-visible histories, organizational memory, decision rights, and evidence-carrying change contracts. The mechanism study crosses six decision rules, three memory conditions, and three task environments under fixed resource ceilings. In a stationary environment, cumulative evidence raises balanced evaluation's normalized net value per task from 0.45224 to 0.48007. Repeated reassessment's disadvantage relative to this comparator falls from 0.01702 with reset evidence to 0.00007 with cumulative evidence. A reversal of the best workflow reveals the opposite cost: indefinite retention delays adaptation, while a finite window restores eventual performance at a transition cost. In exploratory controls, matching trial acquisition and label reuse reduces the apparent reassessment gain from 0.00607 to 0.00191. Program replacement adds no stable benefit across the tested reversal times. The study identifies evidence acquisition, reuse, and timely updating as mechanisms that must be separated from evaluator replacement when assessing organizational improvement.

AI.tldr: Stronger AI agents do not automatically produce better organizations: teams must also learn which work arrangements to retain and when to reconsider them. We propose a modeling specification for recursive organization improvement and evaluate it through an executable checker, a public-record mapping, and controlled simulation. The specification connects actor-visible histories, organizational memory, decision rights, and evidence-carrying change contracts. The mechanism study crosses six decision rules, three memory conditions, and three task environments under fixed resource ceilings. In a stationary environment, cumulative evidence raises balanced evaluation's normalized net value per task from 0.45224 to 0.48007. Repeated reassessment's disadvantage relative to this comparator falls from 0.01702 with reset evidence to 0.00007 with cumulative evidence. A reversal of the best workflow reveals the opposite cost: indefinite retention delays adaptation, while a finite window restores eventual performance at a transition cost. In exploratory controls, matching trial acquisition and label reuse reduces the apparent reassessment gain from 0.00607 to 0.00191. title: Where Do Multi-Agent Systems Fail? Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis of Collective Mechanisms
summary: When a multi-agent system answers correctly, it is tempting to conclude that its agents shared, checked, and used information as intended. Yet a system can break one of its collective mechanisms, the rules that govern how agents route, admit, store, and act on shared information, and still return the right answer, while a wrong answer rarely reveals which mechanism failed. We ask what evidence from an execution is sufficient to conclude that a particular mechanism was violated. Our answer is a diagnostic contract, which separates what counts as a violation from which execution records can establish one, and concludes that a violation is supported, ruled out, or unknown; removing records can make this conclusion unknown but never reverse it. We test contracts for four mechanisms by replaying executions from the step where a mechanism acts, once unchanged, once with the mechanism broken, and once with it restored. Broken mechanisms often left the answer correct. An LLM diagnoser detected many more violations from internal records than from public outputs, yet with identical records a generic prompt often claimed certainty the records did not support, which prompts stating the contracts largely avoided. The contracts also applied, in narrow form, to mechanisms in independently developed systems, but a diagnostic behavior that was nearly perfect on our benchmark degraded on an independently developed workflow. A correct outcome is therefore no substitute for records of how collective mechanisms operated, and agreement on one benchmark does not show that a diagnoser transfers to another system.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"诊断契约"(diagnostic contract)框架，用于基于执行记录判断多智能体系统中特定集体机制是否被违反，而非依赖任务结果。核心发现包括：正确的结果不能证明机制未被违反；内部记录比公共输出更能揭示违规；声明契约的提示比通用提示更遵守证据义务；基准测试上的诊断表现不一定能迁移到独立开发的系统。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统可能违反其集体机制（管理信息路由、接纳、存储和行动的规则）却仍输出正确答案。基于结果的失败分析无法诊断此类隐蔽违规，因为：(1) 违规可能因偶然因素被正确答案掩盖；(2) 公共记录往往无法区分违规与合规；(3) 不同框架记录差异大，诊断语义难以统一。作者旨在回答：给定执行记录，什么证据足以认定特定集体机制被违反？
AI.method: 1. 定义"诊断契约"：将违规谓词（violation predicate，即什么构成违规）与证据规范（evidence specification，即需要看到哪些权威记录）分离；判定结果为三值（supported/ruled_out/unknown）。2. 提出四个诊断位点（locus）：access/routing、admission/dependence、state maintenance、representation/action。3. 构建受控基准：通过"共享前缀重放"协议，从机制生效步骤开始，分别以不变、破坏、恢复三种方式继续执行，以构造性地提供真地标签。4. 设计诊断器对比：使用相同证据包，比较通用提示（G0）、声明契约的零样本提示（G1）、加示例的提示（G2），并测试对独立开发系统的可迁移性。
AI.result: 1. 任务结果不能代表机制正确性：288个规范挑战中，43/72的admission违规仍产生正确答案；DRAC任务中28/137的违规也得到正确答案。2. 证据至关重要：LLM诊断器从公共输出仅恢复26.4%的违规，从内部原生记录可恢复63.2%。3. 程序遵守证据义务差异显著：通用提示G0有138/1152的"反向翻转"违反命题3.1；而G1、G2在有效输出中无反向翻转，且在几乎所有F→I对中保持判定不变。4. 可迁移性存在缺口：G1在规范基准上287/287对的irrelevance不变性，在Co-STORM独立工作流上仅13/28对保持。
AI.conclusion: 诊断契约将"什么算违规"与"需要什么记录来认定违规"分开，提供了一个基于证据的多智能体系统诊断方法论。论文证明：正确结果不能替代集体机制运行情况的记录；诊断必须由权威记录而非结果或标签授权；在基准测试上看起来已解决的诊断行为必须在每个新系统上重新测试。诊断契约在规范基准和独立开发的系统上以狭窄形式均适用，但诊断行为的迁移性不能被假设。

title: Fast and Scalable Multi-Agent Distribution Matching via Partitioned Optimal Transport
summary: This paper presents a scalable optimal-transport-based framework for terminal distribution matching in multi-agent systems. While optimal transport provides a natural way to measure distributional mismatch and assign agents to a desired spatial distribution, global discrete transport can become computationally expensive for large-scale systems. We address this bottleneck by partitioning agents and target samples into spatially corresponding blocks and solving smaller local transport problems. Under a mass-balance condition, the resulting restricted coupling remains feasible for the global problem and provides an upper bound on the Wasserstein cost. The local assignments generate target locations for finite-horizon agent control, applicable to both linear and nonlinear dynamics. By alternating local assignment and control, we establish a cycle-to-cycle descent guarantee for the resulting transport surrogate. The proposed framework therefore enables scalable terminal distribution matching while retaining a rigorous connection to the Wasserstein objective. The technical soundness of the proposed results is validated through simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于空间分区的最优传输框架，用于大规模多智能体系统的终端分布匹配问题。通过将智能体和目标样本划分为空间对应的K个块并求解局部传输子问题，在质量守恒条件下保证全局可行性，从而将一个M×N规模的全局OT问题分解为K个(M/K)×(N/K)规模的子问题，实现O(K²)的计算加速。结合有限时域重心控制和交替分配-控制迭代，证明了传输代理代数的逐周期单调下降性，并将其作为Wasserstein距离的严格上界。仿真验证了在M=300、N=1500规模下，K=10分区可实现26倍加速，仅以轻微匹配性能下降为代价。
AI.motivation: 全局离散最优传输在大规模多智能体系统中计算代价过高。传统的集中式OT分配需要处理M个智能体与N个目标样本之间的耦合关联，复杂度高达O(M³)，难以扩展至大规模群体。需要一种既保留OT理论连接性又能实现可扩展计算的方法。
AI.method: （1）将M个智能体和N个目标样本按空间划分为K个对应块，施加质量守恒条件M_r/M = N_r/N；（3）在每个块内独立求解规模约(M/K)×(N/K)的局部OT子问题，可并行执行；（2）组装分块对角全局耦合，通过重心映射为每个智能体生成唯一目标点；（3）对LTI系统采用最小范数闭式控制器，对非线性系统施加终端收缩假设；（4）交替执行局部分配与有限时域控制迭代，证明了逐周期代理代数单调下降性以及Wasserstein距离上界保证。
AI.result: 在M=30个LTI智能体、N=500个高斯混合目标样本、K=5分区的仿真中，分区代理代数随周期单调下降，验证了Theorem 1的收敛保证；分区OT在终端分布匹配上获得与集中式OT相当的定性性能。在计算效率方面，K=5和K=10分区相对集中式OT分别达到11倍和26倍加速（最大规模M=300、N=1500时从5.48s降至0.21s），且加速比随问题规模扩大持续改善，验证了O(K²)的理论计算缩减。
AI.conclusion: 分区OT框架在保留与Wasserstein目标的严格理论联系的同时，实现了大规模多智能体分布匹配的可扩展性。质量守恒条件保证了分区耦合对原始OT问题的全局可行性，循环到循环的下降性提供了收敛保证，而空间分解则带来了显著的计算收益。该方法以轻微的匹配性能损失换取数量级的计算加速，为大规模终端分布匹配提供了一种实用且理论严谨的解决方案。

title: Consensus and Factual Dynamics in Large Populations of Interacting Language Models
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as populations of interacting entities, in which consensus --agreement on a shared answer-- emerges as a collective, unengineered behaviour. Prior work on LLM consensus shows that agents can cross-verify their answers and converge towards more factual responses, treating agreement as a proxy for correctness. However, these studies usually fix a single interaction structure, leaving open how consensus depends on how agents interact. We address this gap by introducing RHEON, a physics-inspired framework that recasts a population drawn from a single frozen model as an evolving $O(n)$ spin system on a ladder of interaction geometries of increasing effective dimension --from a 1D ring to a full-coupling mean-field graph-- with the sampling temperature $T$ as the tunable source of thermal disorder, evolved through a Glauber-like asynchronous dynamics. Sweeping RHEON across $432$ configurations of prompt, population size, communication topology, and sampling temperature yields Eraclitus-4.7M, a tagged evolutionary corpus of $4.7$ million responses. We find that agents reach their strongest consensus gain within the first few update sweeps and that increasing the number of neighbours per agent accelerates convergence on average. We further show that whether a configuration settles on factually correct or hallucinated consensus is not predictable from its initial state alone, and that the hallucination-minimising temperature depends on how the agents are coupled, so the common near-greedy default is not automatically the safest. Finally, semantic agreement correlates positively with factual convergence, and interaction strengthens the association, yet never enough for unanimity to certify correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RHEON 框架，将同质 LLM 智能体群体重塑为 O(n) 自旋系统，沿交互几何阶梯（1D 环 → 2D/3D 环面 → 平均场）和采样温度 T 进行 Glauber 异步演化，扫描 432 种配置生成 Eraclitus-4.7M 数据集（470 万条带事实性标签的响应），系统揭示了交互拓扑与采样温度如何共同决定共识的速度与事实正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 共识研究通常固定单一交互结构，将一致视为正确性的代理，忽略了交互方式（而非单个智能体）对群体集体结果的支配作用。理解群体如何在多种耦合方式下达成共识、且该共识是否事实正确，是部署多智能体 LLM 系统所亟需的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 构建 RHEON 框架：每个智能体的响应被编码为两个耦合自旋——白化后的句向量作为 O(n) 语义自旋 s_i ∈ S^{d-1}，以及二值事实自旋 σ_i ∈ {-1, +1}（由 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 评判）。在 1D 环、2D 环面、3D 环面、平均场四种图上以 Glauber 式异步动力学演化 10 轮，配位数 k = 2, 4, 6, N_a-1；温度 T ∈ {0.1, …, 1.6} 控制采样热噪声。使用 Qwen3-14B（4-bit）作为冻结骨干，固定每条响应 100 tokens，跨 6 个 FreshQA 提示（含 3 个含错误前提）扫描 432 种配置 × 5 次独立试验，共 4,767,840 次 LLM 调用。定义宏观序参量：语义磁化强度 m(t)、语义内聚 c̄(t)、幻觉密度 ρ(t)。
AI.result: 核心发现：(1) 共识是近乎普遍的结果，在所有几何上均达成；连接数越高，收敛越快且越完全（平均场 m≈1）。(2) 幻觉多数不稳定，正确少数能将群体拉回正确方向，故初始多数票不能预测事实结局（区别于对称投票模型）。(3) 共识与事实性都在前几轮扫掠中定型（前载性），t=4 处两曲线均已平台化，可截断以节省 54.5% 算力。(4) 采样温度是真控制参数但非单调：局部耦合下 T* 接近冷端（T=0.1），全局耦合（平均场）下 T*≈1.0，冷采样将群体锁定在初始共识中，需要热噪声让正确少数翻盘。(5) 语义一致性与事实收敛正相关（Pearson r 峰值 +0.36），但交互不足以使一致保证正确——最一致的群体可能是最自信地错误的群体。Eraclitus-4.7M 数据集已公开，包含四套句向量编码，跨编码器的 Spearman 秩相关 ≥ 0.899，结果稳健。
AI.conclusion: RHEON 框架与 Eraclitus-4.7M 数据集表明：共识是交互协议的必然产物，但其事实正确性不由初始状态唯一确定，温度对事实结局的非单调控制意味着常用的近贪心默认并不自动安全；温度必须与耦合方式匹配。部署中可通过前几轮轨迹早期判读结果，且不能将一致性作为正确性代理。后续方向包括在扫掠中退火 T 以兼顾逃逸错误共识与后期稳定性，以及放松同质性假设检验异质部署下秩序的存续。

title: Solving Multi-Agent Sokoban via LaCAM
summary: Sokoban, a puzzle game in which an agent pushes boxes onto unlabelled target locations in a grid world, is a long-standing benchmark planning problem. While it is easy to see the connection to practical applications such as warehouse logistics with autonomous forklifts, its multi-agent counterpart has remained underdeveloped. This is because Multi-Agent Sokoban is substantially more difficult due to factors specific to multi-agent planning, such as the rapidly growing branching factor as the number of agents grows and the need to handle integrated task assignment and collision-free pathfinding. In this paper, we show that a scalable planner for Multi-Agent Sokoban can be designed by leveraging recent advances in multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF). Specifically, our Sokoban-LaCAM efficiently solves instances involving tens of agents and boxes while preserving both completeness and eventual optimality guarantees. This provides evidence that MAPF can serve as a powerful primitive for solving broader collective automation problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Sokoban-LaCAM，一种基于多智能体路径规划（MAPF）算法LaCAM的可扩展规划器，用于解决Multi-Agent Sokoban问题。该方法通过约束PIBT生成联合动作，并结合目标-箱子分配、Agent-站位分配等启发式策略，在保持完备性和最终最优性的前提下，能够在秒级时间内解决涉及数十乃至上百个智能体和箱子的实例。
AI.motivation: Multi-Agent Sokoban是一个将任务分配（哪个agent推哪个box到哪个target）与无碰撞路径规划紧密耦合的组合规划问题，与仓库物流等现实场景高度相关。然而由于智能体数量增加导致的分支因子爆炸式增长，传统搜索方法难以扩展。该问题在文献中受到的关注极少，缺乏专用求解器。作者希望探索MAPF技术能否作为解决更广泛集体自动化问题的可扩展规划原语。
AI.method: 方法核心是将LaCAM配置空间搜索框架扩展到Multi-Agent Sokoban：(1) 使用Sokoban-PIBT作为配置生成器，agent动作决定箱子移动；(2) 偏好构造分两步——目标-箱子分配（用推感知距离做瓶颈分配的轻量启发式+局部搜索）和Agent-站位分配（受约束的贪心+交换优化）；(3) 搜索增强：随机重启、基于h_T-B-A的可纳启发式（结合目标-箱子和agent-箱子距离下界）、卡住检测（启发式停滞时重启）、死局剪枝（2×2箱子块等）、无标签重复检测（agent和箱子均不可区分时压缩Explored表）。最终通过LaCAM*获得最终最优性。
AI.result: 在5×5空地图上与IDA*对比：Sokoban-LaCAM*求解93.3%，IDA*仅30.0%；27个共同求解实例中Sokoban-LaCAM*初解<0.1ms，最终全部收敛至最优（次优因子1.00），并对其中24个证明最优。在大规模压力测试中（最多100个agent和100个box），Sokoban-LaCAM聚合成功率68.2%，远超Sokoban-PIBT单独运行的40.2%。消融实验显示卡住检测贡献最大，随机重启对解质量影响显著，偏好构造的随机化版本仅能求解2.8%实例，验证了启发式设计的关键性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明基于MAPF的配置空间搜索（LaCAM+PIBT）通过适度的领域适配即可有效扩展到任务分配与物体操作耦合的多智能体规划问题，远超传统搜索方案的规模。MAPF不应被视为孤立的规划问题，而应作为构建更复杂多智能体规划系统的可扩展算法原语。未来方向包括集成学习启发式以进一步引导搜索。

title: StateFork: Branchable Infrastructure for Agent Exploration
summary: AI agents improve task success by exploring multiple trajectories, but for computer-use agents each trajectory modifies external environment state. Branching from an intermediate point is correct only when restoration is observation-equivalent - future actions produce the same observations - and practical only when creating, restoring, and discarding branch states is physically efficient. We study this problem for terminal-using agents, where tasks modify files, shell context, running processes, and local services. We introduce StateFork, a logical control plane that separates exploration policies from physical state materialization, exposing sessions, commands, snapshots, restores, and cleanup over multiple execution substrates. We also build Waypoint, a checkpoint/restore substrate for terminal execution sessions that combines filesystem layering, process checkpointing, and a persistent terminal-compatible command session. Together, StateFork and Waypoint improve terminal-agent exploration by combining sample-efficient search with efficient restoration of the right execution state. On Terminal-Bench, branch-based exploration through StateFork and Waypoint improves task completion over pass@20 at the same visited-node budget, and using Waypoint achieves 26% higher task accuracy than other execution substrates while completing exploration up to 70% faster. These results show that observation-equivalent, physically efficient execution sessions are a key systems abstraction for exploratory AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文针对计算机使用智能体在分支探索时面临的环境状态恢复问题，提出StateFork逻辑控制层和Waypoint执行会话检查点/恢复底座。StateFork将探索策略与物理状态物化分离，提供统一的会话、快照、恢复操作接口；Waypoint以OverlayFS、CRIU进程检查点和持久PTY shell组合的方式高效恢复执行会话状态。在Terminal-Bench上，Waypoint使任务完成率比其它底座高26%，探索完成速度最高快70%。
AI.motivation: 终端使用型智能体在分支探索时，每条轨迹都会修改外部环境状态。仅靠模型上下文进行分支是错误的——分支的正确性需要"观察等价"（未来动作产生相同观察），分支的实用性需要创建、恢复、丢弃分支状态的物理高效。现有执行底座（文件系统快照、CRIU、容器/VM快照、replay等）要么恢复不完整，要么开销过大，且需要智能体理解底层实现细节，缺乏可移植性。
AI.method: 1. 提出StateFork逻辑控制平面：暴露build_session/exec_command/snapshot/restore/cleanup五个操作；区分物理检查点（实际快照）和虚拟检查点（记录命令日志，从最近物理祖先replay）；Smart Decider策略基于驻留内存大小和累积replay成本，线性估计检查点成本，决策何时物化为物理检查点。2. Waypoint执行会话底座：将执行会话（文件系统+进程/内存+PTY shell+本地服务）作为原生检查点边界；文件系统用OverlayFS in-place分层实现大小无关的快照；用CRIU转储shell进程树；通过Unix域socket提供命令服务器接口；checkpoint/restore时协调OverlayFS重建与CRIU恢复。3. Terminal-Bench上对比pass@20与MCTS，并对比Prefix Replay、Docker commit、Podman-Hybrid、Waypoint四种底座。
AI.result: Terminal-Bench上77个任务平均，StateFork+Waypoint相比其它底座：任务完成率提升26%，探索完成时间最高缩短70%；Microbenchmark中Waypoint快照延迟比最优对照底座低3.6×，恢复延迟低2.1×，且对文件系统大小不敏感；Smart Decider相对Eager物化降低23%完成时间和58%检查点存储；MCTS在相同节点预算下优于pass@20。
AI.conclusion: 观察等价且物理高效的执行会话是可探索AI智能体的关键系统抽象。StateFork通过将逻辑探索树与物理状态物化解耦，使同一探索策略可移植到不同底座；Waypoint证明在执行会话边界组合OverlayFS、CRIU和持久shell即可避免容器/VM级开销。实验验证了检查点/恢复底座的设计选择对终端智能体探索效率具有决定性影响。局限：Waypoint针对受控智能体探索，非租户级沙箱；外部服务/网络状态需要任务特定协调；当前仅支持终端，GUI支持需扩展会话边界。

title: Extending eBPF observability to Non-standard execution environments
summary: eBPF observability of non-standard execution environments (NEEs) like TEEs or LibOSes is hindered by their unconventional exception-handling and memory-access mechanisms that limit standard Linux tooling. This work introduces two mechanisms that enable eBPF-based observability for NEEs: (1) kernel memory extensions for safely accessing NEE memory from eBPF programs, and (2) a lightweight flexible probe performance measurement unit (LWFP PMU) that provides flexible and generic probing, for NEEs, through the following LWFP: simple (SLWFP), enclave (ELWFP) and extended (ExLWFP) probes. We demonstrate the practicality of these extensions by developing tooling for tracing, stack sampling with Flame Graphs, dynamic instrumentation, timing analysis, and USDT support for Intel SGX enclaves and LibOSes. Performance measurements show that SLWFP probes achieve a latency of 394 ns, outperforming uprobes, which exhibit 25% higher latency, while ELWFP probes incur a latency ~2.8 microseconds, which is practical for enclave observability. The addition of SLWFP introduces negligible overhead to existing uprobe performance. Taken together, this work lays the foundation for closing the long-standing gap between NEE tooling and Linux observability tooling by enabling generic and reusable eBPF tooling for diverse NEE hardware and software architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一组基于eBPF的原语（安全内存访问、轻量级灵活探针LWFP及异常处理），使eBPF可观察非标准执行环境（NEE），如可信执行环境（TEE，包括Intel SGX）和库操作系统（LibOS），填补了NEE与Linux原生可观察性工具之间的长期差距。
AI.motivation: 非标准执行环境（NEE），如Intel SGX、LibOS（Gramine、SCONE）和unikernel，使用非标准的代码加载、内存访问和异常处理机制，导致标准Linux可观察性工具（uprobes、kprobes、eBPF）无法有效工作。现有的NEE专用工具（如TEE-Perf、SGXoMeter、Intel VTune）功能单一、依赖重编译或嵌入式插桩库，缺乏通用性和可重用性，无法满足云环境中对性能调优、调试和正确性验证的需求。
AI.method: 提出了三项关键原语：(1) P1——通过扩展Linux内核`struct vm_operations_struct`，增加VMA操作方法（检测、访问、加锁/解锁），使eBPF辅助函数（如`bpf_probe_read`）可安全访问NEE受保护内存；(2) P2——设计轻量级灵活探针性能监控单元（LWFP PMU），引入新的perf事件类型`PERF_LWFP`，支持三种探针：简单（SLWFP，匹配RIP）、Enclave（ELWFP，匹配RIP+RBX，针对SGX）和扩展（ExLWFP，匹配任意寄存器组合）；(3) P3——将LWFP集成到Linux异常处理与eBPF基础设施中，通过`register_die_notifier`回调实现上下文感知匹配。探针生命周期管理中，代码插入和目标发现由用户空间负责，内核仅负责注册、异常投递和事件管理。配套工具包括：基于DWARF的eBPF栈采样器（含Flame Graph）、动态/静态插桩器、strace（系统调用跟踪与画像）、函数计时工具和USDT支持工具（以MariaDB为目标）。
AI.result: 实现基于Linux 6.0.0内核（新增679行内核代码）。性能评估在Intel Xeon 6787P服务器上进行，针对Intel SGX SDK、Gramine-SGX和SCONE软件栈。探针延迟测量结果：SLWFP（SSB）原生延迟394 ns，比uprobes（505 ns）快25%，比硬件断点（492 ns）快17.5%，且对原生uprobe性能影响可忽略；ELWFP（ESB）和SGX硬件断点在enclave往返延迟约2.8 µs，主要由AEX时间（EENTER→EXIT 1617 ns）主导。功能性验证：成功生成SCONE运行MariaDB的火焰图（识别出`spmc_dequeue`耗时热点）；strace追踪Gramine-SGX上Python3的libz搜索路径问题及SQLite3系统调用画像；USDT工具生成MariaDB查询延迟直方图。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过三项eBPF原语成功弥合了NEE与Linux原生可观察性工具之间的差距，使通用、可重用的eBPF工具能够跨多样化硬件和软件NEE架构工作。其灵活性允许通过简单的驱动接口集成支持新NEE架构（如类SGX的vSGX集成直接），并通过为现有BCC工具添加NEE prologue/epilogue实现便捷移植。论文奠定了NEE可观察性的基础，未来工作包括支持任意硬件架构的通用PEO探针和进一步优化。

title: Capture the lifecycle: KV Cache management in ReAct Agents with KVTether
summary: Efficient serving of long-context reasoning-and-acting (ReAct) agents relies on KV cache reuse to reduce large language model (LLM) prefill latency and monetary cost. However, a semantic gap exists between agent harnesses and the underlying serving stack. Through context mutation, tool execution, and subagent coordination, context messages may become actively engaged, permanently discarded, and temporarily unused, while the serving stack only observes accesses to the corresponding KV cache. This lifecycle blindness prevents recency-only policies such as LRU from reclaiming dead KV promptly and from preserving older KV that will be reused sooner than newer entries. We present KVTether, a lifecycle-aware KV cache management framework for ReAct agents. By tracing semantic primitives embedded in agent harnesses, KVTether captures runtime lifecycle semantics during highly dynamic execution. KVTether then translates message-level semantics into KV-level lifecycle states and uses these states to drive state-prioritized cache management without exposing physical complexities to agent harnesses. After reclaiming dead KV, KVTether preferentially preserves live-but-idle KV that is waiting for reuse, reducing premature eviction before reuse. Across agent benchmarks and production workloads, KVTether reduces end-to-end request latency by up to 26.3% and 17.4% relative to LMCache and MORI, respectively, and lowers estimated task cost by 40.0% and 33.2% on average.

AI.tldr: KVTether提出了一种面向ReAct智能体的生命周期感知KV缓存管理框架，通过在智能体框架层面暴露消息级语义原语，将消息生命周期事件翻译为KV级生命周期状态，并采用状态优先级策略（回收Expired KV）+ MRU策略（处理Suspended KV），解决了现有LRU策略因无法区分"死KV"与"活但空闲KV"导致的僵尸缓存驻留和错误方向驱逐问题。
AI.motivation: ReAct智能体在应用层（智能体框架）与底层推理服务栈（vLLM/SGLang等）之间存在语义鸿沟：框架通过append、replace、remove、fork等消息级操作管理上下文逻辑生命周期，但服务栈只能观测到KV缓存的页面访问事件，导致基于LRU的策略无法及时回收已死KV，也无法保留即将被复用的旧KV。生产trace分析显示：LMCache的僵尸KV占比可达36.3%，错误方向驱逐率高达71%-95%。
AI.method: KVTether采用三层流水线设计：（1）语义原语模型：在框架层暴露8个消息级原语（append、replace、remove、fork、spawn、one_off、pin、unpin），捕获消息生命周期事件；（2）事件驱动生命周期管理器：将消息级事件翻译为KV级生命周期状态（Pinned、Active、Suspended、Expired、Temporary），并通过前缀依赖性正确性处理replace/remove导致的后缀失效，管理跨上下文共享KV；（3）状态引导缓存引擎：采用状态优先级准入策略——Temporary直接绕过、Expired优先回收、Suspended次之、Active兜底、Pinned最后竞争；在Suspended层使用MRU策略驱逐最近挂起的KV。
AI.result: 在12块GB200 GPU的三节点集群上，使用GLM-4.7（358B）模型配合SGLang和MoonCake进行评估，对比LMCache（LRU）和MORI（基于空闲度的预测式基线）：（1）端到端性能：KV缓存命中率平均提升33.3%（vs LMCache）和24.5%（vs MORI）；预填充时间平均降低29.2%和23.3%；端到端延迟最高降低26.3%和17.4%；任务成本平均降低40.0%和33.2%。（2）消融实验：禁用生命周期跟踪时，僵尸KV占比达22.1%-38.5%，命中率下降25.6%；禁用MRU（改用LRU）时，错误方向驱逐率高达65.6%-92.3%，命中率下降29.1%。（3）易用性：集成到6个不同智能体框架（Codex、SWE-agent、OpenCode、Hermes、Agent-G、OpenClaw）仅需26-216行代码。（4）运行时开销：原语记录<100μs/次，LLM调用插入<50ms，KV范围解析约350ms（256K token输入），总开销约2%。
AI.conclusion: KVTether通过将消息级生命周期语义从智能体框架显式导出到KV管理层，解决了ReAct智能体中KV缓存管理的语义盲区问题。其核心贡献在于：生命周期感知的语义原语模型和状态优先级+MRU策略，无需依赖精确的复用预测即可在不确定的复用间隔下同时解决僵尸KV驻留和错误方向驱逐两个问题。该框架在多个生产trace和基准测试上显著优于现有基线，且对框架开发者友好。

title: Tide: Reclaiming Phased Memory in Agent MicroVMs
summary: Cloud agents run each task in an isolated MicroVM. The trouble is the harness loop inside that guest: the harness is nearly idle while it waits on the model, then usage rises on a tool whose size is known only at run time, which complicates memory management from the host. Existing approaches infer reclaim targets from access frequency and memory footprint while the guest allocator places the idle harness and the short-lived tool on the same pages. Therefore, reclamation either selects the wrong pages, fixes on an incorrect capacity, or partially reclaims a huge page, splitting its transparent huge page. This paper proposes Tide, a proactive memory reclamation technique for agent MicroVMs. Our key insight is that the harness already knows each phase's memory intent (which memory, when, and whether its contents must survive), so the guest can report that intent as an exclusive guest-physical region for the host to reclaim directly. To realize this insight, we introduce an abstraction called arena and a set of user-space APIs for managing memory with exclusive intent; a guest-kernel allocator that groups exclusive allocations into huge-page-aligned extents; and a hypervisor extension that resolves those extents to host backing and applies the reported action, leaving guest capacity unchanged. Experiments on recorded agent trajectories show that Tide outperforms state-of-the-art mechanisms while incurring low overhead.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tide，一种针对云端智能体MicroVM的主动内存回收技术。核心思路是利用harness已知的各阶段"内存意图"（memory intent），通过新增的arena抽象将不同生命周期的内存隔离在2MB对齐的guest-physical区段中，由hypervisor直接回收host侧内存而不缩减guest容量。
AI.motivation: 云端智能体每个任务运行在独立MicroVM中，harness在等待模型时几乎空闲，而工具执行时内存需求突增且大小运行时才可知。现有方法（交换、按访问频率推断、virtio-balloon/virtio-mem缩容）存在三类问题：①分不清空闲但存活（harness）和已死亡（工具）的页面；②元凶地按footprint定目标容量，无法适配突发需求；③guest分配器把不同生命周期的页混在同一个2MB THP中，回收会分裂透明大页映射。
AI.method: 三个层面的设计：(1) 用户态arena API（create_arena/spawn_with_arena/pageout/pagein/destroy_arena）让harness将不同生命周期的内存分别放入独占的arena H（harness）和T（每次工具调用）；(2) Anchor作为harness的代理，运行在H和T之外，负责RPC代理、信号拦截、grace period判定、suspension broker，并通过cgroup挂起harness；(4) Guest内核的arena分配器从共享CMA池分配2MB对齐的独占extent，通过virtio通道把arena及其guest-physical范围及操作意图报告给hypervisor；(3) hypervisor端virtio后端解析guest-physical范围到host backing，按意图执行pageout/pagein/discard，不修改host内核。流程为：model wait时pageout(H)（内容保留，换出到swap），工具退出时destroy_arena(T)（直接丢弃），next请求到来前pagein(H)避免major fault。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench八个任务上，Tide相对于baseline在六个耗时>1s的任务上偏差在1.7%以内；在Terminal-Bench六个任务上，于OpenCode/OpenClaude/Codex上相比baseline的总backing memory分别减少45.3%、41.0%、34.2%，相比HyperAlloc分别减少46.8%、39.3%、32.9%，harness时间仅增加5.1%、1.1%、1.9%。实现覆盖Linux、Firecracker、OpenCode/Claude Code/Codex，Anchor用Rust实现。
AI.conclusion: Tide通过让guest主动报告"内存意图"（哪个区域、何时、内容是否需保留）而非让host从访问频率/footprint推断，解决了agent MicroVM中harness空闲页和工具私有页难以区分、容量目标难以确定、不同生命周期混合在同一个THP内导致回收分裂映射三大问题，使host可按策略直接回收host backing且不缩减guest容量，端到端大幅降低backing memory且开销很低。

title: Herschel: Continuous Optimization of Production LLM Inference through On-Demand Profiling
summary: Model-as-a-service platforms call for continuous optimization as complex serving conditions expose inefficiencies missed before deployment. Detailed always-on profiling can incur substantial overhead, while lightweight collection omits information needed for diagnosis. We present Herschel, a continuous optimization system for production large language model (LLM) inference. Our key insight is that adaptive, on-demand profiling can provide rich full-stack evidence without continuous collection. Herschel safely attaches to and detaches from selected running processes without engine changes or restarts, and adapts coverage as investigations reveal missing evidence. Herschel reconstructs operator executions and cross-process dependencies to identify inefficiency mechanisms and suggest solutions using applicable reference fixes. AI agents implement and test engine and kernel changes under controlled conditions that preserve the triggering workload and dependencies, with expert review before deployment. Controlled tests show active-collection overhead below 0.5% for time to first token and 7% for time per output token. Bounded windows, typically 30 s, avoid the continuous cost of always-on tracing. Over six months, Herschel collected approximately 17,000 traces across over 120 model variants and more than 10 accelerator types, identifying inefficiency patterns in 23% of the traces. Representative findings guide widely deployed optimizations, including restructured synchronization, removal of unused computation, and improved operator implementations.

AI.tldr: Herschel是阿里巴巴针对生产环境LLM推理部署的持续优化系统，通过按需性能剖析、自适应分析和AI代理驱动优化，在不重启服务的情况下识别并修复性能瓶颈。
AI.motivation: MaaS平台需要day-one可用性，部署前调优无法覆盖复杂服务场景下的所有低效问题；现有方法（异常检测、always-on剖析、引擎耦合插桩）各自存在局限性，无法兼顾全面证据采集与低开销。
AI.method: 三大组件协同：Hprof通过ptrace运行时附加机制实现无重启剖析（典型30秒窗口）；Analyzer重建算子执行和跨进程依赖，匹配35种已知低效模式并关联参考修复方案；Optimizer利用AI代理在受控实验环境中迭代实现并验证引擎与算子优化。
AI.result: 控制测试显示采集开销TTFT<0.5%、TPOT<7%；6个月生产部署中采集约17,000条trace（120+模型变体、10+加速器），23%的trace匹配到低效模式；4项代表性优化广泛部署，如Paged Attention算子在XPU-C上SOL提升155%、TPOT降低8-32%。
AI.conclusion: Herschel验证了自适应按需剖析+机制化分析+代理驱动优化的可行性，为生产LLM推理的持续性能改进提供了可扩展的工程范式。

title: Large Language Models are Approximate Survival Estimators
summary: Survival analysis estimates time-to-event outcomes from patient covariates and is widely used for medical risk assessment. Patients seeking prognostic information after a diagnosis may turn to large language models (LLMs), now readily accessible through consumer applications. However, whether LLMs can provide accurate survival predictions has not been rigorously evaluated. We introduce Survprompt, a framework that converts structured patient covariates into free-text clinical vignettes and prompts pre-trained LLMs to predict survival zero-shot. We benchmark Survprompt against conventional survival models, including random survival forests (RSF), across two multi-institutional pan-cancer cohorts: the publicly available MSK-CHORD cohort and a newly curated cohort from the Providence St. Joseph Health Network constructed using an LLM-based medical abstraction framework. We report censored mean absolute error (cMAE) and concordance index (c-index) and conduct feature ablations to identify variables influencing LLM predictions. Frontier LLMs achieved surprisingly competitive cMAE for individual survival times. For example, GPT-5.6-Sol achieved cMAE within 10% of state-of-the-art RSF models specifically trained for survival prediction for several cancer types and lower cMAE than RSF for prostate cancer in MSK-CHORD. Feature ablations revealed that LLMs prioritized clinical variables similarly to specialized survival models. However, LLMs showed inconsistent accuracy across cancer types and institutions and poorly discriminated between high- and low-risk patients (lower c-index). Zero-shot LLMs can generate surprisingly accurate prognostic estimates without specialized training, but their variable performance across cancer types and institutions remains an important limitation for clinical use.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Survprompt框架，将结构化患者临床特征转化为自由文本临床小故事，以零样本方式提示预训练大语言模型(LLM)预测癌症患者生存期，并在两个多机构泛癌队列(MSK-CHORD和Providence)上与随机生存森林(RSF)等传统生存模型进行基准对比。结果显示前沿LLM在个体生存时间点估计精度(cMAE)上具有出人意料的竞争力，但风险区分能力(c-index)和校准能力较差，且在不同癌症类型和机构间表现不一致。
AI.motivation: 癌症患者在确诊后越来越多地通过消费级应用向大语言模型寻求预后信息，但LLM能否提供可靠的生存预测尚未得到严格评估。传统生存分析方法依赖手工特征工程、对协变量关系的刚性假设以及针对特定数据集的训练，限制了其灵活性和跨数据集泛化能力。因此需要一种能够跨数据集泛化、处理异构输入且无需任务特定训练的生存预测方法。
AI.method: 核心方法是Survprompt框架，包含：(1)数据——使用两个多机构泛癌队列(公开的MSK-CHORD和通过LLM医学抽取框架新构建的Providence队列)，涵盖五种癌症类型(NSCLC、BRCA、CRC、PANC、PROSTATE)；(2)提示生成——将结构化表格特征(人口统计学、治疗、病理学、疾病状态、转移、基因组学、实验室检查)转化为自由文本临床小故事；(3)零样本推理——向预训练LLM(GPT-5.6-Sol为主要模型)提供小故事，要求其输出21个(x,y)坐标对参数化0-10年生存曲线，从中提取期望生存时间；(4)评估指标——使用删失平均绝对误差(cMAE)作为主要指标，同时报告一致性指数(c-index)、综合Brier分数(IBS)和D-Calibration校准；(5)特征消融分析——通过提供不同特征子集评估各临床变量对LLM预测的影响。基线为针对特定癌症和数据集训练的RSF模型。
AI.result: LLM在个体生存时间点估计上表现出与RSF可比的cMAE：例如GPT-5.6-Sol在多个癌症类型上cMAE在RSF的10%以内，在MSK-CHORD的前列腺癌中cMAE甚至略低于RSF(5.52 vs 6.58年)。特征消融显示LLM与RSF在特征依赖模式上一致，疾病状态特征贡献最大。然而LLM在所有癌症类型和队列中的c-index均低于RSF(如前列腺癌MSK-CHORD中0.75 vs 0.82)，表明风险排序能力有限；Survprompt在所有组合中D-Calibration均失败。性能在不同癌症类型和机构间不一致，LLM倾向于在长预测时间窗口低估生存。Kaplan-Meier曲线在早期窗口重叠较好。运行间变异性小。
AI.conclusion: 零样本LLM可在无任务特定训练的情况下生成令人惊讶地准确的个体生存时间点估计，在cMAE上接近专门训练的RSF模型，但在风险区分(c-index)和校准方面仍逊于专门模型，且在不同癌症类型和机构间表现不一致。LLM的灵活性和可移植性使其在缺乏训练数据或无法构建专门模型的场景中具有吸引力，但在临床部署前需进一步验证。患者和临床医生应将其输出视为粗略估计而非个性化风险预测。伦理层面需关注不准确预测对患者心理的潜在伤害以及在保险或治疗决策中的滥用风险。局限包括可解释性有限、API非确定性、MSK-CHORD潜在训练数据污染、Providence特征抽取的LLM可能引入误差、未评估人口亚组公平性差异。

title: Framing the Narrative: Ideological Mimicry in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer questions about politically contentious issues, yet evaluations typically treat a model's stance as a relatively stable property. Real users, however, communicate political signals through their terminology, assumptions, and personal context. We investigate whether such signals produce ideological mimicry: systematic shifts in the political stance expressed by an LLM toward the position conveyed by the interaction. If LLMs adapt their responses to these signals, they risk creating personalised political information environments in which users with opposing views receive systematically different accounts of the same issue, potentially reinforcing existing divisions. We build the Poli-SHIFT dataset and evaluation framework and assess seven open-weight LLMs across ten contentious political topics in the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, systematically manipulating contested terminology, politically valenced premises, and user information, and eliciting responses in both multiple-choice and open-text formats. Across models, we find robust evidence that prompt framing shapes the political stance of LLM outputs. Changing terminology alone reverses which side of an issue a model supports in 16.9% of matched comparisons. Stated political ideology also systematically shifts responses toward the user's position. These findings show that political stance is not a fixed property of LLMs; the views expressed are conditional on the interaction with the user. As LLMs become increasingly personalised sources of information, such interaction-dependent adaptation could contribute to political information environments that reinforce users' existing perspectives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大语言模型在政治敏感话题上是否存在"意识形态模仿"现象,即模型是否系统性地将其表达的政治立场向用户交互中传递的政治信号方向偏移。研究构建了Poli-SHIFT数据集和评估框架,在美国、英国和澳大利亚三个国家的十个争议性政治议题上测试了七个开源权重LLM,操控争议性术语、政治倾向前提和用户人口学信息,并采用选择题和开放文本两种形式。发现提示框架确实系统性地塑造LLM输出的政治立场:仅更改争议性术语就会在16.9%的对比中逆转模型所支持的立场方向;用户声明的政治意识形态也会显著推动回答向用户立场靠拢。论文主张政治立场评估应同时测量基线立场和条件敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有政治偏见评估通常将LLM的立场视为相对稳定的属性,而忽略了真实用户通过术语选择、假设前提和身份信息传递的政治信号。如果LLM确实根据这些信号调整回答,持不同政治观点的用户可能会从同一个模型获得系统性不同的答案,加剧信息茧房和极化。这促使研究者将研究问题从"LLM是否有特定政治偏见"转向"LLM的政治立场是否系统性地依赖于交互中的政治信号"。
AI.method: 构建Poli-SHIFT数据集和评估框架(Political Stance Heterogeneity under Interaction and Framing Tests),采用预注册实验设计。控制条件基于三国(BES/ANES/AES)选举调查问卷,三种处理条件分别是:争议性术语(例如"undocumented migrants"vs."illegal immigrants")、政治倾向前提(例如强调经济贡献vs.经济负担)以及用户传记(含意识形态、种族、性别、年龄、教育五个属性的2,700个独特组合)。测试七个开源权重LLM(Command A、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Falcon 3 10B、Gemma 3 27B、Llama 4 Scout、Mistral Large、Qwen 3.6 27B),覆盖十个争议性政治议题和三个英语国家。使用五点Likert量表(MCQ)和最多50词的开放文本(OT)两种形式;OT由三个LLM评判员盲评打分并由人类标注员验证。主要结果指标是"亲方向-反方向"立场差异(pro-side minus anti-side),采用配对t检验和OLS回归分析,辅以聚类标准误的稳健性检验。
AI.result: 三个假设均得到强支持。H1(争议性术语):全部七个模型在MCQ和OT两种形式下均显示出统计显著的方向性术语框架效应(MCQ效应从+0.51到+1.55,OT从+0.23到+0.91);16.9%的匹配配对在仅更改术语后就跨越中性中点,逆转模型所支持的立场方向。H2(前提框架):效应更大且更一致,平均+1.21点(术语为+0.87点),OT前提效应最强(+0.90到+2.16)。28个模型×格式×处理组合中有27个在主题聚类推断下仍然显著。用户传记中,显式意识形态是最大且最一致的预测因子(partial η²=0.124-0.370,远超种族、性别、年龄、教育),保守派身份将回答推向反方向,自由派推向亲方向。MCQ一致性较高(自矛盾率多数≤8.7%),OT变异性较大;LLM评判员间一致性为r=0.78-0.88,与人类标注员一致性相当(r=0.84)。平均而言,亲方向表述使立场较基线偏移+0.80点,反方向为-0.25点,呈现不对称性。
AI.conclusion: LLM的政治立场不是固定属性,而是依赖于交互中的政治信号。三种独立的政治信号源(争议性术语、政治前提、用户意识形态)均一致地引发意识形态模仿,效应在选择题和开放文本两种形式下均成立,在七个不同开发背景的模型间稳健。这对政治偏见评估具有直接方法论意义:标准审计应同时测量基线立场和在合理政治交互条件下的条件敏感性,而不是仅报告中立提示下的立场。该现象也可能对日益个性化的AI系统构成信息环境层面的风险——持相反观点的用户可能从同一系统获得系统性不同的信息。局限包括仅覆盖三个英语国家、单轮交互、传记作为个人化代理而非真实部署情境、五点量表压缩立场粒度,以及未区分预训练与RLHF等训练阶段对效应的因果贡献。

title: EVOKE: Eliciting World Knowledge in Agents for Transferable Decision-Making
comment: 19 pages. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL ; Models: this https URL
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents for multi-step decision-making, yet transfer poorly to unseen environments. World-model methods address this by training agents to predict future observations, at the cost of additional training and errors that compound when predictions are used for planning. However, for LLM agents operating in digital environments, much of this world knowledge is already internalized during pretraining, which shifts the problem from acquiring it to eliciting it. We argue that typical post-training provides little pressure for such elicitation, since supervision under a single goal at each visited state inadvertently drives policies to rely on superficial contextual habits. We introduce EVOKE, a post-training method that supplies this pressure through goal diversity at fixed states. Motivated by theory showing that an agent competent across diverse goals must encode a world model recoverable from its action preferences, EVOKE holds the environment state and interaction history fixed and ranks the same candidate actions under alternative goals, forcing action preferences to change, so that a policy relying on contextual habits or single-goal correlations cannot order them correctly. This implicitly elicits the policy's pretrained world knowledge to inform decisions. We evaluate EVOKE across diverse tasks in three backbones, demonstrating improved task performance, unseen environment generalization, and data efficiency. We further conduct controlled analyses to better understand what drives these gains. These findings offer a new perspective on eliciting internalized world knowledge for transferable action through direct decision supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出EVOKE方法，通过在固定状态下对同一候选动作在不同目标下进行排序，以激发LLM智能体内部化的世界知识，从而提升多步决策任务中的泛化能力和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在多步决策中难以迁移到未见环境。传统世界模型方法需要额外训练且预测误差累积；而LLM智能体在数字场景中已内化大量世界知识，但后训练在单一目标监督下导致策略依赖表面上下文习惯，无法有效激发该知识。
AI.method: EVOKE是一种后训练方法：保持环境状态和交互历史固定，对同一候选动作集合在不同替代目标下进行排序监督。理论依据是，能在多样化目标下正确排序动作的智能体必然编码了可从动作偏好中恢复的世界模型。该方法通过直接决策监督迫使策略依赖内化的世界知识，而非上下文习惯或单目标相关性。
AI.result: 在三个骨干模型上的多任务评估表明，EVOKE提升了任务性能、对未见环境的泛化能力以及数据效率；通过受控分析进一步理解了收益来源。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为通过直接决策监督激发LLM智能体内化的世界知识以实现可迁移动作提供了新视角，揭示了目标多样性在后训练阶段对世界知识提取的关键作用。

title: Halluscoring 2026: The first shared task on llms hallucination detection and answer verification
summary: We present HalluScoring 2026, a shared task for evaluating hallucination detection and factual verification in Arabic question answering under challenging generalization settings. The shared task is organized into two main tasks, each comprising two subtasks, for a total of four subtasks. Task 1 evaluates binary hallucination detection, considering generalization to unseen questions (Subtask 1.1) and responses generated by unseen LLMs (Subtask 1.2). Task 2 extends the evaluation beyond detection by requiring the systems to additionally identify the correct factual answer from six related candidates, covering Islamic knowledge (Subtask 2.1) and general knowledge (Subtask 2.2). The shared task is based on two Arabic datasets: HalluScore and HalluTruthQA. A total of 13 teams participated in the shared task, 10 of which submitted system description papers. The results of Task 1 demonstrate that hallucination detection remains challenging under distribution shift, with the winning team achieving AUC-ROC test scores of 0.772 and 0.767 for Subtasks 1.1 and 1.2, respectively. For Task 2, the winning team achieved scores of 0.882 and 0.857 in the Islamic and general-knowledge subtasks, respectively, under assisted evaluation.

AI.tldr: HalluScoring 2026 是首个面向阿拉伯语问答的 LLM 幻觉检测与答案验证共享任务，包含两大主任务（共计四个子任务），涵盖对未见问题和未见 LLM 的二分类幻觉检测，以及在伊斯兰知识与通用知识领域中同时识别幻觉并从六个候选选项中选出正确答案的联合任务。基于 HalluScore 和 HalluTruthQA 两个阿拉伯语数据集，共有13支队伍参赛，10支提交了系统论文。获胜系统在 Task 1 上 AUC-ROC 分别为 0.772 和 0.767，在 Task 2 辅助评估下得分分别为 0.882 和 0.857，揭示了分布偏移下幻觉检测仍具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 尽管阿拉伯语 LLM 应用日益广泛，其生成内容的真实性与可靠性（幻觉问题）尚未得到充分评估，尤其在泛化到未见问题、未见生成模型以及识别正确事实信息方面缺乏标准化基准。这促使研究者组织一个聚焦阿拉伯语问答的共享任务，以严格评估幻觉检测与事实验证的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 任务设置两大主任务四个子任务：Task 1 二分类幻觉检测（Subtask 1.1 跨未见问题泛化、Subtask 1.2 跨未见 LLM 泛化）；Task 2 联合幻觉检测与正确答案选择（Subtask 2.1 伊斯兰知识、Subtask 2.2 通用文化），后者需从6个语义相近候选中选1。数据集为 HalluScore（827题×17个LLM生成的14059条标注实例）与 HalluTruthQA（4000条涵盖伊斯兰、历史、科学、地理）。评估指标采用 AUC-ROC 与 F1-Macro（Task 1），以及 0.5×F1_macro + 0.5×AnswerAcc（Task 2），分 blind 与 assisted 两种设置。参赛队伍主要采用基于编码器（CAMeLBERT、ARBERT、MARBERT 等）的方法（Task 1）和基于解码器（ALLaM、Fanar、Gemma、AceGPT 等）配以 QLoRA/LoRA 等 PEFT 策略（Task 2），并使用集成、知识蒸馏、反事实监督、跨检查验证、多阶段推理等技术。
AI.result: Task 1.1 中 REGLAT 以 AUC-ROC 77.17 居首，紧随 ARBERT 基线（76.39）、AyahVerse（76.30）和 NAMAA（75.96）；Task 1.2 中 NAMAA 以 76.70 夺冠，相对最佳基线提升 2.78 点。开发集与测试集之间存在显著性能差距（如 REGLAT 从 94.13 降至 77.17，Sense 从 94.16 降至 74.61），反映出对系统性幻觉倾向问题分布的泛化难度。Task 2 中 Anhnamxtanh 在两个子任务的 assisted 与 blind 设置下均获第一（2.1：0.882/0.859；2.2：0.857/0.835），Hashtag AI 在 2.1 blind 设置下表现更佳（0.826）。总体而言 assisted 设置下平均提升约 5.99%（2.1）和 15.12%（2.2），表明候选信息对多数系统有益。
AI.conclusion: HalluScoring 2026 表明阿拉伯语问答中的幻觉检测在分布偏移下仍具挑战性，多个系统在未见问题与未见 LLM 上出现显著性能下降；同时，Task 2 揭示了检测幻觉与识别正确事实信息之间的能力差异。结果强调需要开发跨问题、跨生成模型均鲁棒、且能从检测迈向可靠事实验证的阿拉伯语幻觉检测系统。

title: Evaluating Language Model Safety Across Long Adversarial Conversations
summary: Conversational safety evaluations often test language models with a single harmful prompt, even though real-world systems interact with users through long, adaptive conversations. This study examines whether models continue to respond safely when an adversarial user persists across multiple turns. We evaluate three open-weight, instruction-tuned models on two harmful prompts across different conversation lengths and random seeds. In each setting, a second language model acts as a persistent adversarial user, while a safety classifier labels every response as safe or unsafe. Across all model-prompt combinations, first-turn safe-response rates ranged from 85% to 100%. By depth 11, they dropped to 38-61%, and by depth 101, to 15-44%. This decline appeared across models and continued well beyond the short interactions typically used in multi-turn safety evaluations. These results provide proof-of-concept evidence that strong single-turn safety does not necessarily persist during sustained adversarial interaction. They highlight the need for long-horizon evaluations and conversation-level safeguards that account for risk accumulating across turns.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实验证明，大语言模型在单轮安全评估中表现良好，但在持续对抗性的长对话中，安全响应率会随着对话深度显著下降，揭示了单轮安全评估的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM安全评估主要基于单轮或短多轮对话（通常3-10轮），而真实世界中用户与聊天机器人的交互可能持续数周甚至数月。多个真实案例（如Character.AI导致青少年自杀、Replika对未成年人发送不当内容等）表明，有害响应往往在多轮交互后才出现。现有的单轮安全基准可能系统性低估了对话式AI系统中的风险。
AI.method:
1. 评估对象：三个不同组织的开源指令微调模型（OpenAI GPT-OSS-20B、Meta Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Google Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it）
2. 任务设置：使用两个有害prompt（专业医疗建议、武器构造危险信息）
3. 对抗用户：使用同一模型的另一实例作为"影子用户"（shadow user），持续追求有害目标
4. 安全评判：使用Llama Guard 4作为固定第三方安全分类器
5. 两组实验：
   - 短对话实验：穷举式构建深度11的完整二叉对话树（2048条路径），10个随机种子
   - 长对话实验：50棵树中各采样50条分支路径至深度101，50个随机种子
AI.result:
1. 第一轮安全响应率：85%-100%（与单轮基准结果一致）
2. 深度11时：下降至38-61%
3. 深度101时：进一步下降至15-44%
4. Gemma-4-26B在第一个prompt上达到最低的15%
5. 安全下降趋势在所有模型、所有prompt、所有随机种子中一致出现
6. 重要发现：影子用户在后期被判定为"安全"的比例上升，而助手的安全率仍持续下降，表明助手安全性并非仅由上一条用户消息的危害性决定，而具有历史依赖性
7. 安全下降开始于深度3-4轮，之后持续下降
AI.conclusion:
1. 单轮安全性能无法预测长对话中的安全表现
2. 持续的用户压力（无需特殊越狱技巧）本身就能揭示单轮评估无法发现的安全失败
3. 应将对话安全视为长程可靠性问题，而非一次性拒绝任务
4. 需要长程评估方法和会话级安全防护措施，以应对跨轮次累积的风险
5. 部署保障措施应在对话层面运作，检测同一有害目标的持续追求，跨轮次聚合风险，并在有害意图持续时实施更强干预

title: Evaluating Whether LLMs Can Reliably Connect the DOTs?
summary: Access to real-world information is often noisy and fragmented. Constructing a coherent narrative from such fragments requires models to reconstruct missing spans within a broader storyline, commonly referred to as text infilling, while preserving consistency with both the local context and the global storyline. Despite using text infilling as a pre-training objective in many Large Language Models (LLMs), their actual performance on real-world narrative infilling remains underexplored. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing a multi-domain benchmark of ~9.2K instances for narrative infilling, constructed by masking one to three sentences across four narrative types: encyclopedic text, commonsense stories, news articles, and visual narratives. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 20 instruction-tuned open-source LLMs ranging from 1.5B to 70B parameters across varying levels of instruction specificity and reasoning guidance. Outputs are assessed using standard automatic metrics and a qualitative framework covering five narrative dimensions. Results show that model scale does not reliably predict infilling quality: Gemma-2-2B achieves the highest qualitative score (4.02/5), outperforming models over ten times larger, including DeepSeek-Qwen-32B (3.77/5, 6.6%) and LLaMA-3.3-70B (3.71/5, 8.3%). We further find that explicit reasoning offers limited benefits as chain-of-thought reasoning yields only a marginal improvement (+0.6%). Additionally, short narratives and domain characteristics emerge as stronger predictors of task difficulty than infill position alone for narrative infilling in current LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个包含约9.2K实例的多领域叙事填充基准，并系统评估了20个开源LLM（1.5B-70B）在不同指令特异性和推理策略下的表现，发现模型规模不能可靠预测填充质量，Gemma-2-2B以4.02/5的最高定性分数超越了包括70B在内的更大模型，且显式推理（如CoT）仅带来边际提升（+0.6%）。
AI.motivation: 虽然文本填充被广泛用作LLM预训练目标，但其在真实世界叙事填充任务中的实际表现尚未被充分探索。现有评估多聚焦于局部重建（token级补全、句子融合），而忽略了全局叙事一致性需求。
AI.method: 构建多领域基准（Wikipedia、ROCStories、CNN/DailyMail、SIND共9,142实例），遮蔽1-3个连续句子；评估20个指令调优开源LLM在两个轴上的表现——指令特异性（TELeR框架L0-L4）和推理引导（演绎、因果、CoT、反事实）；使用5种自动指标和5维定性评估框架（流畅性、上下文忠实度、双向连贯性、叙事一致性、信息量），以GPT-4.1-mini作为评判LLM，并通过300样本人工验证其可靠性。
AI.result: 主要发现：(1) 适度增加指令特异性可提升自动分数16.7%和定性分数3%，但L4（含少样本示例）出现性能下降；(2) 推理引导收益有限，CoT仅+0.6%，反事实推理反而降低性能（QAvg降至3.64）；(3) 模型规模不保证质量，Gemma-2-2B（4.021）超过DeepSeek-Qwen-32B（3.774）和LLaMA-3.3-70B（3.707）；(4) 自动指标与定性评估相关性弱（最高Kendall τ仅0.141）；(5) 短叙事（5-6句）+ 开头位置是最差组合，低分率可达16%；(7) 故事型叙事（ROCStories、SIND）比事实型（Wikipedia、CNN/DailyMail）更受益于推理引导；(9) GPT-4.1-mini与人工评估Spearman相关性约0.56-0.60，处于可接受范围。
AI.conclusion: 叙事填充对当前LLM仍是挑战，平均定性分数仅3.80/5；指令设计比模型规模更重要；显式推理仅带来边际收益但对故事型叙事的高质量生成比例有帮助；叙事长度和领域特性比填充位置更能预测任务难度；自动指标与叙事质量的系统性评估相关性弱，凸显开发叙事感知评估方法的必要性。

title: DEdit: Iterative Draft Editing for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive LLMs by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Diffusion-based drafters further reduce drafting latency by proposing multiple tokens at once. However, these tokens are predicted independently, so a single early error causes prefix verification to discard the rest of the draft, even when it contains useful downstream predictions. We introduce DEdit, a diffusion-based drafter that can not only draft by conventional parallel unmasking but also iteratively edit its draft through token-to-token predictions. Through editing, later predictions can serve as bidirectional context for repairing earlier errors and extending the accepted prefix. To teach the model to repair errors while preserving correct predictions, we propose ProposalMix, a training scheme that mixes draft predictions with ground-truth tokens based on first-pass confidence during training. Across seven benchmarks on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, DEdit achieves the highest macro-average token acceptance and speedup among the evaluated drafters, reaching macro-average speedups of $5.72\times$ and $5.97\times$ over autoregressive generation under greedy decoding, respectively. Further analysis shows that acceptance improves with more editing passes and wider drafting windows, and that ProposalMix halves harmful edits that shorten the accepted prefix. Moreover, restricting the editor to causal attention lowers acceptance, especially on highly predictable outputs, indicating that future context is a key source of these gains.

AI.tldr: DEdit 提出了一种基于扩散模型的推测解码起草器，在目标模型验证前对初始提案进行多轮双向迭代编辑。通过 ProposalMix 训练策略（根据首轮置信度混合草稿预测与真实 token），模型学会了修复错误同时保留正确预测。在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，DEdit 在贪心解码下分别达到 5.72× 和 5.97× 的宏平均加速，是当前评估起草器中性能最优的。
AI.motivation: 扩散式起草器并行预测多个 token，但各位置缺乏条件关联，一旦某个 token 出错，整个前缀都被丢弃，后续即使正确的 token 也被浪费。已有方法（如 Domino）通过因果修正恢复依赖关系，但只能利用前缀上下文，无法利用后续正确预测来修复早期错误。
AI.method: 1) 迭代编辑机制：使用同一起草器，先从 mask 输入并行生成初始提案（P1），然后用 K-1 轮编辑 pass，以完整提案作为双向上下文同时更新所有位置；2) ProposalMix 训练策略：在置信度高的位置用真实 token 替换预测，保留其余预测，让编辑器学会区分该修改和该保留的情况；3) 联合训练：单一网络同时训练 P1 和 P2 目标，共享参数；4) 窗口扩展：从 W=16 收敛检查点继续训练以适配 W=24/32。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B/Qwen3-8B 的七个任务上，DEdit P3 (W=32) 在贪心和随机解码下均取得最高宏平均 τ（7.58/7.75）和最高加速比（5.72×/5.97× 贪心）。窗口扩展 16→32 时接受率提升 10.3%（DFlash 仅 2.1%）；ProposalMix 将有害编辑比例从 9.9% 降至 4.7%。遮蔽未来 token（因果注意力）使接受率全面下降，在 Copy-heavy 任务上最大（+0.724 至 +0.897）。
AI.conclusion: 双向编辑能让后续正确提案 token 为早期位置提供修复上下文，这是因果修正器所不具备的能力。DEdit 将迭代细化引入推测起草，并以 ProposalMix 对齐编辑目标与前缀验证目标。在合理执行环境下，编辑带来的接受率提升可转化为端到端加速，但实际生产部署中还需联合调度设计。

title: StreamDecisionBench: Evaluating Decisions in Force on Evolving Language Streams
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Code and data: this https URL
summary: As natural language drives more applications, language models increasingly run inside programs as decision components: the program sends them the current state and acts on the returned decision until a newer one arrives. When evidence changes during inference, a decision correct for its own state can stay in force after that state has passed, as when a call recorder keeps running after a customer starts reading out a card number; untimed (offline) accuracy counts such an error as correct. We introduce StreamDecisionBench (SDB), which evaluates the decision in force at every instant and attributes every erroneous instant to judgment, latency or both. Its scenarios stream evidence in four application families, with reference decisions computed from public rules by executable code. We summarize in-force accuracy across update intervals of 1-5 s by its normalized area under the curve on a logarithmic time axis, giving equal weight to equal multiplicative ranges. Across six settings of four hosted models, this score stays within 2.9 points of the scenario-wise product of untimed accuracy and an oracle's integrated timing score. Reasoning improves judgment, but at low effort latency costs Luna and Terra, two GPT models we also evaluate without reasoning, 38.8 and 42.8 points relative to untimed accuracy; a faster component with weaker judgment attains a similar integrated score to Terra without reasoning. The aggregate and family curves show where these tradeoffs change, making the evaluation's time-scale dependence visible.

AI.tldr: StreamDecisionBench (SDB) 是评估语言模型作为实时决策组件的新型基准，通过在四个应用场景家族（IDE调试、装配站、客服呼叫、演讲者语音控制）中流式传输证据，衡量每个时刻生效的决策（in-force decision）的准确性，而非传统的离线准确性。它将每个错误时刻归因于判断（judgment）、延迟（latency）或两者兼有，并使用1-5秒对数时间轴上的AUC来对结果进行总结。评估了六个设置（四款托管模型，包括GPT系列Luna、Terra、Astra和商业决策模型Jev），发现延迟导致低推理设置下38.8-50.5分（相对于非定时准确度）的损失，而推理的关闭或调整会在判断和延迟之间产生不同的权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型越来越多地作为实时应用中的决策组件（例如IDE状态徽章、装配站指令、客服呼叫录音暂停），传统的离线（untimed）准确度评估存在缺陷：当证据在推理过程中发生变化时，对当前状态正确的决策在新状态到达后可能仍然生效并造成错误（例如呼叫录音在客户读出卡号时未暂停）。这在流式感知（streaming perception）领域已有讨论，但缺乏针对语言模型作为嵌入式决策组件的综合基准。该研究旨在填补这一空白，提供一个能区分判断错误与延迟错误的评估框架。
AI.method: 方法核心包括：(1) 设置与公共状态：每个场景发布60个时间步的状态（间隔1-5秒可调），使用不透明选项标签防止走捷径；(2) 分支组合决策（branch-composed decision）：应用消费由路由问题和分支问题共同组成的组合决策，正确性按组合后的整体判断；(3) 生效准确性（in-force accuracy）：在每个瞬间检查生效决策是否与参考决策一致，使用零阶保持（zero-order hold）和流式感知评估；(4) 错误分解：通过判断（答案对其源状态是否正确）、陈旧（stale，答案对源正确但已过时）、复合（两者都错）、幸运（lucky，过时的错误答案碰巧匹配新参考）等类别对每个错误时刻进行归因，并推导出 oracle in-force accuracy O 的精确分解公式 A = O·U_cur + λ；(5) 跨时间尺度集成：使用对数时间轴上1-5秒的归一化AUC（normalized log-AUC）作为主要评分指标，对相等的乘法范围赋予相等权重；(6) 执行协议：步骤锚定重放（step-anchored replay）确保延迟包含处理、服务和传输时间，但排除重试等待和队列等待；(7) 参考构建：使用基于公开规则的可执行代码计算参考决策，并通过盲法LLM代理审计验证；(8) 网络移除诊断：使用分位数回归估计延迟中不随token变化的网络部分。基准包含8个场景（每个家族2个），共480个状态、177次参考转换。评估了6种设置：GPT-5.6-Luna/Terra（低和无推理）、GPT-6-Astra（低推理）和商业决策模型Jev。
AI.result: 主要结果（归一化log-AUC 1-5秒）：Luna低50.0%（非定时88.8%）、Luna无33.4%（43.8%）、Terra低52.6%（95.4%）、Terra无60.1%（82.1%）、Astra低49.3%（99.8%）、Jev 60.7%（63.8%）。关键发现：(1) 低推理设置下，延迟导致38.8-50.5分损失，主要来自陈旧决策（37.9-51.6%对数加权时间）；(2) Astra低推理：尽管非定时准确度最高（99.8%），但log-AUC因2.67秒中位延迟而降至49.3%，几乎全部错误时间为陈旧；(3) Jev响应时间0.25秒，判断错误占对数加权时间的34.4%；(4) 推理有助于判断，但以低推理设置下的延迟为代价；关闭推理对Terra有效（log-AUC达60.1%），对Luna无效（降至33.4%）；(5) Terra无推理与Jev的综合分数相近，但在不同家族表现不同：Terra在IDE调试领先，Jev在另外三个家族领先；(6) 观察到的log-AUC与场景级非定时准确度×oracle时序分数的乘积在2.9分以内一致；(7) 对数加权vs线性加权会反转Terra无和Jev的排序（线性下Terra 64.2% > Jev 61.3%）。
AI.conclusion: SDB通过评估嵌入式决策组件在每个时刻应用的决策，而非仅评估每个状态的答案，为语言模型实时应用评估设立了新标准。其核心贡献在于：(1) 生效准确性指标与精确的错误归因分解，能清晰区分判断限制和延迟限制；(2) oracle时序因子分解表明观察分数与非定时准确度×oracle分数的乘积非常接近（2.9分内）；(3) 跨时间尺度的对数加权AUC揭示了不同模型的权衡变化。主要结论：低推理GPT模型主要受延迟限制（Jev则受判断限制）；关闭推理仅在判断仍可接受时有效（Terra有效，Luna无效）；类似的综合分数可能掩盖不同的家族级权衡（Terra在IDE调试最强，Jev在装配/演示/支持最强）；评估应同时报告非定时和oracle准确度、错误归因及聚合与家族曲线。该工作为语言模型作为实时决策组件的评估提供了必要的框架，强调了在快速变化环境中延迟与判断权衡的重要性。基准代码、数据、录音和可复现分析随论文发布。

title: Marking Contour Tones in Yorùbá
comment: Under review at the 12th World Congress of African Linguistics (WOCAL 12)
summary: Yorùbá is a tonal language in which contour tones pose persistent orthographic challenges. These are especially notable for personal names and lexical items whose conventional spellings avoid vowel lengthening that would otherwise provide a host syllable for the second tone. A particular concern is a class of names in which the conventional spelling does not just omit tonal information but inverts the meaning of said name, sometimes asserting the opposite of what the name intends. This paper describes the problem, illustrates the inadequacy of current solutions, and proposes the adoption of the caron and circumflex marks. These are symbols with precedent in Yorùbá phonological scholarship since Olmsted (1951), used as orthographic conventions on single vowels to encode rising and falling contour tones, making them accessible for the first time through standard keyboard input and computational text processing. The proposal is supported by an implementation in the WriteYoruba keyboard and the TTSYoruba speech synthesizer, whose architecture and listener evaluation are reported separately (Tubosun et al., 2026).

AI.tldr: 本文针对约鲁巴语（Yorùbá）声调语言中升降调（contour tones）在正字法和计算处理中长期缺失的问题，提出采用 Unicode 兼容的扬抑符（caron ˇ）标记升调（L+H）、抑扬符（circumflex ˆ）标记降调（H+L）的方案，作为元音重复拼写法的紧凑替代形式，并通过 WriteYoruba 键盘和 TTSYoruba 语音合成系统加以实现。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语的标准正字法仅能为单个元音标注一个声调符号，遇到升降调时传统上采用元音重叠（gemination）方式表示（如 Níkẹ̀ẹ́）。然而在大量人名和词汇中，约定俗成的拼写拒绝使用元音重复，导致声调信息缺失；更严重的是，部分名字（如 Ifápurọ́）因约定拼写掩盖了降调轮廓，使否定形态被隐去，语义被完全反转。尽管扬抑符与抑扬符在语音学文献中早有使用先例（Olmsted 1951; Oyětádé 1988），但既无正字法规范支持，也无键盘输入工具可用，形成长期未解决的结构性缺口。
AI.method: 1) 区分两类约束——跨音节音位过渡产生的"语音性轮廓"与历史性元音省略或复合造成的"词汇性轮廓"，聚焦后者；2) 形式化等价映射：规定 ǎ ≡ àá（升）、â ≡ áà（降）等 12 组等价关系，涵盖全部 7 个约鲁巴元音（含开元音 ẹ、ọ）；3) 将上述映射写入 WriteYoruba 键盘（macOS Option+</>，Windows ALT+</>）和 TTSYoruba 合成器，在规范化阶段将 caron/circumflex 字符扩展为对应的元音重叠串；4) 通过 N=50 的听觉评测验证两种标注法在自然度和可懂度上无显著差异。
AI.result: 1) 给出 20 个代表性词例（Table 1）和 10 个语义反转词例（Table 2）的完整对照表，展示扬抑符/抑扬符方案的紧凑性与准确性；2) 形式化 12 组 caron/circumflex 与元音重复的等价关系，可被任何约鲁巴语 NLP 管线直接采用；3) WriteYoruba 成为首个支持 ẹ̌、ọ̌、ệ、ộ 等开元音轮廓符号的键盘工具；4) TTSYoruba 评测（N=50）证实扬抑符形式与其元音重复形式的合成输出在感知上无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 扬抑符和抑扬符作为单一元音上的轮廓调标记，是约鲁巴语正字法的补充而非替代，与现有正字法委员会标准兼容。该方案弥合了语音学转写传统与现代数字排版之间的鸿沟，为 NLP 规范化、命名实体识别、文本转语音等应用提供可立即部署的解决方案；其推广依赖可访问性、可见度和机构认可，未来工作将基于 YorubaName.com 语料库进行系统分析、键盘扩展的用户测试以及开元音降调形式的进一步 TTS 评测。

title: Strong Multilingual Privacy Tagging at Encoder Speed
comment: 46 pages, 23 figures. Includes supplementary appendices. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review, October 2026 cycle
summary: Privacy redaction must remove personal information while preserving relationships expressed in text. We develop a multilingual named-entity tagger with fine-grained distinctions supporting varied redaction policies and methods for cheaply learning additional distinctions. We fine-tune a multilingual encoder with an affine span-tagging head on frontier-model annotations in 35 languages, replay mapped human gold with coverage-aware masking so unannotated types are not treated as negatives, and repair subword boundaries with a learned +/-1-character adjustment. On 1,283 human-gold test segments in seven languages, best measured redaction F1 is 88.8, against 69.1 for published GLiNER2 with 11 unrepresentable types excluded from its task (68.8 without that exemption), 67.8 for GLiNER2 adapted to the new training data, 57.3 for Microsoft Presidio and 35.8 for the best published OpenAI Privacy Filter fine-tune. Adding about 50,000 annotated training sentences and increasing human-gold replay improves exact typed-span F1 from 74.5 to 76.3 on Ont3, our 31-type frontier-annotated NER evaluation of 1,201 development segments. Mapped-gold replay alone raises human-gold F1 by ten points without loss on frontier-annotated text; boundary adjustment adds 1.7 exact typed-span F1 points on Ont3. Local LLMs fitting on a single 96-GB GPU underperformed as prompted annotators and frozen encoders, with encoding 30-95 times slower than XLM-R inference and prompted annotation roughly 180-1,100 times slower in the evaluated configurations. The encoder architecture delivers 4.9 times GLiNER2's CPU throughput. We release code, prompts and training recipes, with data-acquisition scripts and source links.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于XLM-R多语言编码器的隐私信息标注方法，通过仿射BIOES头、覆盖感知映射人工标注回放和±1字符边界修复，在35种语言上实现了优于GLiNER2、Presidio和OpenAI Privacy Filter的隐私信息检测性能，同时CPU吞吐量是GLiNER2的4.9倍。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私信息检测系统在多语言支持、细粒度类型区分、跨域泛化和部署效率方面存在不足，难以在保留文本关系的同时可靠地去除个人身份信息；本文旨在构建一个支持广泛编辑策略的多语言命名实体标注器，并探索高效学习新类型区分的方法。
AI.method: 在XLM-R-large上微调一个仿射token分类头（BIOES标注），使用覆盖感知映射将人工标注与前沿语言模型的标注结合进行训练（35种语言），通过约束的coarse-fine BIOES解码组合相关实体类型得分，并用一个小型学习排序器调整子词边界（±1字符），还探索了λ=0的非实体损失权重（忽略不完整标注中的未标记token）。
AI.result: 在7种语言1283个人工标注测试段上，最佳编辑F1达88.8，显著优于已发布GLiNER2（69.1）、Microsoft Presidio（57.3）和OpenAI Privacy Filter（35.8）；在Ont3的1201段开发集上，仅类型掩码F1从74.5提升至76.3；映射标注回放单独使人工标注F1提升10分；CPU吞吐量是GLiNER2的4.9倍；本地LLM（即使是31B参数）作为冻结编码器或提示标注器均显著劣于XLM-R，推理速度慢30-1100倍。
AI.conclusion: 任务匹配的前沿模型标注与覆盖感知映射人工标注回放相结合，可训练出XLM-R-large编码器，在多语言隐私信息检测任务上以编码器速度超越现有最优发布模型；简单的仿射头配合字符级边界修复即足够，更复杂的头部或LLM编码器未能带来一致改进；额外标注提升细粒度类型任务，已强的编辑分数增益较小。

title: MetaSteer: Context-Conditioned, nonlinear Steering via Attention-Projection Adaptation
comment: Preprint. Code and pretrained model checkpoints will be released shortly
summary: Steering large language models typically relies on linear, context-independent interventions in activation space, an assumption that recent work has challenged and that can induce an information bottleneck when a fixed representation must encode many behavioral distinctions. We introduce MetaSteer, a method that learns nonlinear interventions with context-dependent effects and applies them to attention projection matrices, producing activation effects that vary with the input context by construction and requiring no linear concept-geometry assumption. Framed as preference-based optimization, MetaSteer is trained once on a pooled preference corpus and transferred zero-shot to unseen concepts and out-of-distribution contexts. We find that, despite using low-rank adapters, MetaSteer induces structured, context-dependent changes in hidden-state trajectories while partially preserving aspects of their local trajectory dynamics, including velocity and curvature. We evaluate MetaSteer on three controlled text-generation benchmarks and three agentic settings across multiple model families and scales. MetaSteer matches or outperforms strong task-specific steering baselines on most aggregate comparisons in the zero-shot regime. Across the evaluated settings, stronger text-generation steering is associated with stronger agentic steering performance. We further discuss geometric trajectory effects, capability retention, and safety considerations raised by transferable steering.

AI.tldr: MetaSteer提出了一种基于偏好训练的非线性、低秩干预方法，通过同时修改注意力机制中的查询、键、值和输出四个投影矩阵，实现上下文条件化的LLM行为控制，无需依赖线性概念几何假设，可在零样本条件下迁移到未见过的概念和分布外上下文。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM引导方法通常采用线性、上下文无关的激活空间干预，这种方法在概念可能位于弯曲、各向异性流形上时会遇到信息瓶颈；因此需要一种能够适应输入上下文、无需强几何假设、且能保持模型通用能力的通用引导方法。
AI.method: MetaSteer在所有四个注意力投影矩阵（q/k/v/o）上应用低秩适配器，通过DPO目标在合并偏好语料上训练一次。由于适配器修改了投影矩阵而非添加固定向量，参数固定后其诱导的激活变化天然依赖于输入上下文。文章还通过轨迹位置、速度和曲率对隐藏状态轨迹进行了几何分析。
AI.result: 在AxBench、CLaS-Bench和PersonalityBench三个文本生成基准以及SocialEval、Dictator和Ultimatum博弈三个智能体设置中（涵盖LLaMA、Gemma和Qwen三个模型家族的六种规模），MetaSteer在零样本条件下的大多数聚合比较中匹配或超越强任务特定引导基线；几何分析显示引导可改变轨迹位置同时部分保留局部动力学（速度和曲率）。
AI.conclusion: 文章支持将引导视为受控的轨迹位移：干预必须诱导目标行为，同时保留任务相关动力学和通用模型效用；MetaSteer提供了一个无需线性假设、上下文条件化、可零样本迁移的解决方案，但需关注评估器可靠性和可迁移引导带来的安全考量。

title: Overlap, Unique and Conflict: Can LLMs Extract What They Can Recognize?
summary: Understanding multi-perspective alternative narratives requires identifying how their information agrees, conflicts, or differs across sources. Existing work on cross-text relations largely focuses on categorizing relations between predefined text pairs, such as entailment or contradiction, rather than directly extracting such information from full narratives. To address this gap, we introduce Overlap-Unique-Conflict (OUC) extraction, a cross-narrative task that extracts all overlapping, conflicting, and unique clauses from two narratives. To support this study, we construct a benchmark of approximately 22K narrative pairs and 140K OUC instances spanning factual, argumentative, and political discourse. Evaluating 14 open-source LLMs (0.6B-35B), we find that unique information is far easier to extract than overlap and conflict: the strongest model, Gemma-4-31B, reaches only 61.13% F1-score on overlap and 48.58% on conflict, against more than 75% on unique. Further diagnostic analysis reveals that this difficulty does not stem from relation recognition alone, but rather from a failure to pair and extract the corresponding clauses from full narratives, especially in smaller models. Nevertheless, learning these extractions with task-specific supervision narrows the gap considerably: a fine-tuned Qwen-3-8B gains 15-28% absolute over its baseline and surpasses models roughly four times its size (e.g., Qwen-3.6-35B) on several tasks. Even so, overlap and conflict remain well below satisfactory, leaving cross-narrative clause extraction an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OUC（Overlap-Unique-Conflict）跨叙事子句提取任务，构建了约22K叙事对和140K OUC实例的基准，评估14个开源LLM后发现小模型在重叠和冲突提取上存在显著短板，任务特定监督微调可大幅缩小差距，但完全提取仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有跨文本关系研究（如NLI、事实核查）依赖预定义的文本对或查询，忽略了从完整叙事中直接发现和提取共享、冲突及独有信息的核心难题。理解多视角替代叙事对于新闻分析、同行评审综合和事件报告等应用至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 提出OUC子句提取任务：从两个完整叙事中提取重叠对、冲突对和独特子句；2) 构建多领域基准（事实、政治、同行评审），采用LLM辅助自动管道（GPT-4.1-mini、Mistral等）生成银标注释并进行人工验证；3) 在14个开源LLM（0.6B-35B）上测试零样本、少样本和CoT提示策略；4) 通过瓶颈分析分离关系理解和对齐能力；5) 比较SFT、DPO和GRPO三种后训练方法及监督规模的影响。
AI.result: 1) 14个LLM评估显示独特信息提取远易重叠和冲突，Gemma-4-31B在重叠/冲突上仅达61.13%/48.58% F1，而独特任务超过75%；2) 瓶颈分析表明小模型在关系理解上表现尚可（如Qwen-3-8B重叠理解86.57%），但从完整叙事中提取配对时大幅下降（对齐62.21%，提取40.71%）；3) SFT带来最大且最稳定的提升，Qwen-3-8B经SFT后在冲突、独特任务上超越4倍大的模型（如Qwen-3.6-35B）；4) 仅25%监督数据即可达到接近全部监督的性能；5) 错误分析揭示跨叙事候选发现和隐式语义匹配是主要瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在跨叙事提取上存在根本性局限：小模型能识别重叠和冲突关系但难以从完整文本中发现并配对相关子句。任务特定监督（特别是SFT）能显著缩小差距，使小模型媲美4倍大小的模型，但重叠和冲突提取仍未达到令人满意的水平。跨叙事信息发现与配对仍是LLM的关键缺陷和未来重要研究方向。

title: You're Hired: Strategic Model Selection for LLM Collaboration
summary: While multi-agent and model collaboration algorithms gain traction to combine the strengths of diverse Large Language Models (LLMs), existing systems remain bottlenecked on pre-defined and hand-crafted model pools. In this work, we investigate the problem of model selection in multi-LLM systems. We propose and systematically evaluate a taxonomy of 9 selection algorithms ranging from diversity of model descriptions, capability-aware behavioral diversity, and LLM-based recruiters. We conduct extensive experiments across two candidate pools of 10 and 32 models, deployed in four model collaboration algorithms, and evaluated across tasks spanning math, coding, QA, and reasoning. Results demonstrate that successful selection algorithms greatly outperform random or heuristics-based teams such as merely selecting the models with top individual performance, by up to 36.1% across settings. Specifically, capability- and training-based selection strategies alleviate selection variance and achieve the best performance, which we recommend to employ before deploying real-world multi-LLM systems. Further analysis reveals that larger candidate pools pose greater challenges to shallow selection heuristics, while algorithms grounded in interacting with candidate models and understanding model capability robustly filter out misaligned, unsafe models, as well as generalizing to novel, out-of-distribution tasks. Together, we establish that principled and informed team selection is critical and present strong model selection algorithms for assembling effective multi-LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多LLM协作系统中的模型选择问题，提出了一个包含5大类共9种选择策略的分类法，涵盖标准基线、声明多样性、能力感知多样性、混合方法和基于LLM的"招聘官"。通过两个候选模型池（10个同构模型和32个异构模型）、四种协作机制（提示路由、多智能体精炼、权重融合、LLM-Blender）以及数学、代码、QA、推理等任务的广泛实验，证明基于能力和训练的选择策略显著优于随机或简单启发式方法（如仅选性能最强的模型），提升幅度可达36.1%。研究还分析了池规模缩放、多样性缩放、对抗鲁棒性（恶意模型过滤）和分布外泛化能力，强调了"招聘谁"与"如何协作"同等重要。
