Experiments on three multilingual ESCI locales show consistent improvements over matched full-SID training under autoregressive decoding. RARS also outperforms grouped soft-target, decoder soft-target, and sampled-tree supervision under a common retrieval rule. The gains persist across alternative identifier structures and relevance definitions. Code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出RARS（Resolution-Aligned Relevance Supervision），通过将文档级相关性度量投射到语义标识符（SID）层次结构的各个深度，形成一致的层级条件分布，并利用一个共享查询表示的辅助预测器来监督局部分支分配。预测器在训练后丢弃，保持标准自回归检索不变。在三个ESCI语言区域的实验表明，RARS在匹配的全SID监督基线以及分组软目标、解码器软目标和采样树监督等控制条件下均取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 在全SID监督下，多相关文档的查询对应的不同分支决策未被显式表征——同一查询在同一父节点下支持多个竞争的子分支，但标准训练将其视为独立的根到叶路径，存在监督-分辨率不匹配问题。论文旨在通过多分辨率相关性视角显式刻画相关性在层次结构各级深度上的分布。
AI.method: 将文档级相关性质量沿SID trie投影到每个深度，得到嵌套一致性分布；在每个相关性承载的父节点上构造条件分布作为局部目标；训练一个深度特定的查询级辅助预测器（通过深度投影和前缀条件子分数），使用父节点相关性质量加权的KL散度损失进行监督；所有承载相关性的子分支及高分合法兄弟负样本参与局部softmax；预测器在训练后丢弃，推理时仅用自回归解码器。附加检索时引入多分辨率兼容性评分，利用查询-目录属性和词汇证据在各SID深度上增强束搜索分数。
AI.result: 在ESCI-US/ES/JP三个区域，RARS在AR-only和全层级检索规则下均优于匹配的全SID基线（Recall@100与NDCG@10均提升）。在NQ320K上，对未见查询的Recall@10从最强基线的2.05%提升至16.52%。在不同SID结构（4×256 RQ-VAE、5×256 RQ-VAE、层级k-means）、不同训练相关性定义（E-only/E+S/E+S+C）以及不同超参数（树损失权重、兄弟负样本数、头维度）下增益均保持一致。多分辨率兼容性评分显著改善局部预测对齐和前缀覆盖。
AI.conclusion: RARS通过在SID层次结构各级深度上显式监督分支相关性分配，将文档级相关性连接到检索决策的整个谱系——从粗粒度前缀到个体文档。实验证明其增益在多种SID构造、相关性定义和检索评分设置下均稳健，且在仅Exact监督和Wikipedia文档检索场景下均有效。

title: Residual Trajectory Distillation for Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval has emerged as a general retrieval paradigm, representing items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and retrieving them through autoregressive identifier generation. When SIDs are constructed with residual quantization (RQ), standard retrieval training supervises only the selected codes and discards the residual trajectories that produce them. The same hard code can nevertheless arise from different preferences over competing codewords, while the residual trajectory also contains information about subsequent quantization decisions. As a result, hard SID supervision collapses distinct quantization behaviors into identical targets and leaves information available during indexing unused in retrieval training. We introduce ResTD, a Residual Trajectory Distillation framework that transfers this discarded indexing information into retrieval training. Treating the frozen RQ indexer as a process teacher, it distills residual-induced codeword preferences into SID-decoding states. This supervision recovers distinctions hidden by hard assignments and allows earlier decoder states to capture information about subsequent quantization decisions before the corresponding SID suffix is generated. In this way, richer information from SID construction is incorporated into retrieval learning while preserving the original retrieval index and inference procedure. Experiments on multilingual e-commerce retrieval show consistent improvements over strong baselines and matched training controls. Controlled comparisons show that residual-derived targets outperform the tested codebook-only soft targets. Representation probes further show that future codebook preferences become more recoverable from earlier decoder states. ResTD can also be readily extended beyond retrieval to generative recommendation. Code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResTD（Residual Trajectory Distillation），一个面向基于残差量化（RQ）语义ID的生成式检索的蒸馏框架。核心思想是将冻结的RQ索引器作为"过程教师"，把构造SID时被丢弃的残差轨迹信息（当前及未来量化层码字偏好）蒸馏到SID解码状态中，从而在保留原始检索索引和推理流程的前提下，为硬SID监督补充更丰富的几何偏好信号。
AI.motivation: 基于残差量化（RQ）构造的语义ID（SID）在生成式检索训练中只监督最终选定的硬码字，丢弃了产生这些码字的残差轨迹。同一硬码可对应不同的码字偏好分布，且残差还蕴含后续量化决策的信息。硬监督将不同的量化行为折叠为相同目标，造成索引与训练之间的信息鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) Residual Behavioral Distillation (RBD)：在每个量化层，由残差到冻结码书的距离构造软教师分布𝒬ₜ；解码状态经可学习投影g₀后与同一码书计算距离得到学生分布𝒫ₜ,₀，以KL(𝒬ₜ‖𝒫ₜ,₀)对齐码书加权期望。2) Multi-Horizon Residual Trajectory Distillation：引入H个horizon-specific投影{gₛ}，使早期解码状态hₜ对齐未来多个量化层（t+s）的码字偏好，构成三角形监督。3) Collision-Aware Teacher：沿存储SID路径重建残差轨迹，并以最小插值混合ϵₜ,ₛ确保教师分布优先选择存储码，保持与固定检索地址一致。整体损失ℒ=ℒ_GR+λ(u)·ℒ_RT，推理时丢弃教师与投影头，不改变索引与束搜索。
AI.result: 在ESCI多语言（英/西/日）产品检索上，ResTD在15个评测设置中一致优于稀疏、稠密及生成式基线，相对最强基线CaLIR在Recall@5提升13.76%~25.79%，NDCG@10提升14.40%~20.48%。匹配训练预算的对照显示：当前层RBD已优于full-output KD与Base-FT；多horizon (H=4) 进一步增益；优于future hard SID监督与codebook-only软目标；shuffle teacher与collision-aware校正均验证残差偏好与物品-教师对应的必要性。表示探针显示多horizon使未来码字偏好从早期解码状态更易恢复（KL相对降低5.3–13.8%）。ResTD在Beauty、Instruments、Yelp生成式推荐上也取得最佳成绩。
AI.conclusion: ResTD将RQ索引过程作为教师，把残差诱导的当前及未来码字偏好蒸馏到查询条件的SID解码状态中，恢复硬分配掩盖的区分性，同时不改变检索索引与推理流程。在多语言检索和生成式推荐上一致提升，受控实验与探针分析证实残差几何偏好与未来信息是增益的关键来源。

title: Generative End-to-end Ad Retrieval at Douyin
summary: Generative retrieval reformulates recommendation as the generation of discrete item tokens. However, scaling this paradigm to real-world recommender systems reveals two critical bottlenecks: 1) Representation collapse, where the item tokenizer converges to degenerate results under continuous distribution shifts, fundamentally hindering stable end-to-end adaptation. 2) Item collisions, where the massive candidate pool causes distinct items to share identical token sequences, compromising the final retrieval precision. Crucially, these bottlenecks are inherently coupled: expanding codebook capacity to mitigate collisions inevitably exacerbates collapse. To address them simultaneously, we propose GEAR, an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes the tokenizer, generator, and reranker. To mitigate representation collapse, we introduce BasisVQ, which re-parameterizes the codebook via an orthogonal basis to enable global gradient sharing and rigid spatial rotation of the latent space, effectively stabilizing gradient dynamics without ad-hoc heuristics. We further extend it to prefix-aware BasisRQ, substantially enhancing the codebook's expressiveness with the same asymptotic time complexity. To resolve item collisions, GEAR integrates a context-conditioned reranking head into the generative process, efficiently disambiguating colliding items with minimal computational overhead. By unifying stable tokenization and joint reranking within an end-to-end generative framework, GEAR establishes a fully differentiable and scalable paradigm. It currently serves hundreds of millions of daily active users on Douyin Ads, yielding substantial empirical improvements in extensive online A/B tests.

AI.tldr: GEAR 是抖音广告系统提出的端到端生成式检索框架，通过联合优化分词器（Tokenizer）、生成器（Generator）和重排序器（Reranker），同时解决大规模工业推荐中生成式检索面临的表征坍缩（representation collapse）和物品碰撞（item collisions）两大耦合瓶颈，已在抖音广告线上服务数亿日活用户。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索将推荐建模为离散物品 token 的自回归生成任务，但在大规模工业场景中存在两大关键瓶颈：1）表征坍缩——在流式数据的持续分布漂移下，物品分词器收敛到退化解，阻碍端到端稳定训练；2）物品碰撞——海量候选池中不同物品被映射到相同的 token 序列，影响检索精度。两者存在内在耦合：扩大码本容量缓解碰撞会加剧坍缩。现有方法（冻结分词器、启发式 EMA、附加唯一 token 等）均无法在避免计算开销过大的前提下同时解决这两个问题，因此需要统一的端到端方案。
AI.method: GEAR 由三个联合训练的模块组成：(1) Tokenizer：提出 BasisVQ，通过可学习的正交基矩阵（经 Newton-Schulz 迭代近似正交化）对码本进行重参数化，实现全局梯度共享并以刚体旋转形式稳定潜空间梯度动力学；进一步扩展为前缀感知的 BasisRQ，通过对每层码本施加基于先前量化结果的仿射变换（缩放 γ 与偏置 β）提升表达力，并推导出与标准 RQ 相同的 O(bNd) 距离计算复杂度，避免物化三维张量。(2) Generator：基于 encoder-decoder Transformer，编码器处理非序列特征、点击与转化序列，解码器以交叉注意力 + Gated FFN + 因果自注意力自回归生成 token。(3) Reranker：在解码器末尾增加一步解码得到用户表示，与分词器物品塔输出的物品嵌入做点积，以 LambdaRank（LTR Loss）在学习排序目标下联合优化，对碰撞物品进行细粒度消歧。训练采用渐进式热身策略：先训练 LTR，再启用 RQ 量化损失，最后启用 Gen 与 Rerank 损失。推理时 KV-cache 波束搜索生成 K_m 个候选序列，Rerank 做 INT4 低精度点积排序。系统层面解耦物品侧计算至近线索引构建，主路径只做序列生成与重排序。
AI.result: 在线 A/B 测试（7 天、5% 流量）：在抖音广告全量部署中，ADSS 提升 +0.563%，ADVV 提升 +0.658%，冷启动激活率相对提升 +1.46%。子集消融中，去掉前缀感知 BasisRQ 收益下降最大（ADSS +0.288% / ADVV +0.219%），去掉重排序头（ADSS +0.358% / ADVV +0.341%）和 secpm 加权（ADSS +0.395% / ADVV +0.354%）也带来明显下降。分词器分析中，前缀感知 BasisRQ (2048,512,128) 取得最高的码本利用率 8.83%、最低碰撞率 52.3% 和最低量化 MSE 1.82×10⁻³，显著优于均匀 (512,512,512)、无前缀 BasisRQ 和带 EMA 的 vanilla RQ。附录中的合成数据可视化实验进一步验证 BasisVQ 通过刚体旋转机制恢复死码的能力优于 SimVQ。
AI.conclusion: GEAR 在统一框架内同时解决了生成式检索在工业级推荐中的表征坍缩与物品碰撞两个核心难题：正交基重参数化在保持码本可微更新的同时稳定梯度动力学，前缀感知仿射变换以零额外渐近复杂度提升表达力，轻量级联合重排序头以最小开销消歧碰撞物品。基于训练-服务协同设计，系统已部署于抖音广告平台，服务数亿日活用户，在收入指标上获得稳定且显著的提升。未来工作将探索更高效的解码策略以进一步降低推理时延并拓展部署场景。

title: When the Label Ignores the Request: Auditing Policy-Selected Targets in Synthetic Conversational Music Recommendation
comment: 6 pages, 2 tables. Camera-ready version (CC BY 4.0). RecSys Challenge 2026 Workshop at ACM RecSys 2026, Minneapolis, October 2, 2026. Code and audit artifacts: this https URL
summary: Synthetic dialogues generated by LLM pipelines now serve as complete conversational-recommendation benchmarks: an LLM listener talks to an LLM recommender, and the track logged next in the conversation becomes the official label for each turn. These policy-selected labels make large-scale evaluation reproducible, but they are proxies for what the simulated user asked. We audit the one place where label and request are directly comparable: turns where the user asks for an exact song by name. In the RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay benchmark, using visible dialogue and catalog metadata alone, we find that the official label contradicts the user's exact-song request in half of the audited development turns. This matters beyond one benchmark: naming the desired item is the dominant intent in real music search, where deployed systems avoid substituting an alternative for an exactly named item, on the premise that it costs satisfaction. A small training-time supplement closes most of the gap: adding catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets to a small fraction of training turns yields a 53.3% relative gain in nDCG@20 on the 43 conflict turns while leaving the official metric intact, verified against a matched control that detects the same requests but trains only on official labels.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对RecSys Challenge 2026的TalkPlay合成对话式音乐推荐基准进行审计，发现在用户明确请求特定歌曲的开发集轮次中，有一半（约41/82）的官方标签与用户请求不一致；通过在1.5%训练轮次中补充"满足请求的目标"，可在43个冲突样本上将nDCG@20相对提升53.3%（从0.523升至0.802），且不损害官方指标。
AI.motivation: 合成对话推荐基准中的"政策选择标签"记录的是生成策略续接的下一首曲目，而非用户实际请求的内容。尽管现有研究关注标签噪声和模拟用户中的目标泄漏，但尚未有人系统审计过"官方标签与用户明确请求直接矛盾"这一失败模式。真实音乐交互中，按名点曲是主导意图，部署系统通常避免对明确命名的项目进行替代推荐——因此该矛盾对实践具有重要影响。
AI.method: 论文设计了一套严格的审计流程：(1) 仅使用可见对话与目录元数据进行确定性正则+目录查找的"精确歌曲请求"检测器（不依赖学习模型，确保可复现）；(2) 设立三段证据门槛——可解析的目标集、严格精度审计、匹配对照组验证；(3) 在匹配对照组（仅增加"存在精确请求"特征但仍用官方标签训练）与专家模型（额外补充请求满足目标并降低整组权重至0.1）之间对比；(4) 采用预冻结协议、引导自助法95%置信区间和预设保护边界（−0.001）评估官方指标。
AI.result: 在RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准的开发集（1,000个会话/8,000个评估轮次）中，检测器识别出82个含明确点曲指令的轮次，其中41个官方标签与请求指向不同曲目。专家模型在冲突子集上将nDCG@20从0.5231提升至0.8018（+53.3%相对增益，10,000次自助法全部为正），整个开发集的官方nDCG@20仅变动+0.0006（+0.31%，95% CI [+0.0002, +0.0012]），完全在预设保护范围内。匹配对照组证实增益并非仅来自"知道该轮含精确请求"这一特征。论文还报告了五类被拒绝的其他请求族（硬艺术家约束、拒绝/切换、相册/年份、宽泛语义等），理由分别是精度不足、保护指标下降、目标不可解析或不可验证。
AI.conclusion: 该论文揭示了合成对话基准中一个可量化但被整体指标掩盖的失败模式：在用户按名点曲时，官方标签有50%概率与请求矛盾；这种监督会让部署系统学到"忽略明确请求"的行为。论文贡献了一个可复现的审计工具包（包括ID索引注释、检测器、目标重映射脚本、训练脚本），主张将"请求满足子集"指标与官方指标并列报告，并建议将此审计扩展到其他合成CRS基准，甚至嵌入生成回路以在标签记录前过滤冲突。官方排行榜得分：nDCG@20 0.440，第12名/44队。

title: KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation.

AI.tldr: 该论文报告了KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026挑战赛，这是一项围绕"推理生成式推荐"主题的竞赛，旨在推动大语言模型与推荐系统的结合。基于OneReason预训练模型，挑战赛设计了理解物品、理解用户、理解世界四大任务，吸引了来自全球的1,206支队伍参与。论文详细介绍了竞赛设置、数据资源、评估方法、复现公平性机制，并总结了前三名队伍的创新方案。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型浪潮下，生成式推荐成为工业界与学术界的研究热点。快手团队开发的OneRec系列模型已成功部署，但前期研究发现简单引入思维链推理并不总能提升推荐性能。为解决这一挑战，探索如何让推理真正有益于推荐，并推动LLM与推荐系统的深度融合，与SIGIR 2026联合举办本次挑战赛。
AI.method: 基于OneReason预训练基座（0.8B/8B，基于Qwen-3，使用超500B tokens预训练），通过多粒度语义对齐预训练（词元级、物品级、关系级、用户级）将物品Semantic IDs与自然语言统一在单一自回归模型中。挑战赛设计四项任务：1）物品理解（双向Caption-SID转换）；2）用户理解（相关行为选择+兴趣演化链）；3）跨域推荐（多域历史预测目标域物品）；4）世界知识（选择题）。评估采用think+nothink双模式Pass@32生成策略。领先方案采用自采样推理与Target-SID-Masked RFT、多任务数据精炼、分阶段后训练（DPO）、前缀引导与分层信用分配等方法。
AI.result: 挑战赛吸引2,031名注册参与者（来自9个国家和地区），共1,206支队伍，初赛812支队伍完成33,059次有效提交，复赛50支队伍完成4,861次提交。冠军方案通过模型自采样与Target-SID-Masked RFT构建推荐推理数据；亚军通过物品描述改写+领域特定推荐监督优化多任务SFT数据；季军采用SFT+知识RL+用户理解RL+推荐DPO的分阶段后训练，结合pack级交叉熵损失。创新方案包括分层GRPO信用分配与Bridge-GRPO训练。所有资源全部开源以推动研究复现。
AI.conclusion: 该挑战赛展示了推理生成式推荐的潜力与挑战，通过开源真实数据和严格评估基准推动推荐基础模型研究。报告强调连接大语言模型与推荐系统是极具前景的方向，期待更多研究者参与。关键洞察包括：推理CoT需要专门设计才能提升推荐性能；think与nothink模式的互补性比单一模式更重要；输出格式对齐（如Bridge处理）不足以解决历史物品与新目标的候选竞争问题；分层信用分配能更有效训练层次化SID生成。

title: Certifiable Near-Optimality: A Simple Framework for Unifying Search and Refutation for (Semi)random CSPs
summary: A classical problem in average-case complexity is the study of random constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs). Random CSPs are traditionally studied in two different settings: refutation, where the instances are uniformly random and thus unsatisfiable with high probability, and search, where the instances are drawn from a planted model so that they are satisfiable. While there is no formal relationship between the refutation and search variants of random CSPs, known algorithms are strikingly similar with near-identical computational thresholds. In this work, we establish a formal relationship between the known algorithms for refutation and search by showing that in either case they achieve a stronger guarantee: they output an assignment $x$ along with a certificate $\pi$ that the fraction of constraints satisfied by $x$ is within some small $\varepsilon$ of the optimal assignment. We call this guarantee certifiable $\varepsilon$-optimality. As an application, we design new algorithms for a model of semirandom CSPs where the instance hypergraph (or scopes) is random, but the literal negation patterns are adversarially chosen and may depend on the hypergraph. For such CSPs, we give a family of algorithms that output certifiably $\varepsilon$-optimal solutions. We additionally study such semirandom CSPs in the "strong contamination model", where an adversary is allowed to corrupt an $O(\delta)$-fraction of constraints after seeing the initial CSP. For such CSPs, we give an algorithm to output a certifiably $O(\delta)$-optimal solution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可认证ε-最优性"（Certifiable ε-optimality）框架，统一了随机约束满足问题（CSP）的反驳（refutation）和搜索（search）算法。该框架输出一个赋值x及其证书π，证x满足的约束比例与最优赋值相差不超过ε。作者证明现有多种算法均满足该保证，并为超图随机但字面取反可对抗选取的半随机CSP设计了新算法，还在强污染模型下给出了certifiably O(δ)-optimal的算法。核心工具是引入"可认证扩展超图"概念及全局相关性舍入框架。
AI.motivation: 随机CSP研究长期分为反驳（实例均匀随机，通常不可满足）和搜索（planted模型，通常可满足）两个方向。虽然已知算法具有几乎相同的计算阈值，但两者之间缺乏形式化联系。本文旨在建立这种形式化联系，并推广到半随机模型。
AI.method: 1. 定义"可认证ε-最优性"概念（输出赋值+可验证证书）。2. 证明现有算法（AOW15, FPV15, RRS17, AGK21, GKM22, GHKM23, BHLM26, CdX26）均隐式满足该保证。3. 引入"可认证扩展超图"概念（具有SoS证书的谱扩展性质）。4. 利用全局相关性舍入（global correlation rounding）框架，在可认证扩展超图上设计算法。5. 证明随机超图、可分拆超图、谱扩展图均满足可认证扩展性。6. 扩展至强污染模型。
AI.result: 主要结果：1) 定理1/2：对超图随机的半随机CSP，在n^{O_k(ℓ)} 时间内输出certifiably最优解，阈值约为m_{k,ℓ}=(n/ℓ)^{k/2}·ℓ。2) 定理6.2：强污染模型下，输出certifiably O(δ)-optimal解。技术贡献包括改进Lemma 4.4中将条件集合大小从k²/ε降至k/ε。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过"可认证ε-最优性"这一更强保证，统一了随机CSP的反驳和搜索算法，揭示了两者计算阈值一致性的根源。该框架自然地推广到超图随机的半随机模型（而非仅字面取反随机），表明CSP的硬度来源于超图与字面取反的"合谋"。结果还适用于强污染模型，为鲁棒统计与平均-case复杂度的联系提供了新视角。

title: Auction-Based Algorithms for Matroid Intersection: Near-Linear Query Complexity and Constant-Pass Semi-Streaming
summary: In this paper, we develop a new auction-based framework for matroid intersection and use it to obtain improved approximation algorithms in several computational settings. Our framework is inspired by Fleiner's generalized stable matching algorithm and extends the semi-streaming auction algorithm for bipartite matching due to Assadi, Liu, and Tarjan. Using this framework, for any $\varepsilon > 0$, we present a simple $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm in the rank-oracle model whose query complexity matches that of the current fastest algorithm. Furthermore, by extending this result, we obtain the first $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for the weighted problem that requires only a near-linear number of rank-oracle queries, achieving the best known rank-oracle query complexity for the problem. We also obtain a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation semi-streaming algorithm for matroid intersection in the multi-pass streaming model, where the elements of the ground set arrive sequentially. It is the first algorithm achieving this approximation ratio using a constant number of passes and nearly linear space in the ranks of the matroids. When viewed in the standard offline setting, the same algorithm yields the first deterministic $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for matroid intersection that requires only a near-linear number of independence-oracle queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于拍卖机制的拟阵相交问题算法框架，受Fleiner广义稳定匹配算法及Assadi-Liu-Tarjan半流拍卖算法启发，在秩预言机模型、加权问题及半流模型中均获得了当前最优的(1−ε)-近似算法结果。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在解决拟阵相交问题中查询复杂度和流式模型下的算法效率问题。尽管已有多种近似算法，但在秩预言机模型中能否达到近线性查询、在加权问题中能否达到近线性秩查询、以及半流模型中能否使用常数遍次获得(1−ε)-近似等问题均未解决。
AI.method: 方法核心是基于拍卖机制的拟阵相交算法，将基础集E视为商品集，价格单调递增。算法通过两方（Alice与Bob）的交互过程维护公共独立集X和价格向量。简单算法对无权和加权版本均使用O(n log n/ε)秩查询；半流版本引入价格向量的隐式表示，仅维护X中元素的价格，通过O(1/ε²)轮迭代，在一轮流式扫描中贪心计算p*-最小基Z，使用二进制搜索技术实现O(log r)查询复杂度。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：(1) 无权问题O(n log n/ε)秩查询的确定性(1−ε)-近似算法（定理1.1）；(2) 加权问题O(n log n/ε)秩查询的确定性(1−ε)-近似算法（定理1.2，首个加权近线性秩查询算法）；(3) 半流模型下O(1/ε²)遍次、O(r)空间、O(n log r/ε²)独立性查询的确定性(1−ε)-近似算法（定理1.3，首个常数遍次半流算法）；(4) 作为离线算法，定理1.3是首个达到近线性独立性查询复杂度的确定性(1−ε)-近似算法；应用于二部图匹配时改进至O(r)空间。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功开发了拍卖式拟阵相交算法框架，在多个计算环境下改进了(1−ε)-近似算法的查询复杂度和流式性能，揭示了拍卖算法、广义稳定匹配与拟阵优化之间的深刻联系。未来研究方向包括进一步改进遍次数、空间复杂度和查询复杂度，以及将半流算法更直接地推广到加权设置。

title: Faster network motif discovery by counting isomorphic subtrees
summary: We develop a new algorithm for counting the number of subgraphs of a network isomorphic to a given query graph (#SubgraphIsomorphism), motivated by network motif search. High-degree vertices (hubs), common in real-world networks, contribute to a combinatorial explosion in the number of subgraphs, making existing motif search algorithms intractable for motif sizes greater than $\approx 8$ on a wide variety of networks of interest. Our procedure leverages the $k$-core decomposition and a novel subtree-counting technique to quickly scan the periphery of a network. These two innovations allow our algorithm to significantly speed up its predecessors in practice, especially as most real-world networks have a relatively large periphery. We prove that #RootedSubtreeIsomorphism, a key subroutine in our algorithm, is #P-complete via a reduction from counting bipartite matchings. We provide analytic upper bounds on our algorithm's execution time, and evaluate its performance on 11 real-world networks of varying topologies.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于k-core分解与子树计数技术的#SubgraphIsomorphism算法，通过快速扫描网络外围（1-shell）显著加速网络模体（motif）搜索，尤其在含有大量枢纽顶点（hubs）的现实网络和树形模体上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有模体搜索算法在规模大于8的模体上对许多含枢纽顶点的真实网络表现不可处理，主要原因在于：（1）算法枚举/映射子图实例而非计数；（2）未考虑不同子图拓扑对运行时间的差异；（3）枢纽顶点引发的组合爆炸。需要一种能利用网络核心-外围结构的高效计数方法。
AI.method: 1. 使用k-core分解将网络和查询图分为外围（1-shell，全为树）和核心（2-core）。2. 设计CountRootedSubtrees算法：利用叶子子树的二项式系数简化（Lemma 2）、等价类多重性校正、以及Ryser公式计算矩阵permanent，通过递归在加权二部图上对子树的根节点孩子进行匹配，计数有根子树同构数量。3. 设计CountSubgraphs主算法：集成Grochow-Kellis对称性破缺算法，遍历1-shell用子树计数处理外围和边界实例（引入coreness早期中止），再在2-core上运行传统模体搜索。4. 证明#RootedSubtreeIsomorphism是#P完全的（从#PerfectMatchings归约）。5. 给出算法运行时间的解析上界。
AI.result: 在communityFitNet语料库中8个约150顶点的无向网络和3个约1000顶点的较大网络上实验。结果显示：（1）子树计数贡献的加速远大于coreness早期中止；（2）高最大外围枢纽度（hub degree）是性能提升的最强预测指标；（3）高coreness查询带来的加速可忽略；（4）例如在C. elegans interactome网络上计数所有size-8子图中最昂贵的子图仅需214秒，而Grochow-Kellis算法对单个size-5子图需要2459秒。整体而言，对于树状查询和大外围网络的加速最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 该算法利用了树与核心-外围结构来加速子图同构计数，可作为子程序集成到任何主流的motif-centric算法中。研究表明，网络和查询拓扑对模体搜索运行时间有重大影响。未来工作方向包括：将技术推广到k≥2的shell（如2-shell的"ear decomposition"，但需注意2-edge-connected图同构是GI完全的）；将该子树计数策略与当前最优motif-centric算法结合；进一步分析运行时间分布与查询图拓扑的关系以设计更实例感知的算法。

title: A Robustified Greedy Algorithm for Online Transportation with Improved Competitive Guarantees
summary: We study the \emph{online transportation problem}, in which $n$ requests arriving sequentially in a metric space must be irrevocably assigned to $k$ capacitated facilities. Beyond classical logistics applications, this problem models resource-allocation tasks arising in machine learning, including online facility assignments, recommender systems, and mixture-of-experts routing. We introduce \emph{Robustified Greedy} (RG), a deterministic generalization of the Robust Matching algorithm that achieves a competitive ratio of $6.6604k-2.89$, improving upon the state-of-the-art bounds of $8k-7$ (Arndt et al., SOSA 2026) and $8k-5$ (Harada and Itoh, ICALP 2025). RG also retains the metric-sensitive guarantee established for Robust Matching (RM) (Nayyar and Raghvendra, FOCS 2017), achieving a competitive ratio of $O(k^{1-1/d}\log^2 n)$ in $d$-dimensional Euclidean spaces for fixed $d>1$. No comparable metric-sensitive guarantee is known for the transportation algorithms of Arndt et al.\ or Harada and Itoh. Beyond these competitive guarantees, RG provides a simple explanation for its decisions. It favors the natural nearest-neighbor assignment and, for suitable parameters, departs from this choice only when it identifies a reassignment that reduces the cost of its maintained auxiliary matching, thereby correcting accumulated assignment costs. We also prove that nearest-neighbor assignments account for a guaranteed fraction of RG's total cost, approaching one-half for appropriate parameters, even under adversarial arrivals. Experiments on real-world datasets corroborate the theory: RG achieves lower cost-to-\textsc{Opt} ratios than the competing algorithms while retaining a substantial nearest-neighbor component in its cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Robustified Greedy (RG)算法，解决度量空间中的在线运输问题（n个请求顺序到达，不可撤销地分配给k个有容量限制的设施），将竞争比改进至6.6604k−2.89，优于此前最佳的8k−7和8k−5。RG是Robust Matching算法的参数化推广，通过引入折扣参数α< t来偏向最近邻分配，同时保持度量敏感的竞争比保证O(k^{1−1/d} log²n)，并在d维欧氏空间中成立。算法可解释性强：优先选择最近邻分配，仅当能降低辅助匹配代价时才偏离。实验在NYC出租车和MovieLens数据集上验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 在线运输问题是机器学习中资源分配（推荐系统、混合专家路由等）和物流中的基本问题。Kalyanasundaram和Pruhs早在1998年就猜想存在(2k−1)竞争的确定性算法，但该猜想已开放二十余年。现有最佳结果为8k−7（Arndt等人）和8k−5（Harada和Itoh）。另一方面，Greedy算法虽然实证表现优异但最坏情况竞争比高达2^n−1，而现有理论算法缺乏可解释性——无法保证任何固定正比例的分配来自最近邻决策。本文旨在设计一个同时具备强最坏情况保证和最近邻偏好的算法。
AI.method: 提出Robustified Greedy (RG)算法，维护在线匹配M和离线辅助匹配M*。对每个新请求，通过(t,α)-净成本函数选择增广路径：直接增广路径的净成本为α·d(r,s)（α< t时折扣），非直接路径的净成本为t·w(P\M*)−w(P∩M*)。α< t时优先选择最近邻（直接路径），仅当非直接路径的净成本更低时才偏离。算法通过原始-对偶实现，每次请求处理时间O(nk log n)。分析采用"服务器饱和轮次"（saturation epochs）框架，利用正成本贪心边在服务器饱和前保持不变的持久结构进行成本核算，并结合几何论证（加权Vitali选取、二进制净成本分组）得到度量敏感保证。
AI.result: 1. 主要竞争比（定理1）：RG的竞争比上界为6.6604k−2.89（取t=2+√5, α=√t时最优），改进了此前最佳的8k−7。先给出较简单分析得到(20/3)k−3，再通过参数优化得到更紧界。2. 度量敏感保证（定理2）：固定d>1的欧氏空间中，RG的竞争比为O(k^{1−1/d} log²n)。3. 贪心分配比例（定理3）：当t≥3+2√2且1≤α≤√t时，RG是O(k)竞争的，且其总成本中至少(1/2−(α+1)/(2(t−α)))比例来自贪心（最近邻）分配；当α=o(t)时该比例趋近1/2。4. RM算法新界（定理15）：取t=1+√2时，RM的竞争比为(6+4√2)k< 11.66k。5. 实验验证：在NYC出租车数据集上，RG在自然时间戳顺序下与Greedy相差不超过0.5%，在方向性顺序下比Greedy降低高达15.02%的成本；在MovieLens数据集上一致优于Greedy（0.41%–0.51%）和Arndt等人算法。RG在NYC上97.37%–98.05%的决策为最近邻分配，占总成本的84%–88%。
AI.conclusion: RG算法通过参数化折扣机制成功地统一了Greedy的可解释性和RM的最坏情况鲁棒性。其6.6604k−2.89的竞争比显著缩小了与(2k−1)下界之间的差距。算法的核心洞察在于：正成本贪心边的持久结构使得可通过饱和轮次进行精确成本核算。非贪心决策获得了清晰的解释——仅当能减少累积辅助匹配代价时才发生。同时，本文给出了RM的首个显式O(k)竞争比分析。未来的工作方向包括：进一步缩小与(2k−1)下界的差距，以及改善度量敏感保证中的对数因子。

title: Breaking the $2^n$ barrier for directed hamiltonicity
summary: We give a randomized algorithm for Directed Hamiltonian Cycle on $n$-vertex directed graphs that runs in time $O^*((375/196)^n)=O^*(1.9133^n)$. For general directed graphs, this is the first improvement in the exponential base over the classical $O^*(2^n)$-time algorithms of Bellman and Held--Karp (1962). To obtain this improvement, we first give a $(2-2^{-d})^n \, \text{poly}(n,W)$-time algorithm for counting Hamiltonian paths modulo two at each total weight when at most $d$ distinct weights from $\{1,\ldots,W\}$ enter each vertex. The algorithm combines the Laplacian determinant method of Björklund, Kaski, and Koutis (ICALP 2017) with a random linearization also used by Arvind and Guruswami (IPEC 2021). To apply the isolation lemma while keeping $d$ small, we randomly delete and duplicate arcs, partitioning the incoming copies at each vertex into $d$ groups, where $d\ge2$. We show that, if the input graph has a Hamiltonian path from $s$ to $t$, then with probability at least $\left(1-\frac{1}{1+(2^d-1)^2}\right)^{n-1}$ one can select one group at each vertex other than $s$ so that the selected arcs contain an odd number of such paths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个针对一般有向图 Directed Hamiltonian Cycle 问题的亚 $2^n$ 随机算法，运行时间为 $O^*(1.9133^n)$，打破了自 1962 年 Bellman 和 Held–Karp 以来的 $2^n$ 障碍。核心技术是结合 Björklund–Kaski–Koutis 的 Laplacian 行列式求和方法与随机线性化技术，并通过随机删除和复制弧、分组入弧来控制权重多样性，从而兼顾隔离引理与高效奇偶计数。
AI.motivation: 自 1962 年 Bellman 和 Held–Karp 提出 $O^*(2^n)$ 算法以来，一般有向图的 Hamiltonian Cycle 问题在指数基底上是否有改进一直悬而未决。无向图方面 Björklund 已取得 $O^*(1.657^n)$ 的突破，而有向图情形长期未获进展。本文旨在填补这一长期空白。
AI.method: 算法框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 通过随机删除弧（概率 $\delta=1/50$）并将每个保留弧的多个副本随机分配到 $d=3$ 个入弧组中，使每个顶点的入弧至多分为 $d$ 组，从而限制权重多样性；(2) 对组赋予独立随机权重并结合隔离引理，确保以 $\Omega((49/50)^n)$ 概率存在唯一最小权重且奇数条 Hamiltonian 路径的组选择；(3) 利用 Björklund–Kaski–Koutis 的 Laplacian 行列式和公式将路径计数的奇偶性表达为 $O(2^n)$ 个行列式之和，并通过随机线性化技术（Arvind–Guruswami）将需要计算的子集族期望大小降至 $O((15/8)^n)$，从而在 $O^*((2-2^{-d})^n)$ 时间内计算每个总权重下的奇偶性。三者组合得到总运行时间 $O^*((50/49)^n \cdot (15/8)^n) = O^*(1.9133^n)$。证明 Proposition 4 的核心是构建关于组选择的多项式 $g(z)$，利用单项式序和二部图的圈论证证明使得 $g(z)=0$ 的组选择数量受限于 $2^{p-1}$。
AI.result: 主要结果为定理 1：$n$ 顶点有向图的 Directed Hamiltonian Cycle 问题存在运行时间为 $O^*(1.9133^n)$ 的双向随机算法。这是自 1962 年以来一般有向图 Hamiltonicity 问题的首个亚 $2^n$ 算法。此外，证明了一个更一般的加权奇偶计数引理（Proposition 3）：当每个顶点入弧至多有 $d$ 种不同权重时，可在 $(2-2^{-d})^n \cdot \text{poly}(n,W)$ 时间内计算每个总权重下 Hamiltonian 路径数量的奇偶性。组选择产生奇数路径数的概率下界为 $(1-1/(1+(2^d-1)^2))^{n-1}$。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了有向 Hamiltonicity 长达 60 年的开放问题，首次将一般有向图的指数运行时间基底从 $2$ 降至约 $1.9133$。方法上统一了 Laplacian 行列式框架与随机线性化技术，并通过精巧的弧分组与隔离引理结合控制了权重多样性参数。值得注意的是，作者声明 ChatGPT 参与了定理 1 证明的生成与稿件撰写，作者对最终内容负责，这一 AI 辅助证明的实践在理论计算机科学顶会论文中较为罕见。开放问题包括：能否进一步改进基底、扩展至 Strassen 秩猜想下的结果、以及对精确计数的加速。

title: Multidimensional Resource Scheduling with Small Demands
summary: We study multidimensional resource scheduling. Each job $i$ has a $d$-dimensional resource-demand vector $v_i$ and a processing time $s_i$. The scheduler assigns a start time to each job, subject to the constraint that, at every time, the total demand of the jobs being processed does not exceed $1$ in any resource dimension. The objective is to minimize the makespan. We focus on the regime in which every individual resource demand is small. We ask whether the favorable \emph{small-vector phenomenon} known for multidimensional vector packing, which corresponds to the special case of unit processing times, extends to jobs with heterogeneous processing times. The key difficulty is that arbitrary processing times create temporal interactions across multiple duration scales: a long job may overlap many shorter jobs, while feasibility must be maintained throughout every job's execution interval. We prove that the small-vector phenomenon persists in this temporal setting. For any $0<\epsilon<1/4$, after normalizing the maximum processing time to $1$, if every coordinate of every demand vector is at most $O(\epsilon^2/\log(d/\epsilon))$, we give a randomized offline algorithm that produces a schedule with expected makespan at most $ (1+6\epsilon)\mathrm{OPT}+3$. Thus, sufficiently small resource demands admit asymptotically near-optimal schedules in arbitrary dimension, despite heterogeneous processing times. We also obtain constant competitive ratios in the online setting. Let $T$ denote the ratio between the maximum and minimum processing times. If every coordinate is at most $O(1/(\log d\log T))$, we give a randomized $O(1)$-competitive algorithm, with a competitive ratio independent of both $d$ and $T$. We further derandomize our approach, obtaining a deterministic $O(1)$-competitive algorithm under a comparable smallness assumption.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多维资源调度问题（也称多维条带装箱）：每个作业具有d维资源需求向量和处理时间，目标是最小化makespan。在"小向量"（每个坐标值足够小）的前提下，本文证明了unit processing time情况下已知的"小向量现象"可以扩展到异构处理时间场景。离线算法达到(1+6ε)OPT+3的近似比，在线随机算法达到96-competitive，确定性在线算法达到160-competitive，竞争比均与维度d和处理时间比T无关。核心技术是"随机放置+廉价修复"框架：随机分配起始时间、利用几何舍入减少代表时间点、溢出池由shelf算法吸收，并通过Chernoff界和势函数法分析。
AI.motivation: 现代计算系统中，作业并发执行时同时占用多种资源（CPU、内存、带宽、网络等），单标量大小无法准确刻画资源争用。多维资源调度中，已知当处理时间相同时，小向量条件下可实现维度无关的近似比；但异构处理时间引入了跨多个时间尺度的复杂交互（长作业可能与大量短作业重叠），使得小向量现象能否扩展到时间维度成为未解的核心问题。
AI.method:
核心方法为"随机放置+廉价修复"框架：
1) **几何舍入处理时间**：将处理时间向上舍入到2^ε的幂次，将连续时间尺度离散化为有限的处理时间层级；
2) **随机分配起始时间**：在时间范围[0, V/(1-ε))内均匀随机选择各作业起始时间（对齐到其舍入处理时间的整数倍）；
3) **代表时间点分析**：利用引理2.2证明任意作业的失败可由其执行区间内至多2/ε个代表时间点见证，从而避免对连续时间的union bound；
4) **Chernoff界+Union Bound**：对d个资源维度和O(1/ε)个代表时间点联合应用，证明每个作业进入溢出池的概率≤2ε/d³；
5) **Shelf算法修复溢出**：将溢出作业用简单的shelf算法调度，因溢出体积期望值较小（缩放O(ε/d²)倍），总开销为O(ε)OPT；
6) **在线处理**：用倍增法（doubling）猜测V，避免需要预先知道总量；
7) **去随机化**：构造1/2-slack的分数调度方案，定义指数势函数Φ，证明了在某个支持集中的起始时间下势能不增，从而转化为确定性选择。
AI.result:
**离线算法（定理2.1）**：当max_{i,k} v_{i,k} ≤ ε²/(24log(d/ε))时，存在时间复杂度O(dn log n)的随机离线算法，期望makespan ≤ (1+6ε)OPT+3。
**在线随机算法（定理3.3）**：当max_{i,k} v_{i,k} ≤ 1/(100 log d log T)时，存在随机在线算法，期望makespan ≤ 96·OPT，竞争比与d和T无关。
**确定性在线算法（定理4.5）**：在相同小性条件下（常数为4000），存在确定性在线算法，makespan ≤ 160·OPT。
所有结果均表明在"小向量"条件下，多维调度可获得维度无关的近优解。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将多维向量装箱中已知的"小向量现象"从静态设置推广到时间维度上的资源调度，证明了在每个资源维度的需求量足够小（与log d和log T成反比）时，无论维度d和处理时间异构性如何，都能获得（近）最优调度。核心贡献包括：（1）一个简洁优雅的"随机放置+廉价修复"框架，利用几何舍入和Chernoff界处理多尺度时间交互；（2）从随机到确定性的去随机化技术，通过分数调度和指数势函数实现常数竞争比。该结果在理论层面回答了小向量条件下时间维度的可调度性问题，对实际多资源系统的调度设计具有指导意义。

title: A Quantum Scaling Algorithm for Maximum-Weight Perfect Matching in General Graphs
summary: Quantum speed-ups have been obtained for many fundamental graph problems, including most variants of matching. A notable exception, however, is the maximum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) problem in general graphs with integer edge weights, which is arguably the most challenging variant of matching. We present a quantum algorithm for MWPM in general graphs that runs in \( \widetilde{O}(n m^{2/3}\log W) \) time, where $W$ is an upper bound on the magnitude of the edge weights. This is an improvement over the best known classical combinatorial bound of \( \widetilde{O}(m\sqrt n \log W) \) in the dense regime, where $m\ge n^{3/2}$. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first quantum algorithm to obtain an asymptotic improvement over the best classical combinatorial algorithm for the MWPM problem in general graphs. The running time of our method accounts for QRAM initialization and access overheads up to polylogarithmic factors, as well as all classical updates to the data structures. At a high level, our algorithm is based on a classical framework due to Duan, Pettie, and Su, but our algorithm requires replacing certain classical tasks with quantum methods, alternative analysis of classical procedures, and the use of alternative data structures that can be implemented effectively in the QRAM model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于一般图上最大权重完美匹配（MWPM）的量子算法，运行时间为 Õ(nm^{2/3} log W)，在稠密区域 m≥n^{3/2} 时优于目前最优的经典组合算法 Õ(m√n log W)，是首个针对该问题的量子渐近改进。
AI.motivation: MWPM是一般图匹配问题中最具挑战性的变体，已广泛应用于资源分配、调度和度量TSP近似等场景。现有量子算法已在大多数匹配问题变体上获得加速，但带整数边权的一般图MWPM仍是空白。该问题的难度源于奇数环（blossom）的处理以及主-对偶框架中增广路径搜索的复杂性。此前已知最优经典组合算法为Duan-Pettie-Su提出的"Liquidationist"算法，时间复杂度为 Õ(m√n log W)。
AI.method: 算法基于QRAM模型，对经典Liquidationist框架进行量子化改编：保留权重缩放、小blossom清算、Perfection和Finalization等经典流程，仅将Free Vertex Reduction中的SearchOne子程序替换为量子版本QSearchOne。具体方法包括：1) 通过Grover搜索在原图（而非显式构建的收缩图）上执行有序深度优先搜索，使用RootB数组判断边是否跨越根blossom；2) 用基于并查-大小union-by-size的标签更新代替经典union-find数据结构以适配Grover搜索；3) 利用Grover/BBHT定理在每次Free Vertex Reduction迭代中将SearchOne从 Õ(m) 加速到 Õ(√(mn))；5) 引入临时blossom结构Ω'和OutTime时间戳等机制保证增广路径搜索的正确性。
AI.result: 主要结果：QSearchOne运行时间为 Õ(√(mn))，完整算法QLiquidationist总运行时间为 Õ(nm^{2/3} log W)。该结果在稠密区域 m≥n^{3/2} 时严格优于经典最优界 Õ(m√n log W)，加速比为 (m/n^{3/2})^{1/3}。在 m≥n^{3/2} 且 m≤n² 的范围内（简单图限制）渐近最优。算法正确性基于量子搜索的失败概率可通过O(log n)次重复放大到任意逆多项式小，通过union bound保证整体高概率成功。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次为带整数边权的一般图MWPM提供了优于经典组合算法的量子加速，开辟了量子匹配算法在权重缩放主-对偶框架下的研究。技术核心在于将Liquidationist框架中的Free Vertex Reduction过程通过Grover搜索实现量子化，同时重新分析Small Blossom Liquidation以平衡总体运行时间。开放问题包括：1) 设计PQSearch的量子类比以进一步加速Small Blossom Liquidation和Finalization，将结果扩展到非稠密区域；2) 探索量子局部搜索在近似加权匹配算法中能否改善对m或ε的依赖。

title: Consensus for Compressed Static Functions
summary: The Consensus technique marked a breakthrough in the construction of minimal perfect hash functions (MPHFs), reaching a linear tradeoff between construction time and space overhead relative to the optimum. Consensus provides a clever scheme to search for and encode seeds of tasks in random data structures. We apply Consensus to the related field of compressed static functions (CSFs). These data structures store a function $f: S \to \Sigma$ such that querying a key $x \in S$ returns $f(x)$ and querying $x \not \in S$ returns an arbitrary value. CSFs do not need to store the keys $S$ and only need space close to the zeroth-order empirical entropy of the multiset of values. Often, some values are much more common than others. In these cases, CSFs can use less space than their non-compressed counterparts. CSFs are a useful building block, for example in database design and bioinformatics. We introduce Consensus-CSF, which can reach arbitrarily close to the empirical entropy $n H_0$, with a construction time of $n \exp(\tilde{\cal{O}} (\sqrt{1 / \delta}))$ for space usage of $n H_0 (1 + \delta)$ when assuming some parameters of the value distribution to be constants. This tradeoff beats previously implemented approaches that can only reach some fixed threshold above the entropy lower bound. We enable Consensus in the setting of CSFs, which is less structured than MPHFs, with the introduction of task insertions. Our approach randomly distributes the keys into one-bit Consensus tasks and then strategically inserts additional tasks in places where the construction would get stuck otherwise. We provide an implemented version of our algorithm which reaches the same order of magnitude in space overhead as competitors but is not competitive in practice. Beyond these results, we present a new way to think and reason about Consensus, which may also be applied to other problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Consensus-CSF算法，将原本用于最小完美哈希函数（MPHF）的Consensus技术扩展到压缩静态函数（CSF）领域。Consensus-CSF可以构建时间-空间权衡接近经验熵下界的压缩静态函数，并引入了"任务插入"（task insertions）机制以应对CSF无结构特性的挑战，同时提出了理解Consensus的新视角。
AI.motivation: 压缩静态函数（CSF）作为数据库和生物信息学等领域的重要构件，具有广泛的应用价值。此前基于Consensus技术的研究主要针对MPHF，而CSF领域需要存储键的映射但无需保存键本身，且可以利用值分布的不均衡性实现比无压缩方案更小的空间占用。然而，现有CSF实现方法只能达到经验熵下界之上的某个固定阈值，无法在空间上任意接近熵下界。Consensus技术在MPHF上的成功启发作者将其思想迁移到CSF领域，以获得更优的时空权衡。
AI.method: 作者将Consensus技术从MPHF扩展到CSF，主要创新在于引入了"任务插入"（task insertions）机制。方法将键随机分配到一位Consensus任务中，并在构造过程可能停滞的位置策略性地插入额外任务，以应对CSF缺乏MPHF那种结构化特性所带来的挑战。从理论上讲，对于值分布假设某些参数为常数的情况下，可以达到构建时间为n exp(ÕO(√(1/δ)))，空间使用为nH₀(1+δ) 的权衡曲线。作者还提出了一种新的理解和推理Consensus的方式，可能适用于其他问题。
AI.result: Consensus-CSF理论上可以达到经验熵nH₀下界上方任意接近的δ倍开销，在时间-空间权衡曲线上优于仅能达到固定阈值的前期实现方法。作者提供了该算法的实现版本，其空间开销与其他竞争方案处于同一数量级，但在实际运行时间上尚不具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功地将Consensus技术从MPHF扩展到了CSF领域，提出了Consensus-CSF方案，理论上实现了更优的时间-空间权衡（可任意接近熵下界）。"任务插入"机制的引入是关键技术贡献。此外，本文还提出了理解Consensus的新视角，具有潜在的广泛应用价值。然而，实际实现版本在效率上尚不能与现有竞争方案相媲美，这是未来需要改进的方向。

title: $(α, β)$ Spanners and Hybrid Spanners with Nearly Tight Bounds
comment: A preliminary version appeared in SODA 2026
summary: For an $n$-vertex undirected, unweighted graph $G=(V,E)$ and a positive integer $k$, we present new spanner constructions with $O_k(n^{1+1/k})$ edges that achieve nearly optimal guarantees for all distances $d\le k$. Specifically, we construct a spanner $H\subseteq G$ with $O(n^{1+1/k}+(k+d\log d)n)$ edges, ensuring that any pair at original distance at most $d$ satisfies $\mathrm{dist}_H(u,v)\le 2k+O(d\log d)$. Equivalently, the multiplicative stretch for pairs at distance $d$ is $2k/d+O(\log d)$. In particular, setting $d=k/\log k$ yields an $(O(\log k),O(k))$-spanner with $O(n^{1+1/k}+kn)$ edges. For comparison, Ben-Levy and Parter (SODA'20) obtained, for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$ and sufficiently large $k$, an $(O(k^\varepsilon),O_\varepsilon(k))$-spanner with $O_{\varepsilon,k}(n^{1+1/k})$ edges. Our result improves the multiplicative stretch from $O(k^\varepsilon)$ to $O(\log k)$ while keeping the additive term linear in $k$, bringing us closer to the goal of $(O(1),O(k))$-spanners. Furthermore, Ben-Levy and Parter obtained multiplicative stretch $O_\varepsilon(k/d)$ for distances $d\le k^{1-\varepsilon}$, for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$, and an explicit bound of $7k/d$ for $d\le\sqrt{k}/2$. We achieve $2k/d+O(\log d)$, which is $(2+o(1))k/d$ whenever $d=o(k/\log k)$. Our second result is an improved construction of $k$-hybrid spanners, which guarantee stretch $2k-1$ for adjacent pairs and $k$ for non-adjacent pairs. Parter's original construction uses $O(k^2 n^{1+1/k})$ edges; we achieve the same guarantees with $O(n^{1+1/k}+kn)$ edges, removing the $k^2$ factor from the $n^{1+1/k}$ term. For every fixed $k$, our edge bound is optimal up to a constant factor under Erdős' girth conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了无向无权图中 (α, β) 混合支撑器和 k-混合支撑器的构造。对于任意距离 d ≤ k 的顶点对，构造了边数为 O(n^{1+1/k} + (k+d log d)n)、保证 stretch 为 2k+O(d log d) 的支撑器，从而得到 (O(log k), O(k))-支撑器（边数 O(n^{1+1/k}+kn)），改进了 Ben-Levy 和 Parter (SODA'20) 的 O(k^ε) 乘性 stretch。此外，将 Parter 的混合支撑器边数从 O(k² n^{1+1/k}) 改进为 O(n^{1+1/k}+kn)，在 Erdős 圈猜想意义下对每个固定 k 均为最优。算法基于两阶段随机化方法，第一阶段进行多轮中心采样和剪枝以处理短路径，第二阶段利用预算机制在稀疏诱导子图上构造经典乘性支撑器，运行时间为 O(m√n)。
AI.motivation: 经典的 (2k-1)-乘性支撑器在 Erdős 圈猜想意义下边数最优（O(n^{1+1/k})），但其 stretch 对所有距离均按最坏情况处理（仅相邻对受限）。对于较短距离 d < k 的顶点对，能否用接近最优的边数换取更好的 stretch？现有最好结果（Ben-Levy & Parter, SODA'20) 仅能得到 O(k^ε) 的乘性 stretch，距理想的 (O(1), O(k))-支撑器仍有差距。本文旨在拉近这一差距，并为混合支撑器改善边数紧度。
AI.method: 两阶段随机化构造。第一阶段（SpannerPartOne）：迭代 log d 轮，每轮按概率 n^{-1/2^{i+1}} 独立采样中心集合 C_i，将彼此距离 ≤ r_i 的中心对连最短路（BFS 森林连顶点到中心），并剪除离中心 ≤ r_{i+1} = r_i/2 - d/2^i 的顶点。半径递推公式保证对每条经过被剪点的长度 ≤ d/2^i 的路径，P 可经中心点绕路获得 4r_{i+1}+3|P| 的替代路径。第二阶段（SpannerPartTwo）：对剩余子图 G[V_{log d}]，利用其 (R,k)-稀疏性（每个顶点的期望 R-球大小 ≤ n^{R/k}），按最小"预算"反复选取中心并抽取 BFS 子树，得到 (2R-1)-乘性支撑器 O(n^{1+1/k}) 边。混合支撑器（k-hybrid）：在 Baswana-Sen 框架基础上截断至 ⌈k/2⌉ 层，附加截断覆盖规则 R2* 和跨层簇间连边规则 R3、R4。预处理阶段通过 δ-叉树替换降低最大度以实现 O(m√n) 运行时间。
AI.result: 主要结果：1) Theorem 1.1：对任意 d ≤ k，构造支撑器边数 O(n^{1+1/k}+(k+d log d)n)，任意距离 ≤ d 的顶点对的 stretch ≤ 2k+O(d log d)，运行时间 O(m√n)。特例 d = k/log k 给出 (O(log k), O(k))-支撑器，边数 O(n^{1+1/k}+kn)；当 d = o(k/log k) 时乘性 stretch 达到 (2+o(1))k/d，渐近匹配最优 2k/d 下界。Corollary 1.3 综合本文与 Ben-Levy-Parter 结果，给出对所有 d 的分段 stretch 上界。3) Theorem 1.4：k-混合支撑器边数 O(n^{1+1/k}+kn)，相邻对 stretch 2k-1、非相邻对 stretch k，每个固定 k 在 Erdős 圈猜想意义下最优。改进 Parter 原 O(k² n^{1+1/k}) 边，去掉了 k² 因子。
AI.conclusion: 本文在 (α, β)-支撑器和混合支撑器两方面均取得了实质性进展：对所有距离 d ≤ k 几乎达到最优 stretch 函数 2k+O(d)，乘性 stretch 2k/d+O(log d) 在 d = o(k/log k) 时渐近匹配 Erdős 圈猜想的下界 2k/d。改进 Ben-Levy-Parter 的 O(k^ε) 乘性 stretch 至 O(log k)，朝 (O(1), O(k))-支撑器的"圣杯"目标迈进一步。混合支撑器方面完全去掉了 k² 因子使边数对每个固定 k 达到条件最优。技术核心是两阶段随机化方法（多轮中心采样+基于预算的稀疏化），并通过 δ-叉树预处理实现近线性运行时间。遗留开放问题：是否能在 O(n^{1+1/k}) 边数下达到 2k+O(d) 的 stretch，即最优 (O(1), O(k))-支撑器。

title: Testing Induced-Subgraph Freeness in Outerplanar Graphs under the Random-Neighbor Oracle
summary: We prove that, for every fixed nonempty graph $H$, induced-$H$-freeness is testable with $\varepsilon^{-O_H(1)}$ queries on outerplanar graphs with no maximum-degree bound in the $\textit{random-neighbor model}$, where each query at a vertex returns a uniformly random neighbor. Thus, the query complexity is polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$ and independent of the number $n$ of vertices. Previously, the best bound known for this problem was the $\operatorname{poly}(\log n)$-query guarantee that follows from the general outerplanar-graph tester of Babu, Khoury, and Newman (2016) in the stronger $\textit{adjacency-list model}$, which provides exact degree queries and indexed access to neighbors. Our tester has $\textit{two-sided error}$, which is necessary in general: induced-$P_3$-freeness has no one-sided constant-query tester in the random-neighbor model, even on outerplanar graphs of maximum degree two.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了在外平面图(outerplanar graphs)中,对任意固定的非空禁止图H,诱导H-无关性(induced-H-freeness)可在随机邻居模型(random-neighbor model)下以ε^{-O_H(1)}次查询进行测试,查询复杂度关于1/ε是多项式且与顶点数量n无关。这是相比之前Babu、Khoury和Newman在邻接表模型下得到的poly(log n)查询保证的显著改进。同时论文给出了在邻接表模型下的单边错误测试器,并证明了随机邻居模型下对P3的单边测试在常数查询下不可能。
AI.motivation: 在稀疏图测试中,无最大度限制下的诱导子图无关性测试面临核心挑战:随机邻居查询无法直接验证非边(nonedges)。此前,外平面图上仅有依赖poly(log n)查询的通用测试器,且需要更强的邻接表模型。本文旨在证明,即使在这种受限的随机邻居模型下,测试复杂度也能独立于n。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件。首先是修改后的外平面图分解:删除少量边后使每个连通分量至多包含一个高度数顶点,并保持分量内的诱导结构。其次是连通禁止图的寻找程序:通过有界探索低度顶点和在高度数根周围采样分支来寻找诱导副本。最后对非连通禁止图,引入了结构二分性引理(Lemma 16):要么每个分量在移除有界副本族后仍远离无关性,要么存在唯一例外分量且有"分离区域"。此外,通过阈值列表查询模拟实现从邻接表模型到随机邻居模型的转换。
AI.result: 主要结果包括:1)在随机邻居模型下,外平面图上诱导H-无关性测试需要ε^{-O_H(1)}次查询(双边错误);2)在邻接表模型下可实现单边错误测试;3)P3-无关性在最大度为2的外平面图上也不存在常数查询的单边随机邻居测试器,证明双边错误的必要性。查询复杂度对固定H是关于1/ε的多项式,与n无关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作解决了外平面图上无度限制的诱导子图无关性测试复杂性这一基本开放问题,证明了虽然随机邻居访问无法直接验证非边,但通过分解、兼容性论证和结构二分性,仍可实现与n无关的测试。论文的核心新结构工具是非连通禁止图的二分性引理,这是从寻找连通副本到测试任意固定诱导模式的关键桥梁。对平面图的扩展需要不同的方法来处理含多个高度数顶点的分量。

title: Connected Dominating Set on Semi-Ladder-Free Graphs
comment: This is an archived version of the paper accepted at ISAAC 2026
summary: We study \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} on graphs whose closed-neighborhood set systems are $d$-semi-ladder-free. This structural condition strictly generalizes the biclique-free setting and provides a natural regime for connectivity-constrained domination. We obtain both a fixed-parameter algorithm and an approximate kernelization framework for the problem on this class. Our algorithmic result is based on a new compact representation theorem for inclusion-wise minimal set covers in $d$-semi-ladder-free set systems. Although the number of minimal set covers of size at most $k$ may be as large as $n^{\Omega(k)}$, we show that all such set covers can nevertheless be encoded by a family of at most $k^{kd+1}$ tuples, and that this family can be enumerated in time $\Oh(k^{kd+2}\cdot nm)$. Combining this representation with a \textsc{Group Steiner Tree} subroutine, we obtain an algorithm for \textsc{Connected Set Cover}, which in turn yields an algorithm for \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} running in time $k^{kd+2}\cdot 2^k \cdot n^{\Oh(1)}$ and polynomial space. For the preprocessing result, we introduce grouped domination cores and dominator cores, and prove polynomial upper bounds on their sizes in $d$-semi-ladder-free graphs. Using these structures, we obtain, for every fixed $d$ and $\varepsilon>0$, a polynomial-time $(1+\varepsilon)$-lossy compression for \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} to an equivalent reduced instance of size $k^{\Oh(d^2/\varepsilon)}$. The reduced instance is a \textsc{Connected Dominating Set} instance on a $(d+2)$-semi-ladder-free graph.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 d-半梯子自由图（d-semi-ladder-free graphs）上的连通支配集问题（Connected Dominating Set），获得两个主要结果：一是基于最小集合覆盖的紧致表示定理，给出运行时间为 k^{kd+2}·2^k·n^{O(1)} 的 FPT 算法（多项式空间）；二是对任意 ε>0，给出大小为 k^{O(d²/ε)} 的 (1+ε)-有损压缩，将实例归约到 (d+2)-半梯子自由图上。这些结果严格推广了此前关于二部图自由图（biclique-free）的工作。
AI.motivation: 连通支配集（Conn-DS）在参数化复杂度中是 W[2]-难问题，且在稀疏图类上也不存在多项式核，因此精确核化不现实。已有的近似核化工作局限于二部图自由（biclique-free）等更窄的图类。本文旨在探索更一般的 d-半梯子自由图结构，结合紧致表示与有损核化技术，研究连通性约束下的支配问题的算法可能性。
AI.method: 核心方法是建立 d-半梯子自由集系统上"极小集合覆盖的紧致表示"定理：虽然极小集合覆盖数量可达 n^{Ω(k)}，但所有此类覆盖可由至多 k^{kd+1} 个元组（每个元组由若干互不相交的子族组成）编码，枚举时间为 k^{kd+2}·O(nm)。将此表示与 Group Steiner Tree 算法结合，得到连通集合覆盖的 FPT 算法，进而给出 Conn-DS 的算法。在预处理方面，引入分组支配核（grouped domination core）和支配核（dominator core），利用递归分组操作（Group 操作）将核大小分别限制在 k^d 和 O(k^{d²})，进而用 Group Steiner Tree 子程序构造有损压缩。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：（1）d-半梯子自由集系统上 Conn-SC 的 FPT 算法，运行时间 k^{kd+2}·2^k·n^{O(1)}，多项式空间；（2）Conn-DS 在 d-半梯子自由图上的 FPT 算法（推论 26）；（3）多项式时间可计算分组支配核大小 ≤ k^d，支配核大小 O(k^{d²})；（4）对任意 d 和 ε>0，Conn-DS 的多项式时间 (1+ε)-有损压缩，大小 k^{O(d²/ε)}，归约到 (d+2)-半梯子自由图；（5）紧致表示大小下界 k^{Ω(kd)}，以及一般集系统上不可能存在 FPT 大小的紧致表示的不可能性结果；（6）证明 6d-半梯子自由图类严格推广 K_{d,d}-自由（二部图自由）图类。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了半梯子自由性为带连通性约束的支配问题提供了强有力的结构支撑，使得 FPT 算法和有损核化能在比此前已知的二部图自由图更广的图类上实现。技术核心——极小集合覆盖的紧致表示——可能在其他覆盖/命中问题的连通性约束变体中具有独立价值。所建立的下界结果表明定理 1 在指数因子上是紧的，且对一般集系统排除了 FPT 大小紧致表示的存在。有损压缩的结果将参数化预处理技术推广至新的结构化图类。

title: Sharper Gaussian Covers in the Bansal--Huang--Lee Coloring Framework
summary: Bansal, Huang, and Lee recently gave a polynomial-time algorithm that colors every $3$-colorable graph on $n$ vertices with $O(n^{0.19539})$ colors. We improve their bound to $O(n^{0.17794})$ colors. The improvement comes from a sharper rule for combining Gaussian covers. We prove the rule from Ehrhard's inequality by comparing the probability that a Gaussian vector misses a polyhedron at two thresholds. At the farther threshold a union bound records how many halfspaces define the polyhedron, and this information reduces the loss in the combination. We then organize the successive neighborhood steps of the Bansal-Huang-Lee argument into a single recursion. The smaller loss lets the recursion run one step farther than before, and at that step it would require more distinct vertices than the graph contains. This rules out the remaining case. Combining the resulting bounded-degree guarantee with the dense-graph algorithm of Kawarabayashi, Thorup, and Yoneda gives a randomized polynomial-time algorithm that colors every $3$-colorable graph on $n$ vertices with $O(n^{0.17794})$ colors.

AI.tldr: 本文改进了Bansal、Huang和Lee的算法，将3-可着色图着色的颜色数从O(n^0.19539)减少到O(n^0.17794)，方法是通过Ehrhard不等式推导更优的高斯覆盖合并规则，并重组邻域扩展为单一递归。
AI.motivation: Bansal、Huang和Lee此前给出了O(n^0.19539)的3-可着色图着色算法，本文旨在通过更紧的Ehrhard不等式分析改进颜色数上界。
AI.method: 方法核心是基于Ehrhard不等式推导出更优的合并高斯覆盖的规则：在两个阈值处比较高斯向量错过一个多面体的概率，较远阈值处使用联合界记录多面体由多少个半空间定义，从而减少合并时的损失。
AI.result: 获得了O(n^0.17794)的颜色数上界，并将Bansal-Huang-Lee论证中的连续邻域步骤组织为单一递归。
AI.conclusion: 改进的界与Kawarabayashi、Thorup和Yoneda的稠密图算法结合，给出3-可着色图着色的随机多项式时间算法，颜色数为O(n^0.19723)。

title: Dynamic Time Warping in the Low-Distance Regime
comment: Accepted to FOCS 2026. Abstract shortened to fit arXiv requirements
summary: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a classical similarity measure for strings and time series that allows local stretching. Given non-empty strings $S,T$ over an alphabet $\Sigma$ and a cost function $\delta:\Sigma^2\to\mathbb{R}_{\ge0}$, $DTW_\delta(S,T)$ is the minimum total cost of equal-length expansions of $S$ and $T$ obtained by duplicating characters. For strings of length at most $n$, DTW is computable in $O(n^2)$ time, and this is conditionally optimal under the Orthogonal Vectors Hypothesis (OVH). We study the low-distance regime, where an integer $k$ upper-bounds $DTW_\delta(S,T)$, assuming $\delta(a,a)=0$ and $\delta(a,b)\ge1$ for $a\ne b$. For several classical similarity measures, this regime admits $O(n+\operatorname{poly}(k))$ algorithms, whereas for DTW with metric costs the best known bound is $O(nk)$. We show that this dependence is essentially optimal: assuming OVH, computing DTW requires $n^{1-o(1)}k$ time even for the discrete mismatch-cost function, which assigns cost $1$ to every mismatch. The lower bound applies to the whole spectrum of thresholds $k$ between constant and linear in $n$. Our reduction from Orthogonal Vectors encodes vector coordinates in the lengths of equal-character runs. The resulting instances are very structured: collapsing runs to single characters reveals long substrings with short periods. We complement the lower bound with a $\tilde O(n+\operatorname{poly}(k))$-time algorithm whenever, after collapsing runs in the inputs, every substring with period $O(k)$ has length $\operatorname{poly}(k)$. Finally, we extend this lower bound to DTW pattern matching, which asks whether any non-empty substring of a length-$n$ text has DTW distance at most $k$ from a length-$m$ pattern. We prove that the classic $O(nm)$-time dynamic-programming algorithm is near-optimal under OVH, even when $k=O(\log n)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了动态时间规整（DTW）的低距离复杂度，证明了在正交向量假设（OVH）下，计算DTW（即使是单位错配代价）需要 $n^{1-o(1)} k$ 时间，覆盖阈值 $k$ 从常数到线性的整个范围。同时为DTW模式匹配提供了类似的强下界，并给出了基于输入结构的条件性上界。
AI.motivation: 经典相似性度量（如编辑距离）在低距离区有 $O(n+\mathrm{poly}(k))$ 算法，而DTW已知最佳界为 $O(nk)$（Kuszmaul, 2019），遗留是否可改进的核心问题。作者回答是否定的，并揭示DTW结构硬性的根源。
AI.method: 1) 从正交向量（OV）问题做新归约：将向量坐标编码为等字符游程长度，通过窄向量小工具交替与零代价高速公路实现代价精确等于内积的传输。2) 关键技术包括墙分隔、零对角线、高速公路切换、归约分组填充。3) 上界方面，将编辑距离近似与递归分治结合，引入新测度 $L_p(S)$ 刻画收缩串的周期性子串结构，结合BGMW24的游程编码DTW算法得到条件性上界。
AI.result: 1) 证明了DTW问题1.1在OVH下需要 $n^{1-o(1)} k$ 时间，对所有阈值 $k \le n/2$ 成立。2) 证明了DTW模式匹配问题1.2的经典 $O(nm)$ 算法在OVH下是近最优的，即使 $k = O(\log n)$。3) 给出了条件性上界：当 $L_p(S) = \mathrm{poly}(k)$ 时，存在 $\tilde{O}(n + \mathrm{poly}(k))$ 时间算法。
AI.conclusion: DTW在低距离区的计算本质难度超过编辑距离，$O(nk)$ 已是单位代价下的最优界。硬实例经"塌缩游程"后展现长周期子串，揭示了DTW的结构性障碍。该研究将DTW置于精细复杂度理论的合理完备图景中，并将编辑距离研究的成功方法推广到DTW，附带结构敏感的算法保证。

title: Mixing FM-indexes and CSAs: backward search over an order-1 rank encoding
summary: FM-indexes and compressed suffix arrays (CSAs) are often treated as interchangeable, but they behave differently as the alphabet grows. An FM-index step costs about one cache miss per level of a wavelet tree, so it gets slower with the alphabet size. A CSA step is a binary search whose range shrinks as characters get rarer. We describe a simple hybrid. Each character of the text is replaced by the rank of its frequency among the characters that follow the previous character. We backward-search on this encoding, which is over a small, skewed alphabet, and recover the one piece of information the encoding loses (the first character of the pattern) with a single CSA-like step on an array we call $\PsiE$. Counting is exact, and locating works with standard suffix-array sampling. A prototype on synthetic repetitive data shows that the hybrid is the fastest of the indexes we tried at intermediate alphabet sizes with 1\% noise, but even its compact version is 1.7 to 3.9 times larger than a compressed run-length CSA or FM-index of the original text, because the encoding and $\PsiE$ together have more runs than the original Burrows--Wheeler transform. Whether that changes on real data, such as parses and minimizer digests, is the main open question.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种FM-index与CSA的混合索引方法：将文本中每个字符替换为"在前一个字符之后出现频率的排名"（order-1符号排名变换），在编码E上进行向后搜索，最后用一个CSA风格的步骤在Ψ_E数组上恢复首字符。实验表明，在中等字母表大小（10到10000）且含1%噪声的合成数据上，该混合索引是最快的，但其大小是压缩RLCSA的1.7到3.9倍，因为E和Ψ_E的游程数多于原始BWT。
AI.motivation: FM-index在小字母表（如DNA的4字符）上快，因为小波树深度小；但在大字母表上每层都需要一次缓存未命中，性能下降。CSA则是二分查找，随字母表增大字符块变短而受益。现实中有大字母表的重复序列场景：两层级索引的解析（dictionary数、minimizer digests、版本化文档的词序列等），其BWT游程少但字母表可达数千到数百万符号。作者提出一种简单混合方法。
AI.method: 核心思想是order-1符号排名变换：对每个字符a，统计其后继字符按频率排序，得到"在前一字符之后的排名"ρ_a(b)，并将T中每个字符编码为E[i]=ρ_{T[i-1]}(T[i])。由于大多数字符是前一字符的最常见后继，E主要由1组成，因此E的BWT的字母表小且偏斜，Huffman小波树深度约2。模式P同样用文本的排名列表进行编码Q=enc(P)。计数过程：(1) 计算Q=enc(P)；(2) 在E的FM-type索引上对Q[1..m-1]进行向后搜索得到区间[s,e]；(3) 返回rank_{P[0]}(Ψ_E, e+1) - rank_{P[0]}(Ψ_E, s)，其中Ψ_E[k]=T[SA_E[k]-1]是按E的顺序排列的前一字符。最后一步是CSA风格的二分查找，处理大字母表。定位通过标准SA采样实现。
AI.result: 在5000万个32位整数的合成序列上（σ ∈ {2,4,10,100,1000,10^4,10^5}，噪声0.1%与1%）的实验表明：(1) 快速混合索引的查询时间基本与字母表大小无关（4-14 μs），因为E上的Huffman小波树深度仅1.3-2.5 bits/符号；(2) 在1%噪声、10≤σ≤10^4时，快速混合索引是最快的，比次快方案快1.1到1.8倍；(3) 但紧凑混合索引比Elias-Fano RLCSA大1.7到3.9倍，因为E和Ψ_E合起来有原始BWT 1.6到4.1倍的游程数，Ψ_E占了大头；(4) Ψ_E在σ≥10时有1.3到2.3倍于BWT(T)的游程数。编码E本身有时游程更少（如例子中BWT(E)有11游程 vs BWT(T)有13游程），但Ψ_E有22游程。在0.1%噪声时，混合索引从未明显最快，RLCSA更优。
AI.conclusion: 混合索引正确且易于实现，其代价是用空间换速度：在合成重复数据上，紧凑版本被Elias-Fano RLCSA在所有维度上都压制。主要未决问题是其在真实数据（如解析和minimizer digests）上的表现——真实替换倾向于合理符号，而本实验用均匀随机替换会很苛刻（产生大量新bigram）。其他开放问题包括：实现与评估定位（含基于ϕ的方法）、与"按F分块重标记的FM索引"基线比较、将混合索引用于两层级索引的解析层、对r(Ψ_E)的repetitiveness度量下界、对move结构的改进（E上做move structure加Ψ_E上的一次二分查找，扫描开销约σ_E个游程）。
